board-key-invalid: Mabuɗin allo manyan haruffan Latin ne da lambobi 2 zuwa 10, wanda ya fara da harafi.
legal-page-external-url: Ko hanyar haɗi zuwa shafin a wani wuri (https://...)
legal-page-not-published: Ba a wallafa wannan shafin ba tukuna.
legal-page-require-acceptance: Buƙaci karɓar wannan siga da kowace sabuwa
legal-acceptance-text: Da fatan za a karanta kuma a karɓi waɗannan don ci gaba.
legal-acceptance-changed: Wannan shafin ya canza a halin yanzu. Da fatan za a karanta sabuwar siga.
legal-acceptance-signup: Na karɓi sharuɗɗan amfani da sanarwar sirri
error-minimum-age: Dole ne ka kasance da shekaru __age__ aƙalla kafin ka yi rajista a nan.
export-csv-board-roles: Alluna da matsayi a matsayin CSV

error-board-notAdmin: Dole ka zama mai gudanar da wannan allo don yin hakan
error-board-notAMember: Dole ka zama memban wannan allo don yin hakan
error-watch-disabled: Mai gudanarwa ya kashe kallon alluna da katuna
error-notAllowed: Rawarka a allo ba ta da izinin yin hakan
error-json-malformed: Rubutunka ba ingantaccen JSON ba ne
error-json-schema: Bayanan JSON ɗinka ba su ƙunshi bayanan da suka dace a tsari madaidaici ba
error-csv-schema: CSV (Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Waƙafi)/TSV (Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Tab) ɗinka ba ya ƙunsar bayanan da suka dace a tsari madaidaici
error-import-empty-board: Wannan fitarwa ba ta ƙunsar abun cikin allo (babu layukan iyo, jerin ko katuna). Wataƙila tsohuwar sigar WeKan mai sanannen kuskuren fitarwa ce ta ƙirƙire shi. Don Allah sake fitar da allon da sigar yanzu sannan ka shigo da sabon fayil.
error-linked-card-not-allowed: Za ka iya haɗawa da kati na yau da kullum kawai. Ba a yarda a haɗa da wani kati mai haɗi, ko kati da ke komawa wannan allo ba domin hakan zai sa katunan ba za a iya isa gare su ba.
error-user-disabled: An kashe wannan asusun mai amfani
error-user-doesNotExist: Wannan mai amfani ba ya wanzu
error-user-notAllowSelf: Ba za ka iya gayyatar kanka ba
error-user-notCreated: Ba a ƙirƙiri wannan mai amfani ba
error-username-taken: An riga an ɗauki wannan sunan mai amfani
error-orgname-taken: An riga an ɗauki wannan sunan ƙungiya
error-teamname-taken: An riga an ɗauki wannan sunan tawaga
error-email-taken: An riga an ɗauki imel ɗin
export-board-without-archive: ba tare da abubuwan da aka adana ba
user-can-not-export-excel: Mai amfani ba zai iya fitar da Excel ba
export-card-excel-fields: Zaɓi filayen da za a haɗa a fitarwar Excel:
export-card-field-people: Mutane (Mai ƙirƙira, Mai shi, Mambobi, Waɗanda aka ba)
export-card-field-dates: Kwanakin wata (Ƙirƙira, Karɓa, Farawa, Ƙarshe, Karewa)
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Ba za a iya fitarwa zuwa Excel ba: babu isasshen sararin diski
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Mai amfani ba zai iya fitar da kati zuwa PDF ba
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Mai amfani ba zai iya fitar da kati zuwa Excel ba
filter-recency-older: Fiye da kwanaki 30 da suka gabata
filter-movement-range: An matsar a lokacin (tarihin da aka rubuta)
filter-date-range-missing: Haɗa katunan da ba su da wannan kwanan wata
filter-date-range-invalid: Zaɓi kwanakin da suka dace, tare da ƙarshen a ranar farawa ko bayanta.
filter-due-previous-week: Lokacin ƙarewa a makon da ya gabata
filter-due-next-month: Lokacin ƙarewa a wata mai zuwa
filter-creator-label: Tace ta wanda aka Mai ƙirƙira
filter-column-age: Ɓoye tsofaffin katuna a cikin jeri
filter-column-age-disabled: Kada a ɓoye bisa tsawon zama a jeri
filter-column-age-hint: Ɓoye katunan da suka shiga wannan jerin fiye da wannan adadin kwanaki da suka gabata. Sauran jerin da katunan da ba a san ranar shigarsu ba za su ci gaba da bayyana. Gyara kati ba ya sake fara ƙidayar lokacin zamansa a jeri.
filter-on-desc: Kana tace katuna a wannan allo. Danna nan don gyara tacewar.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Tace kwanakin kati da @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt ko @listEnteredAt. Misali: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' ko @endAt = none. Saka sunan filin musamman da ya fara da @ cikin alamomin zance.
advanced-filter-description: Tacewa ta ci gaba tana ba da damar rubuta jimla mai waɗannan alamomin aiki: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ana amfani da sarari wajen raba alamomin. Za ka iya tace duk filaye na musamman ta rubuta sunayensu da ƙimominsu. Misali: Field1 == Value1. Lura: Idan fili ko ƙima na ɗauke da sarari, dole ka saka su cikin alamar zance guda. Misali: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Don tsallake haruffan sarrafawa guda (' \/), za ka iya amfani da \. Misali: Field1 == I\'m. Haka kuma za ka iya haɗa sharuɗɗa da yawa. Misali: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. A al'ada ana fassara duk alamomin daga hagu zuwa dama. Za ka iya sauya jeri ta amfani da baka. Misali: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Haka kuma za ka iya neman filayen rubutu da regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Yana daidaitawa lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri kati, ko aka canza taken ko bayaninsa, kuma sabon rubutun ya ƙunshi wannan (ba tare da bambance manyan da ƙananan haruffa ba).
imported-member-no-account: Memba da aka shigo da shi — babu asusun da ya dace tukuna
impersonate-user: Yi aiki a matsayin mai amfani
impersonate-emergency: Shiga na gaggawa: sanar da duk sauran masu gudanarwa yanzu
impersonate-emergency-note: Dalili (ana aika wa sauran masu gudanarwa)
email-emergency-access-subject: Shiga na gaggawa: __admin__ ya shiga a matsayin __user__
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ ya yi amfani da shiga na gaggawa don shiga a matsayin __user__ a __url__ a __time__.

Dalili: __note__

Duk abin da aka yi a wannan lokacin yana cikin Panel na Admin / Mutane / Rajistar bincike da Matsaloli / Rahoton kwaikwayon mai amfani.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar Kanboard: abu mai "columns" (ko ayyuka masu column_name) da jerin "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ginshiƙai su zama jerin, ayyuka su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-deck: Liƙa JSON na allon NextCloud Deck (allo mai "stacks", kowane stack yana ɗauke da "cards"). Stacks su zama jerin, cards su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Liƙa JSON na tarin fakitin-aiki na OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Matsayi su zama jerin, fakitin aiki su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-issues: Liƙa jerin JSON na batutuwan __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Batutuwa su zama katuna da aka haɗa cikin jerin Buɗe / Rufe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar ayyukan Asana ({ "data": [...] } daga fitarwar Asana ko GET /tasks). Ana haɗa ayyuka cikin sassa (memberships); ayyukan da aka kammala su koma An gama.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar jerin ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages su zama jerin, items su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Manna jerin ayyuka na markdown (al'adar da kayan aikin markdown-kanban kamar Obsidian Kanban ke amfani da ita): taken "## Sunan jeri", tare da abubuwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" a ƙasa. Taken suna zama jerin sunayen kuma abubuwa suna zama katunan; jeri mai sauƙi na maki ba tare da akwatin duba ba shima ana shigar da shi, a matsayin katunan buɗe.
import-board-instruction-leo: Manna tsarin Leo (fayil .leo). Ƙwayoyin matakin farko sukan zama jerin, ’ya’yansu sukan zama katuna masu amfani da jikin ƙwayar a matsayin bayanin, ƙwayoyin da suka fi zurfi kuma sukan zama jerin dubawa. Ana shigo da ƙwayoyin da aka yi wa alama a matsayin an gama.
import-board-instruction-opml: Liƙa tsarin OPML, kamar yadda Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq da sauran shirye-shiryen tsari ke fitar da shi. Abubuwan saman matakin suna zama jerin abubuwa, 'ya'yansu suna zama katuna tare da bayanin kula a matsayin bayani, kuma abubuwa masu zurfi suna zama jerin dubawa. Abubuwan da aka kammala ana shigo da su a matsayin an gama.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Liƙa fayil ɗin Org mode, kamar yadda Emacs, Orgzly ko Beorg ke rubuta shi. Kanun saman matakin suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma kanun mataki na biyu suna zama katuna. Ana kiyaye TODO da DONE, fifiko, tambari, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE da CLOSED, kuma akwatunan alama da kanun masu zurfi suna zama jerin dubawa.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Manna fayil ɗin todo.txt: aiki ɗaya a kowane layi, kamar yadda manhajar todo.txt da manhajojin da suka dace da ita suke rubutawa. Ayyukan da aka kammala ("x") suna zuwa Done, +project da @context suna zama alamomi, (A) yana zama alamar fifiko, sannan due: da t: suna zama ranar ƙarshe da ranar farawa.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Manna sakamakon task export: jerin JSON ko aiki ɗaya a kowane layi. Ayyukan da aka kammala suna zuwa Done, project da priority suna zama alamomi, annotations yana zama sharhi, depends kuma yana zama dogaro da ayyukan da ke toshe su.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Buɗe fayil ɗin .boardarchive daga kundin da aka matse, sannan manna abin da ke cikin board.jsonl na allo, tare da layin sigar ko ba tare da shi ba. Siffar haɗawa rukuni-rukuni ta kallon allo tana zama jerin abubuwa, sauran siffofin zaɓi suna zama alamomi, tubalan rubutu da akwatunan alama suna zama bayani da jerin dubawa, kuma ana riƙe sharhi. Ba a shigo da hotuna da haɗe-haɗe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: A cikin Azure DevOps, buɗe Boards, sannan Queries, gudanar da tambaya da ke nuna ginshiƙan da kake so, ka zaɓi Export to CSV; zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .csv. Board Column (ko State) yana zama jerin abubuwa, Board Lane kuma layuka; abubuwan aiki suna zama katunan tare da nau'insu da tags ɗinsu a matsayin alamomi, Assigned To, kwanan wata, bayani da mahaifi, sauran ginshiƙai kuma suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-mslists: A cikin Microsoft Lists, buɗe jerin, zaɓi Export, sannan Export to CSV, ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .csv. Ginshiƙin Status (ko Progress) yana zama jerin abubuwa, kowane abu kuma kati, tare da takensa, bayani, mutane, kwanan wata da tags; sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-msproject: A cikin Microsoft Project, zaɓi File, sannan Save As, da nau'in XML Format (*.xml), ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin. Ayyukan taƙaitawa suna zama layuka, ayyuka kuma katunan a cikin Not started, In progress ko Completed, tare da kwanan watansu, bayanai, albarkatu, ƙananan ayyuka da waɗanda suka gabace su.
import-board-instruction-outlook: A cikin Outlook, ja saƙonni zuwa babban fayil a kwamfutarka, ko adana su da File, sannan Save As, a matsayin Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Zaɓi fayil ɗin .msg ɗaya, ko .zip na fayilolin .msg da .eml. Kowace tattaunawa tana zama kati a cikin Board View / Email, tare da amsoshinta a matsayin sharhuna, abubuwan haɗawa kuma a matsayin fayiloli.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: A MeisterTask, danna sunan aikin, zaɓi Export project kuma fitar da CSV, sannan ka liƙa shi. Sassa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da bayanin kulansu, ranar ƙarshe, wanda aka ba wa da tambari; ayyukan da aka kammala suna kiyaye ranar kammalawarsu. CSV da aka rubuta don shigo da MeisterTask na kansa shi ma yana aiki.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: A Obsidian, buɗe fayil ɗin allon Kanban a matsayin Markdown (ko buɗe fayil ɗin .md a editan rubutu), sannan ka liƙa duka. Layukan suna zama jerin abubuwa tare da iyakokin katunansu, katuna suna kiyaye tambarinsu, kwanakinsu, fifiko, filaye da jerin dubawa, kuma Archive yana zama katunan taska.
import-board-instruction-linear: A Linear, fitar da batutuwa a matsayin CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, ko fitar da wani view), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, ƙungiyoyi suna zama layuka, kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna tare da wanda aka ba wa, alamomi, kwanaki, babban batu, fifiko, ƙiyasi, aiki da zagaye.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: A TickTick, buɗe Settings, Account, Backup & Import kuma ƙirƙiri ajiyar kwafi, sannan ka liƙa fayil ɗin CSV. Kowane jerin TickTick yana zama layi kuma ginshiƙansa suna zama jerin abubuwa; ayyuka suna kiyaye tambarinsu, kwanaki, jerin dubawa, fifiko da ƙananan ayyuka.
import-board-instruction-clickup: A ClickUp, fitar da ayyuka a matsayin CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, ko fitar da List ko Table view tare da dukkan ginshiƙai), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, jerin ClickUp suna zama layuka, kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna tare da ƙananan ayyukansu, waɗanda aka ba wa, tambari, kwanaki, fifiko da lokaci.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: A Nullboard, buɗe allon, zaɓi Export this board... daga menu, buɗe fayil ɗin .nbx a editan rubutu kuma liƙa abin da ke ciki. Jerin abubuwa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma bayanan kula suna zama katuna: layin farko na bayanin kula shi ne taken kati kuma sauran bayaninsa ne. Bayanin kula raw yana samun alamar raw. Fayil mai alluna da yawa yana shigo da allonsa na farko.
import-board-instruction-kanri: A Kanri, buɗe Import & Export kuma zaɓi Export individual board (ko Export all data), sannan ka liƙa fayil ɗin .json. Ginshiƙai suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma katuna suna zama katuna, tare da bayaninsu, ranar ƙarshe, tambari da launuka; ayyukan kati suna zama jerin dubawa. Daga fitar da dukkan bayanai ana shigo da allon farko.
import-board-instruction-planka: Rubuta adireshin Planka ɗinka (misali https://planka.example.com), sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri na Planka, sannan danna Jera. Ana amfani da su ne kawai don ɗauko allon kuma ba a adana su. Zaɓi allo ka danna Ɗauko: WeKan yana karanta shi daga API na Planka, tare da jerin sa, katuna, bayanai, ranakun ƙarshe, alamomi, mambobi, jerin ayyuka da sharhuna, sannan ka ci gaba da shigo da shi kamar yadda aka saba. Katunan da ke ma'ajiyar Planka ana shigo da su a adane; haɗe-haɗe da katunan da ke cikin kwandon shara ba a shigo da su.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: A cikin Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), shiga, amince da izinin Tasks.Read kuma kwafi alamar daga shafin Access token. Liƙa ta a nan ka danna Jera; ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Zaɓi duk jerin ko jeri ɗaya ka danna Ɗauko. Kowane jerin To Do yana zama jeri kuma kowane aiki kati, tare da bayanansa, ranar ƙarshe da ta farawa, matakai a matsayin jerin dubawa, rukunoni a matsayin alamomi, da muhimmanci mai girma da matsayi a matsayin alamomi; ana adana ayyukan da aka kammala. Ba a shigo da tunatarwa da maimaitawa.
import-board-instruction-onenote: A cikin Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), shiga, amince da izinin Notes.Read kuma kwafi alamar daga shafin Access token. Liƙa ta a nan ka danna Jera; ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Zaɓi littafin rubutu ka danna Ɗauko. Sassan suna zama jerin abubuwa, shafuka kuma katunan, tare da rubutunsu, akwatunan ayyuka a matsayin jerin dubawa, ƙananan shafuka kuma a matsayin ƙananan ayyuka.
import-board-instruction-teams: Liƙa alamar shiga ta Microsoft Graph mai Chat.Read (daga Graph Explorer, asusun aiki ko makaranta) ka danna Jera, sannan zaɓi hira ko tasha ka danna Ɗauko; ba a adana alamar. Ko zaɓi fayil: .tar na fitarwarka ta kanka daga teams.live.com/dataexport, ko .json na saƙonnin hira. Kowace hira tana zama kati a cikin Board View / Chat, saƙonninta kuma sharhuna.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: A cikin Sandstorm, buɗe grain na __app__, zaɓi Download backup a saman sandar grain ɗin, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .zip. Abin da ke cikin grain ɗin ya zama allo, abubuwansa kuma su zama katunan tare da abin da manhajar ke adanawa game da su. Zaɓi manhajar da grain ɗin yake nata: ana ƙin grain na wata manhaja, kuma yana faɗin wace manhaja ce.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: A cikin KanbanFlow, buɗe menu na allon, zaɓi Settings → API & Webhooks kuma kwafi alamar API ta allon. Liƙa alamar a nan, danna Jera, zaɓi allon ka danna Ɗauko; ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Ginshiƙai suna zama jeri kuma layuka suna kasancewa layuka; ayyuka suna riƙe bayaninsu, launi, alamomi, ranar ƙarshe, ƙananan ayyuka a matsayin jerin dubawa, lokacin da aka kashe, ƙiyasi, mutane da sharhuna.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Rubuta ID na asusun Basecamp ɗinka (lambar bayan basecamp.com/ a cikin adireshin) da alamar shiga (daga manhajar OAuth 2 da aka yi rajista a launchpad.37signals.com, ko wadda haɗin da ke akwai ya riga ya mallaka), danna Jera, zaɓi aiki ka danna Ɗauko. Ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Kowane teburin katuna yana zama layi tare da ginshiƙansa a matsayin jeri, kuma jerin abubuwan yi suna zama layin Abubuwan yi; katuna da abubuwan yi suna riƙe rubutunsu, ranaku, waɗanda aka ɗora wa da sharhuna, matakan kati suna zama jerin dubawa kuma ana adana abubuwan yi da aka kammala.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Samo alamar shiga daga OAuth 2.0 Playground: ƙarƙashin Tasks API v1 zaɓi tasks.readonly, danna Authorize APIs, sannan Exchange authorization code for tokens, kuma kwafi alamar shiga. Liƙa ta a nan ka danna Jera, zaɓi duk jerin ayyuka ko ɗaya, sannan Ɗauko. Ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Jerin ayyuka suna zama jeri kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da bayanansu, mahaɗai da ranar ƙarshe; ƙananan ayyuka suna zama jerin dubawa kuma ana shigo da ayyukan da aka kammala a adane.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API na Google Keep na asusun Google Workspace ne kawai. Samo alamar shiga ta OAuth 2.0 tare da iyaka https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (a cikin OAuth 2.0 Playground idan mai gudanar da Workspace ɗinka ya yarda, ko daga asusun sabis mai wakilci na duk yanki), liƙa ta, danna Jera sannan Ɗauko. Ana amfani da alamar ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana ta. Bayanan rubutu suna zama katuna a cikin jerin Bayanai, kuma bayanan jerin dubawa suna zama katuna a cikin jerin Jeri tare da abubuwansu a matsayin jerin dubawa. Ba a shigo da bayanan da ke cikin kwandon shara, haɗe-haɗe da rabawa.
api-import-desc: Ɗauko shi daga sabis ɗin da asusunka. Abin da ka rubuta a nan ana amfani da shi ne kawai don wannan ɗaukowa kuma ba a adana shi.
api-import-list: Jera abin da za a iya shigo da shi
api-import-fetched: An ɗauko. Duba mambobin da ke ƙasa ka shigo da su.
api-import-nothing: Babu abin da za a shigo da shi da wannan asusun.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: A Pivotal Tracker, buɗe shafin MORE na aikin kuma zaɓi Export CSV (ko zaɓi labarai kuma zaɓi Bulk Actions, CSV), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Kowane matsayin labari yana zama jeri kuma labarai suna zama katuna, tare da nau'insu da alamominsu, masu su, mai nema, kwanaki, sharhuna, ayyuka da masu toshewa; Estimate yana zama Story points kuma zagaye suna zama sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: A Tasks.org, buɗe Settings, Backups kuma zaɓi Export tasks, sannan ka liƙa abin da ke cikin fayil ɗin .json. Jerin abubuwa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da bayanan kulansu, tambari, kwanaki, sharhuna da ƙananan ayyuka; ayyukan da aka kammala suna kiyaye ranar kammalawarsu, kuma fifiko yana zama filin keɓaɓɓe.
import-board-instruction-monday: A monday.com, buɗe menu na allo, zaɓi More actions da Export board to Excel (tare da updates da subitems idan kana so), sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .xlsx. Ginshiƙin Status yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma ƙungiyoyi suna zama layuka; mutane, kwanaki, timeline da tambari suna kiyaye wurarensu, sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu kuma updates suna zama sharhuna.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: A Super Productivity, buɗe Settings, sannan Sync & Backup, zaɓi Export Data kuma liƙa abin da ke cikin fayil ɗin sp-backup .json. Kowane aiki yana zama layi kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna a To Do, In Progress, Backlog ko Done, tare da bayanan kulansu, tambari, ranar ƙarshe, lokacin da aka kashe da ƙananan ayyuka; ayyukan taska suna zama katunan taska.
import-board-instruction-taiga: A Taiga, buɗe Admin > Project > Export kuma sauke juji na aikin (buɗe fayil ɗin .json.gz da farko), sannan ka liƙa JSON ɗinsa. Matsayin user story suna zama jerin abubuwa, user story suna zama katuna tare da ayyukansu a matsayin ƙananan ayyuka, epic da batutuwa suna samun layukansu na kansu, kuma sprint, tambari, sharhuna da halaye na keɓaɓɓu suna zuwa tare. Ba a shigo da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: A Vikunja, buɗe Settings, zaɓi Data Export kuma sauke fayil ɗin .zip da yake aiko maka, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil, ko liƙa data.json da ke cikinsa. Bokitin Kanban suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da alamominsu, waɗanda aka ba wa, kwanaki, bayani, jerin ayyuka a matsayin jerin dubawa da sharhuna; fifiko, kashi da aka gama da an gama suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Ba a shigo da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-quire: A Quire, buɗe menu na aikin kuma zaɓi Export CSV, sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da ƙananan ayyukansu a matsayin katunan 'ya'ya, waɗanda aka ba wa, tambari a matsayin alamomi, ranakun farawa, ƙarshe da kammalawa, bayani da fifiko a matsayin filin keɓaɓɓe. Sharhuna da abubuwan haɗawa ba sa cikin CSV na Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: A Wrike, fitar da aiki ko babban fayil zuwa Excel, ko cike samfurin shigo da Excel na Wrike, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .xlsx. Layukan babban fayil da aiki suna zama layuka, Status yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da Key ɗinsu, babban aiki, waɗanda aka ba wa, ranakun farawa da ƙarshe, dogaro da bayani; Priority, Duration da sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: A Teamwork.com, cike samfurin shigo da ayyuka na Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) kuma ajiye shi a matsayin .xlsx, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil. Jerin ayyuka suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna; aikin da ya fara da -, # ko > yana zama ƙaramin aiki na aikin da ke samansa (--, ## ko >> mataki ɗaya ƙasa). Waɗanda aka ba wa, kwanaki da tambari suna kiyaye wurarensu; Priority, Estimated time da Complete suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: A Businessmap (wanda a da ake kira Kanbanize), buɗe Advanced Search, zaɓi Configure results don zaɓar ginshiƙai, sauke fayil ɗin Excel, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .xlsx. Ana karanta ginshiƙai da sunayensu na Turanci (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): idan asusunka yana amfani da wani harshe, sake suna layin kanun zuwa Turanci da farko. Column yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma Lane layuka; masu su, tambari, launi, kwanaki, sharhuna da mahaɗan iyaye suna kiyaye wurarensu, kuma Priority, Size, Type da sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-redmine: A Redmine, buɗe Issues na aikin, zaɓi Also available in: CSV a ƙasan jerin, zaɓi ginshiƙai (All columns, tare da Description) kuma fitar, sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Redmine yana sanya sunayen ginshiƙai a harshenka, don haka saita harshenka zuwa Turanci a My account kafin fitarwa. Kowane matsayi yana zama jeri kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna, tare da tracker a matsayin alama, wanda aka ba wa, marubuci, kwanaki, babban aiki da batutuwa masu alaƙa; fifiko, rukuni, sigar da aka nufa, ƙiyasin lokaci, % Done da filayen keɓaɓɓu suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-notion: A Notion, buɗe rumbun bayanai a matsayin cikakken shafi, zaɓi ••• da Export, zaɓi Markdown & CSV, kuma zaɓi fayil ɗin .zip da ya sauke, ko CSV ɗaya na rumbun bayanai daga ciki, ko liƙa wannan CSV. Ginshiƙin mai suna Status yana zama jerin abubuwa (idan babu shi, ginshiƙin farko da ya yi kama da zaɓi ne, kuma rahoton shigowa yana faɗin wanne); layuka suna zama katuna tare da takensu, tambari a matsayin alamomi, mutane a matsayin mambobi, kwanaki, da rubutun shafi a matsayin bayani; sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Ba a shigo da dangantaka, hotuna da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-plane: A Plane, buɗe Workspace Settings, zaɓi Exports, fitar da ayyuka a matsayin JSON, CSV ko Excel kuma sauke fayil ɗin .zip, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil, ko fayil ɗaya daga ciki, ko liƙa JSON ko CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, ayyuka suna zama layuka, kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna tare da mai gano su, iyaye, waɗanda aka ba wa, alamomi, kwanaki, mahaɗai da sharhuna; fifiko, ƙiyasi, zagaye da module suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Fitarwar Plane ba ta da bayanai ko abubuwan haɗawa, don haka ba a shigo da su ba.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: A Fizzy, fitar da asusun a "Account settings", ko katunanka da "Download my data", sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .zip da Fizzy ya aiko maka, ko fayil ɗin .json na kati ɗaya. Allunan suna zama layuka, ginshiƙai kuma suna zama jerin, tare da "Maybe?", "Not now" da "Done" kamar a Fizzy; katunan suna riƙe bayaninsu, alamominsu, waɗanda aka ba wa, matakai a matsayin jerin dubawa, sharhuna da fayiloli.
import-board-instruction-mail: Zaɓi fayil ɗin .mbox, kamar yadda Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt ko Gmail ta hanyar Google Takeout ke adana shi, ko saƙo ɗaya na .eml, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Kowace tattaunawa za ta zama kati ɗaya a jerin Inbox, tare da mai aikawa, masu karɓa da batunta, don ta bayyana a duban Email; amsoshin za su zama sharhunanta. Alamomin Gmail za su zama alamomi. Ba a shigo da haɗe-haɗe ba.
import-board-instruction-ical: Zaɓi fayil ɗin kalanda na .ics, kamar yadda Google Calendar, Apple Calendar ko Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud ko Outlook ke fitar da shi, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Ayyuka za su je To Do, In Progress, Done ko Cancelled bisa matsayinsu, abubuwan da suka faru kuma zuwa Events, tare da ranakun farawa da na ƙarshe, don su bayyana a duban Calendar da Gantt. Rukunai da fifiko za su zama alamomi. Abubuwan da ke maimaituwa ana shigo da su sau ɗaya.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: A takeout.google.com, zaɓi Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar da Google Chat, ƙirƙiri fitarwar sannan ka sauke fayil ɗin .zip, sannan ka zaɓe shi a nan. Kowane samfur zai zama layi: wasiƙa don duban Email, jerin ayyuka da bayanai tare da jerin dubawarsu, abubuwan kalanda da ayyuka tare da ranaku, da wuraren hira waɗanda saƙonninsu sharhuna ne don duban Chat. Ba a shigo da sauran samfura da haɗe-haɗe ba.
import-board-instruction-slack: A Slack, buɗe saitunan wurin aiki, zaɓi Import/Export Data, fitar da wurin aikin sannan ka sauke fayil ɗin .zip, sannan ka zaɓe shi a nan. Kowace tasha za ta zama kati a Channels, Groups ko Direct messages, saƙonninta da amsoshin zaren kuma za su zama sharhunan katin, bisa marubucinsu, don duban Chat ya nuna tashar. Ba a shigo da fayiloli ba.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Fitar da mmctl export create, sauke fitarwar sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗinta na .jsonl, ko liƙa rubutunta. Kowace tasha da saƙon kai tsaye za su zama kati, rubuce-rubucenta da amsoshinta kuma za su zama sharhunan katin, don duban Chat ya nuna tashar. Ƙungiyoyi za su zama layuka. Ba a shigo da fayiloli ba.
import-board-instruction-telegram: A Telegram Desktop, buɗe Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, zaɓi tsarin JSON sannan ka fitar, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin result.json, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Kowace hira za ta zama kati a Direct messages, Groups ko Channels, saƙonninta kuma za su zama sharhunan katin, don duban Chat ya nuna hirar. Ba a shigo da hotuna da fayiloli ba.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: A WhatsApp, buɗe hirar, zaɓi Export chat ba tare da kafofin watsa labarai ba, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .txt a nan, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Hirar za ta zama kati wanda saƙonninsa sharhunansa ne, bisa mai aikawa da lokaci, don duban Chat ya nuna ta. Ba a shigo da kafofin watsa labarai da saƙonnin tsarin ba.
import-board-instruction-discord: Fitar da tashar Discord da DiscordChatExporter a tsarin JSON sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .json, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Tashar za ta zama kati a rukuninta, saƙonninta kuma za su zama sharhunan katin, don duban Chat ya nuna tashar. Sabar za ta zama layin. Ba a shigo da haɗe-haɗe ba.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: A Rocket.Chat, fitar da bayananka a matsayin JSON a "My Data" sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .zip da ya aiko maka, ko fayil ɗin .json da aka fitar na ɗaki ɗaya. Kowane ɗaki yana zama kati, saƙonninsa kuma suna zama sharhunan katin, don duban Chat ya nuna ɗakin. Ana kuma karanta .zip da WeKan ke fitarwa don mai shigo da CSV na Rocket.Chat.
import-board-instruction-evernote: A Evernote, fitar da bayanan ko littafin bayanai a matsayin fayil ɗin .enex sannan ka zaɓe shi a nan, ko liƙa rubutunsa. Kowane bayani zai zama kati tare da rubutunsa, akwatunan abubuwan yi a matsayin jerin dubawa, alamominsa a matsayin alamomi da tunatarwarsa a matsayin ranar ƙarshe; bayanan da tunatarwarsu ta kammala za su je Done. Ba a shigo da hotuna da fayilolin da aka haɗa ba.
tool-group-issues: Masu bin diddigin matsaloli da sarrafa sigar
tool-group-messages: Imel, kalandoji, hira da bayanan kula
import-board-instruction-trello: A allon Trello, je zuwa 'Menu', sannan 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ka kwafi rubutun da aka samar.
import-board-instruction-csv: Liƙa Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Waƙafi (CSV)/Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Tab (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Liƙa JSON daga binciken batu na Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), ko makamancin abu { "issues": [...] }. Matsayin Jira su zama jerin, batutuwa su zama katuna. Za ka iya haɗa jerin "automationRules" don shigo da dokoki.
import-board-instruction-excel: Zaɓi takardar .xlsx irin ta WeKan (ginshiƙai iri ɗaya da fitarwar Excel: Take, Bayani, Matsayi/Jeri, Mambobi, Lakabai, kwanakin wata, filaye na musamman). Layi na farko shi ne take.
import-board-instruction-wekan: A allonka, je zuwa 'Menu', sannan 'Export board', ka kwafi rubutun cikin fayil ɗin da aka sauke.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Idan ka samu kurakurai yayin shigo da allo, wani lokaci shigowar tana aiki duk da haka, kuma allon yana shafin Duk Alluna.
import-without-mapping-members: Shigo ba tare da haɗa mambobi ba (haɗa daga baya)
import-members-mode-map: Zaɓi mai amfani da ke akwai ga kowannensu
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bar su a matsayin masu amfani na wucin gadi da sunayensu, don haɗa su da masu amfani na gaske daga baya
csv-mapping-description: Zaɓi ginshiƙin fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da kowane filin kati. An yi zaɓuɓɓukan daga sunayen ginshiƙai; canza duk wanda ba daidai ba, kuma zaɓi (ba ya cikin fayil) ga filin da fayil ɗin ba shi da shi.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Fayil ɗin ba shi da ginshiƙi na jeri. Zaɓi ɗaya a sama, ko rubuta sunan jeri ɗaya da kowane kati zai shiga.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Sauran ginshiƙai da za a shigo da su a matsayin filayen keɓaɓɓu na rubutu:
csv-mapping-boards: Kowane takarda yana zama allonsa na kansa:
csv-mapping-skipped-sheets: Takardun da ba a shigo da su ba:
csv-mapping-title-required: Zaɓi ginshiƙin da ke ɗauke da taken katuna.
csv-mapping-list-required: Rubuta sunan jerin da kowane kati zai shiga, ko zaɓi ginshiƙin da ke ɗauke da jerin.
invalid-import-mapping: Haɗin ginshiƙai bai dace da fayil ɗin ba.
import-many-boards-hint: Zaɓi fayilolin fitarwa da yawa na wannan kayan aiki, ko .zip ɗaya da ke ɗauke da su: kowane fayil yana zama allonsa na kansa, an shigo da shi ba tare da haɗa mambobi ba. .zip da shi kansa fitarwa ɗaya ne (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, ko WeKan tare da abubuwan haɗawa) allo ɗaya ne. Idan an zaɓi fayiloli a nan, Shigo da yana shigo da su maimakon filin da ke sama.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Kowane layi da shigowar za ta yi (aiki, babban fayil ko jerin kayan aikin) yana zama allonsa na kansa. Katunan iyaye da dogaro tsakanin waɗannan alluna ana lissafa su a rahoton shigowa.
import-many-results-heading: Fayilolin da aka shigo da su
export-all-boards-hint: Kowane allo da za ka iya fitarwa, a saukewa ɗaya: Excel a matsayin littafi ɗaya mai takarda ga kowane allo mai sunansa, kowane sauran tsari a matsayin .zip mai fayil ga kowane allo.
import-json-file: Ko zaɓi fayil ɗin JSON na Trello
import-attachments-zip: ZIP na maƙalolin Trello (na zaɓi, daga Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Allon Trello ɗaya da aka fitar a matsayin .json. Idan ka adana mabuɗin API da token na Trello, ana sauke maƙalolinsa, bangon allo da hotunan mambobi ma.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Fayil .zip mai fayilolin .json na allo ɗaya ko fiye da maƙalolinsu a ƙananan manyan fayiloli masu sunan allo (daga Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Ana shigo da duk allunan.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Ba a sami fayilolin .json na allon Trello a cikin .zip ba.
import-trello-zip-progress: Ana shigo da alluna daga .zip, don Allah jira…
import-timeout: Shigowa ta ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo kuma an dakatar da ita. Don Allah sake gwadawa; idan yana maimaituwa, allon na iya yin girma sosai ko rumbun bayanai yana aiki sosai.
import-too-large: Fayil ɗin ya yi girma sosai don a shigo da shi lokaci guda. Raba shi zuwa ƙananan fayiloli, misali ta aiki ko ta kwanan wata, sannan ka shigo da kowanne.
import-trello-zip-read-failed: Ba a iya karanta .zip da aka ɗora ba.
import-trello-zip-too-large: Fayil ɗin .zip ya yi girma sosai don shigowa.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: Fayil ɗin .zip yana da fayiloli da yawa fiye da a iya shigowa.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Wani fayil cikin .zip ya yi girma sosai don shigowa.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: Fayil ɗin .zip yana ɗauke da hanyoyin fayil marasa aminci kuma an ƙi shi.
import-trello-workspace: Sunan wurin aiki na kai (na zaɓi)
import-attachment-auth-hint: Fitarwar tana ambaton abubuwan haɗawarta amma ba ta ɗauke da fayilolin ba. Don kawo su tare, ba da adireshin sabis da bayanan shiga: ana amfani da su don wannan shigo da kawai, ana aika su zuwa adireshin kawai, kuma ba a taɓa adana su ba. Bar shi babu komai don shigo da ba tare da fayilolin ba.
import-attachment-auth-token: Alamar API, maɓallin API ko kalmar sirrin manhaja
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Ana sanya allon da aka shigo da shi ƙarƙashin wannan wurin aiki, ana ƙirƙirarsa idan babu shi
import-trello-parent-workspace: Sanya wuraren aiki da aka shigo da su ƙarƙashin
trello-api-import: Shigo kai tsaye daga Trello da mabuɗin API da token
trello-api-import-desc: Liƙa mabuɗin API da token na Trello don jera wuraren aiki da allunan Trello, sannan shigo da zaɓaɓɓun tare da maƙalolinsu.
trello-api-token: Token API na Trello (an ƙirƙira da hannu a ƙasan mabuɗin API)
trello-api-credentials-required: Don Allah shigar da mabuɗin API da token na Trello duka.
trello-api-credentials-saved: An adana mabuɗin API da token na Trello. Za ka iya jera wuraren aiki ba tare da sake shigar da su ba.
trello-export-desc: Ƙirƙiri kwafin wannan allo a Trello ta API na Trello, tare da maɓallin API na Trello da token ɗinka. Layuka suna zama alamomi masu suna "Swimlane: …", waɗanda shigo da Trello na WeKan ke mayar da su layuka.
trello-export-warnings: Ba a iya fitar da komai ba
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Grain na Sandstorm ba shi da damar shiga Intanet na kansa. Ba wa wannan grain izinin isa Trello da farko.
sandstorm-trello-access-granted: Wannan grain zai iya isa Trello.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, don shigo da fitar da alluna
trello-select-boards: Don Allah zaɓi aƙalla allo ɗaya don shigowa.
trello-cancel-delete: Soke kuma share waɗanda aka shigo da su
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: A soke shigowar kuma a share allunan da wannan aikin ya riga ya shigo da su? Ba za a iya janye wannan ba.
trello-delete-imported: Share allunan da aka shigo da su
import-members-map: Allon da ka shigo da shi yana da wasu mambobi. Don Allah haɗa mambobin da kake son shigowa da masu amfani naka
import-members-map-note: Lura: Za a sanya mambobin da ba a haɗa ba ga mai amfani na yanzu.
import-user-select: Zaɓi mai amfani naka da ke akwai wanda kake son amfani da shi a matsayin wannan memba
invalid-year: Shekara mara inganci. Don Allah rubuta duk lambobi huɗu, misali 2026.
just-invited: Yanzu aka gayyace ka zuwa wannan allo
shared-labels-desc: Ana iya amfani da alamomin da aka ajiye a nan a kan alluna da yawa, tare da alamomin kowane allo na kansa. Sauya suna ko launin ɗaya a nan yana canza shi a kowane allo da ke amfani da shi; share ɗaya yana barin sa a kan waɗannan alluna a matsayin alamarsu ta kansu.
label-delete-pop: Babu janyewa. Wannan zai cire wannan lakabi daga duk katuna kuma ya lalata tarihinsa.
label-text-use-board-default: Yi amfani da tsohon saitin allo
last-admin-desc: Ba za ka iya sauya rawa ba domin dole a sami aƙalla mai gudanarwa ɗaya.
hide-board: Bar wannan allo: ɓoye shi daga Dukan alluna. Membobinka na tawaga ko ƙungiya yana nan, kuma Saitunan mamba / Alluna masu ɓoye suna dawo da shi.
board-label-name-includes: don alluna waɗanda sunansu ya ƙunshi
group-members-read-only: Masu gudanarwa na wannan rukuni ne kawai za su iya canza wanda ke cikinsa. Rukunin da ya fito daga LDAP ko wani kundin adireshi ana canza shi a can, ba a cikin WeKan ba.
leave-board-pop: Ka tabbata kana son barin __boardTitle__? Za a cire ka daga duk katunan wannan allo.
list-archive-cards: Matsar da duk katunan wannan jeri zuwa Taska
list-archive-cards-pop: Wannan zai cire duk katunan wannan jeri daga allo. Don ganin katunan da ke Taska da dawo da su allo, danna “Menu” > “Taska”.
listArchiveCardsPopup-title: Ajiye dukan katunan a matsayin tarihi?
list-move-cards: Matsar da duk katunan wannan jeri
list-delete-pop: Za a cire duk ayyuka daga jerin ayyuka kuma ba za ka iya dawo da jerin ba. Babu janyewa.
list-delete-suggest-archive: Za ka iya matsar da jeri zuwa Taska don cire shi daga allo tare da kiyaye ayyukan.
log-out-everywhere-confirm: Wannan zai fitar da kai daga kowane burauza, waya da manhaja inda ka shiga, har da wannan.
passkeys-description: Maɓallin shiga yana ba ka damar shiga da zanen yatsa, fuska, kullewar allo ko maɓallin tsaro na wannan na'ura maimakon kalmar sirrinka. Yana zama a na'urarka; WeKan yana ajiye maɓallinsa na jama'a kawai.
passkey-add: Ƙara maɓallin shiga a wannan na'ura

Shigowa tana karanta wannan JSON da aka liƙa a sama, daga WeKan ko daga GET /workflows na Wrike, zuwa allon da aka zaɓa: matsayin da ba shi da jeri yana zama jeri, kuma doka tana alamta kati a matsayin an kammala lokacin da aka matsar da shi zuwa matsayin Completed ko Cancelled kuma ba a kammala ba a matsayin Active ko Deferred. globalSearch-instructions-description: Bincike na iya ƙunsar masu aiki don takaita binciken. Ana bayyana masu aiki ta rubuta sunan mai aiki da ƙimarsa, waƙafi mai ɗigo ya raba su. Misali, bayanin mai aiki `jeri:An-toshe` zai takaita binciken zuwa katunan da ke cikin jeri mai suna *An-toshe*. Idan ƙimar tana da sarari ko haruffa na musamman dole a sanya ta cikin alamomin zance (misali `__operator_list__:"A Duba"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operators: Masu aiki da ake da su:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - katunan cikin allunan da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - katunan cikin jerin da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - katunan cikin layukan iyo da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - katunan da ke da sharhi mai ɗauke da *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - katunan da ke da alamar da ta dace da *<color>* ko *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* yake *mamba* ko *wanda aka sanya wa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-assig: `__operator_assignee__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* yake *wanda aka sanya wa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* shi ne mai ƙirƙirar katin
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - katunan da ke cikin allo da aka sanya wa ƙungiya *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - katunan da ke cikin allo da aka sanya wa tawaga *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - katunan da wa'adinsu zai yi cikin kwanaki *<n>* daga yanzu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ yana lissafa dukkan katunan da ranar ƙarewarsu ta wuce.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - katunan da aka ƙirƙira kwanaki *<n>* da suka wuce ko ƙasa da haka
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - katunan da aka gyara kwanaki *<n>* da suka wuce ko ƙasa da haka
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - inda *<status>* yake ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dukkan katunan da aka adana da waɗanda ba a adana ba
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - katunan da ke da ranar ƙarshe
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - katuna a alluna masu zaman kansu kawai
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - inda *<field>* yake ɗaya daga `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` ko `__predicate_member__`. Sanya `-` a gaban *<field>* yana binciken rashin ƙima a wannan fili (misali `has:-due` yana binciken katunan da ba su da ranar ƙarewa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - inda *<sort-name>* yake ɗaya daga `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` ko `__predicate_modified__`. Don jeri mai gangarowa, sanya `-` a gaban sunan jeri.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - inda *<n>* yake cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya da ke bayyana yawan katunan da za a nuna a kowane shafi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ana iya bayyana masu aiki da yawa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ana haɗa masu aiki iri ɗaya da *OR*. Za a dawo da katunan da suka dace da kowane ɗaya daga sharuɗɗan.
`__operator_list__:Akwai __operator_list__:An-toshe` zai dawo da katunan da ke cikin kowane jeri mai suna *An-toshe* ko *Akwai*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ana haɗa masu aiki mabambanta da *AND*. Katunan da suka dace da dukkan masu aikin mabambanta kawai ake dawo da su. `__operator_list__:Akwai __operator_label__:ja` yana dawo da katunan cikin jerin *Akwai* masu alamar *ja* kawai.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Ana iya bayyana kwanaki da cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya ko marar tabbas, ko ta amfani da `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` ko `__predicate_year__` don zangon yanzu.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Binciken rubutu ba ya bambanta manyan da ƙananan haruffa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: A tsoho ba a bincika katunan da aka adana.

database-migration-description: Ƙaura bayanan rubutu (komai ban da maƙaloli da hotunan fuska, waɗanda suke zama a tsarin fayil) tsakanin MongoDB da FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Dole ɗayan ma'ajiyar bayanan ta kasance tana aiki kuma ana iya isa gare ta (tashoshin asali: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; sauya da WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Bayan ya ƙare, nuna MONGO_URL zuwa ɗayan ma'ajiyar bayanan sannan sake kunna WeKan (a Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb ko =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Ƙaura bayanan rubutu zuwa FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: A kwafi dukkan tarin bayanan rubutu zuwa __db__? Ba a shafar maƙaloli da hotunan fuska da ke tsarin fayil. Dole ma'ajiyar bayanan makoma ta kasance tana aiki.
sandstorm-migration-description: Lokacin da WeKan yake aiki cikin grain na Sandstorm, ana ƙaura tsohuwar ma'ajiyar MongoDB 3 zuwa FerretDB v1 (SQLite) a farkon kunnawa, kuma ana matsar da maƙaloli da hotunan fuska daga ma'ajiyar bayanai zuwa kundin grain files/attachments da files/avatars. Wannan yana nuna ko ƙaurar ta yi nasara da yawan sararin faifai da tsoffin fayilolin MongoDB marasa sarrafawa suke amfani da shi cikin grain, kuma yana ba ka damar share waɗannan fayiloli don 'yantar da sarari.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Bayan ƙaura mai nasara bayanan suna FerretDB da tsarin fayil, don haka ana iya share tsoffin fayilolin ma'ajiyar MongoDB 3 marasa sarrafawa don 'yantar da sararin faifan grain. Ba za a iya warware wannan ba.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: A share fayilolin ma'ajiyar MongoDB 3 marasa sarrafawa don 'yantar da sararin faifai? An riga an ƙaura bayanan zuwa FerretDB da tsarin fayil. Ba za a iya warware wannan ba.

feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalanda da kalandar alluna da yawa.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ƙididdiga, haɗawa bisa wanda aka ba aiki, taswirar shiri, allon bayani da babban allo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nau'ukan duba jadawalin Gantt guda uku.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Jerin ayyukan samfur, zangunan aiki, rahoton zangon aiki da sauri.

card-field-visibility-desc: Filayen da ke cikin Saitunan allo / Kati waɗanda alluna za su iya nunawa. Filin da ba a yi masa alama ba yana ɓoyuwa daga duk katuna, ƙananan katuna da Saitunan allo / Kati na kowane allo. Bayanan kati da saitunan allo ba sa canzawa. Idan an sake yi masa alama, kowane allo zai bayyana bisa saitunansa na baya. Kowane allo yana da nasa tsarin jera filaye.
cards-loading-auto: Ta atomatik (jinkiri ga manyan alluna kawai)
cards-loading-lazy: A hankali (katunan da ake gani kawai)
cards-loading-description: WeKan yana loda katunan allo ta atomatik: babban allo (wanda ya wuce iyakar girma) yana loda katunan da ake gani a yanzu kawai (gungurawa marar iyaka) tare da ƙidaya kai tsaye, don ya ci gaba da sauri kuma ya yi amfani da ƙarancin ƙwaƙwalwa da bandwidth, yayin da ƙananan alluna suke loda kowane kati don mafi sauƙin gogewa mai cikakkun fasali. Babu abin saitawa. Masu gudanarwa har yanzu za su iya tilasta yanayi da CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) da canjin mahalli CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Loda katuna a hankali na gwaji ne: ƙidayar katuna da iyakokin WIP daidai ne, amma duban Kalanda/Tebur/Gantt da zaɓi da yawa suna nuna katunan da aka loda zuwa yanzu kawai. Sake loda allunan da suke buɗe bayan canza wannan.

render-links-as-plain-text-description: Idan an kunna, dukkan haɗe-haɗe (haɗin markdown kamar [alama](url) da alamar HTML <a href> kai tsaye) koyaushe ana nuna su a matsayin rubutu da ba za a iya dannawa ba a kowane filin rubutu mai tsari (taken allo da kati, bayanai, sharhi, jerin dubawa, da sauransu). Wannan yana hana haɗe-haɗe masu ruɗi da za a iya dannawa. A tsoho yana kashe, don haka ana iya danna haɗe-haɗe.
always-show-code-as-text: Koyaushe nuna dukkan lamba a matsayin rubutu
always-show-code-as-text-description: Idan an kunna, ba a taɓa nuna rubutu mai tsari a matsayin markdown ko HTML: koyaushe ana nuna dukkan tushe a matsayin rubutu kawai a kowane filin rubutu mai tsari (taken allo da kati, bayanai, sharhi, jerin dubawa, da sauransu). Wannan yana bayyana ɓoyayyen abu — sharhin HTML (<!-- -->), makomar haɗin markdown, JavaScript da kowace lamba — don haka dukkan lamba koyaushe a bayyane take, ba za a iya dannawa ba, kuma ba ta aiki. A tsoho yana kashe, don haka ana nuna markdown yadda aka saba.
disable-all-import-description: Idan an kunna, ana kashe dukkan fasalin shigo da kaya: shigo da allo daga WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea da Forgejo, da yin kwafin allo. Ana ɓoye zaɓuɓɓukan menu na shigo da kaya kuma saba tana ƙin kowace buƙatar shigo da kaya. A tsoho yana kashe.
import-max-megabytes-description: Mafi girman fayil da shafin Shigo da ke karɓa, a cikin megabytes. Idan babu komai, babu iyaka: fayil zai iya kai girman da sararin faifai da ya rage zai bari a gama shigo da shi. Ana rubuta kowace ɗorawa a faifan saba kashi-kashi, kuma ana ƙin shigo da da zai cika faifan.
import-disk-full: Babu isasshen sararin faifai a saba don wannan shigo da.
import-upload-not-found: Fayil ɗin da aka ɗora ba ya nan kuma. Sake zaɓen shi.
import-upload-failed: Ba a iya ɗora fayil ɗin ba.
disable-all-export-description: Idan an kunna, ana kashe dukkan fasalin fitar da kaya: fitar da allo a matsayin WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ko zuwa NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, da fitar da maƙala guda. Ana ɓoye zaɓuɓɓukan menu na fitar da kaya kuma saba tana ƙin kowace buƙatar fitar da kaya. A tsoho yana kashe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Idan an kunna, ba a taɓa shigo da hotunan fuska (hotunan bayanin mai amfani) ba. Wannan ya ƙunshi shigo da WeKan JSON, shigo da Trello, da daidaita hoton fuska daga masu ba da shaidar waje yayin shiga (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Har yanzu ana shigo da sunaye da sauran bayanai; hotunan fuska kawai ake tsallakewa. A tsoho yana kashe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Idan an kunna, ba a taɓa haɗa hotunan fuska (hotunan bayanin mai amfani) lokacin fitar da allo ba (fitarwar WeKan JSON da CSV). Har yanzu ana fitar da sunayen masu amfani da sauran bayanai; hotunan fuska kawai ake bari. A tsoho yana kashe.
anonymize-import-users: Ɓoye shaidar masu amfani da ake shigowa da su
anonymize-import-users-description: Idan an kunna, shigo da allon WeKan JSON yana maye gurbin sunan mai amfani, cikakken suna da baƙaƙen farkon kowane mai amfani da aka shigo da shi da madadin ƙidaya (user1, user2, ...), yana cire hoton fuskarsa, kuma yana sake rubuta ambaton @username (da filayen wanda-ya-nema / wanda-aka-sanya-wa) cikin abin katuna da sharhi da aka shigo da su. Ba a adana ainihin shaidar mai amfani daga allon tushe. Kalmar "mai-amfani" tana bin harshen mutumin da yake shigo da kaya. A tsoho yana kashe.
anonymize-export-users: Ɓoye shaidar masu amfani da ake fitarwa
anonymize-export-users-description: Idan an kunna, fitar da allo yana maye gurbin sunan mai amfani, cikakken suna da baƙaƙen farkon kowane mai amfani da aka fitar da madadin ƙidaya (user1, user2, ...), yana cire hoton fuskarsa, kuma yana sake rubuta ambaton @username (da filayen wanda-ya-nema / wanda-aka-sanya-wa) cikin abin kati da sharhi. Fayil ɗin da aka fitar ba ya ɗauke da ainihin shaidar mai amfani. Kalmar "mai-amfani" tana bin harshen mutumin da yake fitarwa. A tsoho yana kashe.
anonymize-account: Ɓoye shaidar masu amfani da ake shigowa da su
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Idan an kunna, fitar da allo yana maye gurbin sunan mai amfani, cikakken suna da baƙaƙen farkon kowane mai amfani da aka fitar da madadin ƙidaya (user1, user2, ...), yana cire hoton fuskarsa, kuma yana sake rubuta ambaton @username (da filayen wanda-ya-nema / wanda-aka-sanya-wa) cikin abin kati da sharhi. Fayil ɗin da aka fitar ba ya ɗauke da ainihin shaidar mai amfani. Kalmar "mai-amfani" tana bin harshen mutumin da yake fitarwa. A tsoho yana kashe.
disable-activities-description: Idan an kunna, ba a taɓa rubuta shigarwar tarihin aiki ko nuna su a ko'ina ba (mashigin gefen allo da shafin aikin kati). Ba a adana tarihin wanda ya yi me ba. A tsoho yana kashe.
disable-notifications-description: Idan an kunna, WeKan ba ya taɓa aika sanarwar kallo (cikin manhaja, imel ko wasu ayyuka) ga kowane aiki. Har yanzu ana iya rubuta ayyuka (sai idan an kashe su ma a sama); sanarwar kawai ake dannewa. A tsoho yana kashe.
disable-watch-description: Idan an kunna, ana kashe fasalin kallo — masu amfani ba za su iya biyan kuɗin alluna, jerin ko katuna don karɓar sanarwa ba, kuma ana ƙin kowane ƙoƙarin canza matakin kallo. A tsoho yana kashe.
backup-description: Yi madadin Maƙaloli, Hotunan fuska da/ko Bayanai (dukkan tarin bayanan rubutu waɗanda ba maƙaloli ko hotunan fuska ba). Ana watsa .zip kai tsaye zuwa ma'ajiyar da aka zaɓa — babu fayil na wucin gadi — a matsayin backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, mai ɗauke da YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars da /data. Ma'ajiyoyin girgije (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) suna amfani da bayanan shaidar da aka saita a shafukan ma'ajiyarsu.
backup-scope-description: Dukkan mahalli, ko Ƙungiya ɗaya. Madadin Ƙungiya yana ƙunsar allunanta da komai da ke kansu, har da maƙalolin waɗannan alluna — amma ba asusun masu amfani da saitunan mahalli ba, domin kowace Ƙungiya tana raba su. Dawo da madadin Ƙungiya yana rubutawa ne kawai ga allunan da wannan Ƙungiya ta mallaka.
theme-override-all-tenants: Sauyin jigo da ya shafi dukkan masu haya
continuous-backup-description: Yana aika kowane canji a ma'ajiyar bayanai, maƙaloli, hotunan fuska da rajistoci zuwa babban fayil cikin daƙiƙu kaɗan, don a iya dawo da yanayin kowane lokaci. Yana aiki tare da madadin da aka tsara lokacinsa, wanda ke ƙirƙirar cikakkun kundin adanawa.
continuous-backup-enabled: Gudanar da madadi mai ci gaba a wannan sabar
continuous-backup-target: Babban fayil na manufa (cikakkiyar hanya a wata faifai, wurin rabawa na hanyar sadarwa ko wurin da aka haɗa da rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Ba a sami ma’ajiyar bayanai ta WeKan da za a iya karantawa ba.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Shafukan SQLite (shafukan da suka canza a kowane tazara)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Babu injin ma'ajiyar bayanai da zai iya aiki a wannan sabar
continuous-backup-key-file: Fayil ɗin maɓallin ɓoye bayanai (cikakkiyar hanya a wajen babban fayil ɗin da aka nufa; haruffan tsarin lamba goma sha shida guda 64 ko jimlar sirri mai aƙalla haruffa 16). Ajiye kwafi: ba za a iya maido da madadin ba idan babu shi.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Babu wani wuri (babban fayil ɗin da aka nufa kawai)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Babban fayil a cikin kwandon ajiya
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Fayil ɗin gudanarwa na Litestream (cikakkiyar hanya)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fayil ɗin ma'ajiyar bayanai na SQLite (ana ƙirƙira shi kusa da madadin, ba a taɓa rubutawa a kan fayil ɗin da ake amfani da shi ba)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Yi amfani da ma'ajin bayanan SQLite da aka sake ginawa a sake farawa na gaba (za a adana ma'ajin bayanan da aka maye gurbinsa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: A mayar da zamanin da aka zaɓa zuwa yanayin lokacin da aka zaɓa? Madadi mai ci gaba zai tsaya na ɗan lokaci yayin da ake mayarwa.
continuous-backup-saved: An ajiye saitunan madadi mai ci gaba
backup-restore-add-missing: Ƙara bayanan da suka ɓace kawai
backup-restore-select-first: Fara da zaɓar madadi daga jeri.
backup-restore-confirm: A dawo da madadin da aka zaɓa? Ana rubuta maƙaloli/hotunan fuska zuwa tsarin fayil da bayanai zuwa ma'ajiyar bayanai bisa yanayin da aka zaɓa.
gcs-key-filename: Hanyar fayil ɗin maɓallin asusun sabis
gcs-key-filename-description: Na zaɓi: hanyar zuwa fayil ɗin maɓallin JSON na asusun sabis a saba.
gcs-credentials-description: Na zaɓi: liƙa maɓallin JSON na asusun sabis. Bar fanko don amfani da fayil ɗin maɓalli ko bayanan shaidar asali.
gcs-permissions-note: Ba asusun sabis na WeKan damar karantawa/rubutawa a bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket ɗinka → Permissions → Grant access. A cikin "New principals", liƙa imel ɗin asusun sabis — ƙimar "client_email" daga maɓallin JSON ɗinka — sannan zaɓi matsayin "Storage Object Admin" kuma ka Adana.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Bar fanko don riƙe ƙimar yanzu.
azure-container-description: Kwantena na blob da za a adana fayiloli a ciki.
gcs-project-id-description: ID na aikin Google Cloud ɗinka.
gcs-bucket-description: Sunan Cloud Storage bucket da za a adana fayiloli a ciki.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: bar fanko (yana amfani da ƙarshen yanki). Mai dacewa da S3: URL na Endpoint daga na'urar sarrafa MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces ɗinka.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket ɗinka → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sunan bucket ɗinka (ko Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mai amfani ɗinka → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → zaɓi yanayin amfani 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ana nuna shi a matsayin 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Allo ɗaya da Access key ID; ana nuna 'Secret access key' sau ɗaya kawai lokacin ƙirƙirar maɓallin — kwafe shi a lokacin (ko Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → asusunka → sunan da aka nuna a sama (har ila yau ƙarƙashin Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → asusunka → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → asusunka → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → asusunka → Data storage → Containers → kwantenarka (ko + Container don ƙirƙirar ɗaya).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → mai zaɓar aiki a sama → ID na aikinka (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sunan bucket ɗinka (ko Create don yin ɗaya).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Hanya a sabar WeKan zuwa fayil ɗin maɓallin JSON na asusun sabis da aka sauke (wanda aka ƙirƙira a ƙasa). Yi amfani da wannan KO liƙa JSON a filin da ke ƙasa.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → asusun sabis ɗinka → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (yana sauke fayil). Liƙa abin da ke cikinsa a nan, ko adana fayil ɗin sannan saita hanyarsa a sama.
cloud-settings-desc: Da WeKan a cikin Weddy, Cloud Panel yana ba da yankuna masu yawa na WeKan daga sabar guda ɗaya, kowanne da nasa bayanan. A Yankin Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin yana sarrafa yankunan da CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel na SuperAdmin ne kawai, a Yankin Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Da maɓallin CloudFlare API, yankin da zonensa ke cikin asusunka na CloudFlare yana samun rikodin DNS mai proxy da takardar shaidar CloudFlare Origin. Sauran yankuna suna samun takardar shaidar Let's Encrypt. Ana adana maɓallin a kan sabar kuma ba za a sake nuna shi ba.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Babu maɓallin CloudFlare API da aka adana: kowane yanki yana samun takardar shaidar Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Matsar da maƙala zuwa Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Matsar da maƙala zuwa Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Yi amfani da MongoDB GridFS don adana fayiloli
migration-pausing: Ana dakatar da ƙaurace-ƙaurace na ɗan lokaci...
migration-pause-failed: An kasa dakatar da ƙaurace-ƙaurace na ɗan lokaci
migration-paused: An dakatar da ƙaurace-ƙaurace na ɗan lokaci cikin nasara
migration-stop-confirm: Ka tabbata kana son tsayar da dukkan ƙaurace-ƙaurace?
migration-stopped: An tsayar da ƙaurace-ƙaurace cikin nasara
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Don a ga maƙaloli da hotunan fuska, matsar da su daga CollectionFS zuwa kowace ma'ajiya daban.
pause-all-migrations: Dakatar da dukkan ƙaurace-ƙaurace na ɗan lokaci
s3-access-key-description: Maɓallin samun AWS S3 don tantancewa
s3-bucket-description: Sunan bokitin S3 don ajiye fayiloli
s3-enabled-description: Yi amfani da AWS S3 ko MinIO don adana fayiloli
s3-endpoint-description: URL na ƙarshen hanyar S3 (misali s3.amazonaws.com ko minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Maɓallin sirrin AWS S3 don tantancewa
s3-secret-key-required: Ana buƙatar maɓallin sirri na S3
s3-settings-saved: An ajiye saitunan S3 cikin nasara
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Yi amfani da SSL/TLS don haɗin S3
writable-path: Hanyar da za a iya rubutawa
writable-path-description: Hanyar kundin tushe don adana fayiloli
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Yana yin cikakken bincike da gyare-gyare ga ingancin bayanan allo, ciki har da tsarin jerin, wuraren katuna da tsarin layin iyo.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Yana share jerin fanko masu maimaituwa cikin aminci. Yana cire jerin da ba su da katuna KAWAI kuma suke da wani jeri mai take ɗaya wanda yake ƙunshe da katuna.
lost-cards-list: Abubuwan da aka dawo da su
restore-lost-cards-migration: Dawo da katunan da suka ɓace
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Yana nemo da dawo da katuna da jerin da swimlaneId ko listId ya ɓace. Yana ƙirƙirar layin iyo 'Katunan da suka ɓace' don sake nuna dukkan abubuwan da suka ɓace.
restore-all-archived-migration: Dawo da dukkan waɗanda aka adana
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Yana dawo da dukkan layukan iyo, jerin da katunan da aka adana. Yana gyara swimlaneId ko listId da ya ɓace ta atomatik don nuna abubuwa.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Yana gano da gyara jerin da suka ɓace ko suka lalace cikin tsarin allo.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Yana sabunta URL na hotunan fuskar mambobin allo don amfani da ma'ajiyar baya daidai kuma yana gyara nunin hotunan fuska da suka lalace.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Yana sabunta dukkan URL na maƙalolin fayil a wannan allo don amfani da ma'ajiyar baya daidai kuma yana gyara nunin fayiloli da suka lalace.
migrations-admin-only: Masu gudanar da allo kawai za su iya gudanar da ƙaurace-ƙaurace
migrations-description: Gudanar da binciken ingancin bayanai da gyare-gyare ga wannan allo. Ana iya gudanar da kowace ƙaura ita kaɗai.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Wannan zai gudanar da cikakkiyar ƙaura don bincika da gyara ingancin bayanan allo. Wannan na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci. A ci gaba?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Wannan zai fara mayar da kowane jeri da aka raba zuwa jerin kowane layin iyo, sannan ya share jerin fanko da suke da wani jeri mai take ɗaya da ya ƙunshi katuna. Jerin fanko masu maimaituwa na gaske kawai za a cire. A ci gaba?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Wannan zai ƙirƙiri layin iyo 'Katunan da suka ɓace' kuma ya dawo da dukkan katuna da jerin da swimlaneId ko listId ya ɓace. Wannan yana shafar abubuwan da ba a adana ba kawai. A ci gaba?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Wannan zai dawo da DUKKAN layukan iyo, jerin da katunan da aka adana, ya sake nuna su. Za a gyara dukkan abubuwan da ID ya ɓace ta atomatik. Ba za a iya warware wannan cikin sauƙi ba. A ci gaba?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Wannan zai gano da gyara jerin da suka ɓace ko suka lalace cikin tsarin allo. A ci gaba?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Wannan zai sabunta URL na hotunan fuskar mambobin allo don amfani da ma'ajiyar baya daidai. A ci gaba?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Wannan zai sabunta dukkan URL na maƙalolin fayil a wannan allo don amfani da ma'ajiyar baya daidai. A ci gaba?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Babu layukan iyo, jerin ko katunan da suka ɓace da za a dawo da su
migration-progress-note: Da fatan a jira yayin da muke ƙaura allonka zuwa sabon tsari...
step-convert-shared-lists: Mayar da jerin da aka raba
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Tabbatar da jerin kowane layin iyo
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Tabbatar da layin iyo na katunan da suka ɓace
step-scan-users: Ana duba hotunan fuskar mambobin allo
step-scan-files: Ana duba maƙalolin fayil na allo
conversion-info-text: Ana yin wannan juyawa sau ɗaya ga kowane allo kuma yana inganta aiki. Za ka iya ci gaba da amfani da allon yadda aka saba.
converting-board-description: Ana juya tsarin allo don inganta aiki. Wannan na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci.
max-concurrent: Mafi yawan masu gudana lokaci guda
migration-batch-size-description: Yawan maƙalolin da za a sarrafa a kowane rukuni (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Dakatar da ƙaura na ɗan lokaci idan amfani da CPU ya wuce wannan kaso (10-90)
migration-info-text: Ana yin ƙaurar ma'ajiyar bayanai sau ɗaya kuma tana inganta aikin tsarin. Aikin yana ci gaba a bango ko da ka rufe burauzarka.
migration-resume-failed: An kasa ci gaba da ƙaura
migration-warning-text: Da fatan kada ka rufe burauzarka yayin ƙaura. Aikin zai ci gaba a bango amma yana iya ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin ya kammala.
monitoring-export-failed: An kasa fitar da bayanan sa ido
monitoring-refresh-failed: An kasa sabunta bayanan sa ido
pause-migration: Dakatar da ƙaura na ɗan lokaci
showChecklistAtMinicard: Nuna jerin dubawa a ƙaramin kati
unmigrated-boards: Allunan da ba a ƙaura ba
available-repositories: Ma'ajiyoyin lamba da ake da su
no-repositories: Ba a sami ma'ajiyoyin lamba ba
account-locked: An kulle asusu na ɗan lokaci saboda yawan gazawar ƙoƙarin shiga. Da fatan a sake gwadawa daga baya.
invalid-credentials: Sunan mai amfani ko kalmar sirri ba daidai ba ne
username-password-required: Ana buƙatar sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri
password-mismatch: Kalmomin sirri ba su dace ba
username-too-short: Dole sunan mai amfani ya kasance aƙalla haruffa 3
user-exists: Mai amfani ya riga ya kasance
account-created: An ƙirƙiri asusu! Yanzu za ka iya shiga.
problems-summary-help: Yi wa wuraren matsalar da ka duba alama, sannan danna Amince da gani don sake saita ƙidayar sabbin matsalolinsu.
problems-in-progress-help: Waɗannan ƙaurace-ƙaurace ko gyare-gyare suna gudana yanzu. Shiga na iya yin jinkiri, ko nuna "Dole ne a shiga" ko alamar jira ta "Ana lodawa, da fatan a jira", har sai sun ƙare kuma CPU ya sauka.
problems-none-in-progress: Babu ƙaurace-ƙaurace ko gyare-gyare da ke gudana.
data-health-checks-found: Binciken da suka gano wani abu: __found__ / __checks__
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: An gyara katuna __fixed__. Katuna __unfixable__ ba su da allo kuma ba za a iya gyara su ta atomatik ba.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: An maido da jerin abubuwa __restored__. Ba a iya maido da __remaining__ ba.
export-select-what-to-include: Zaɓi abin da za a haɗa:
export-card-details: Cikakkun bayanan kati (kowane kati kamar yadda yake a fitarwar kati)
import-here-instruction: Shigo da fitarwar WeKan (.json ko .zip) a nan:
import-not-wekan-export: Wannan fayil ba fitarwar WeKan ba ne
import-board-source: Shigo da allo (Trello, Jira, fitarwar WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-heading: An shigo da shi tare da gargadi
import-report-description: An ƙirƙiri allon, amma an kasa shigo da wasu sassan fayil ɗin. Ana ajiye wannan rahoton a Panel na Admin → Matsaloli → Farfaɗowa.
import-parts-instruction: Sassan da aka yi wa alama kawai ake shigowa da su. Ana amfani da wannan zaɓin lokacin fitarwa ma.
import-wekan-file: Shigo daga fayil ɗin fitarwa na .json ko .zip:

sum-of-number-fields: Jimlar filayen lambobin da aka keɓance da aka nuna a saman jerin

blockly-ZOOM_TO_FIT_ARIA_LABEL: Daidaita girman gani don komai ya shiga
r-blocks-help: Haɗa mai kunnawa guda ɗaya da aiki guda ɗaya. Ja tubala daga akwatin kayan aiki. Yi amfani da editan fom don ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka.
r-blocks-discard: A watsar da canje-canjen tubalan da ba a ajiye ba?
r-blocks-unavailable: Bayanan ƙa'ida ba su samuwa. Yi amfani da editan fom don duba wannan ƙa'ida.
r-blocks-invalid: Haɗa mai kunnawa guda ɗaya tak da aiki guda ɗaya tak. Cire tubalan da ba a haɗa ba ko waɗanda suka wuce kima kafin ajiye.
r-blocks-conflict: Wannan ƙa'ida ta canza yayin da kake gyarawa. Sake loda ƙa'idar da aka ajiye kafin ka ajiye.
r-blocks-permission: Ana buƙatar izinin mai gudanar da allo don gyara ƙa'idoji.
r-blocks-unsaved: Canje-canjen da ba a ajiye ba
r-blocks-reload: Sake loda ƙa'idar da aka ajiye
board-view-product-backlog: Jerin ayyukan samfur da ake jira
board-view-velocity: Adadin aikin da ake kammalawa a kowane zango
scrum-policy-dueComplete: An yi wa kati alamar kammalawa
scrum-policy-doneLists: Kati yana cikin jerin rukunin An kammala
scrum-rollover-sprint: Matsar da aikin da ba a kammala ba zuwa
scrum-product-backlog: Jerin ayyukan samfur da ake jira
scrum-edit-sprint: Ƙirƙiri ko gyara zangon aikin da aka tsara
scrum-capacity: Adadin aikin da za a iya yi
scrum-releases: Sigar da aka fitar da ƙarin sassan samfur
scrum-releases-select-help: Kati na iya kasancewa a saki da yawa. Riƙe Ctrl (Cmd a Mac) don zaɓar fiye da ɗaya; share su duka don cire katin daga kowane saki.
scrum-select-sprint: Zaɓi zangon aiki don ganin rahotonsa.
scrum-backlog-help: Jera ayyuka bisa matsayinsu a jerin ayyukan da ake jira. Sanya katuna a zangon aikin da aka tsara ko wanda ake yi yanzu.
scrum-backlog-rank: Matsayi a jerin ayyukan da ake jira
scrum-event-retrospective: Nazarin yadda zangon aiki ya gudana
scrum-committed: Aikin da aka ɗauki alƙawarin yi
scrum-added: An ƙara cikin ayyukan da za a yi
scrum-removed: An cire daga ayyukan da za a yi
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Babu hoton bayanan zangon aikin da aka rufe.
scrum-report-help: Rahotanni suna riƙe kiyasi daga hotunan bayanan zangon aiki. Ana ƙidaya kiyasin da ba a sani ba dabam; ba kiyasin sifili ba ne. Kwatanta adadin aikin da ake kammalawa a kowane zango kawai idan ma’aunin kiyasi da ƙa’idoji sun yi daidai.
scrum-total: Katuna __count__; kiyasi __estimate__; ba a sani ba __unknown__
scrum-unknown-estimate: Kiyasin da ba a sani ba
scrum-confirm-close: A rufe wannan zangon aiki kuma a ajiye sakamakonsa? Za a matsar da katunan da ba a kammala ba zuwa inda aka zaɓa.
scrum-confirm-cancel: A soke wannan zangon aiki? Katunansa za su ci gaba da kasancewa a cikinsa har sai an sake sanya su wani wuri.
scrum-partial-report: Rahoton wani ɓangare: katunan da aka sanya maka a yanzu kawai aka haɗa.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: Ba a iya dawo da manunin tushe ba: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Wannan zangon aiki ya ƙunshi wani ɓangare ne kawai na hoton bayanan asali.
scrum-resume-close: Ci gaba da rufe zangon aikin da aka katse
scrum-rollover-progress: Ana matsar da katunan zangon aiki gaba: __done__ daga __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Ana soke ko sake yin babban sauyi: __done__ daga __total__ layukan tarihi
scrum-history-job-failed: Soke ko sake yin babban sauyi ya tsaya. Danna soke ko sake yi kuma don ci gaba:
scrum-daily-observations: Ayyukan da aka tsara da waɗanda suka rage a kowace rana (abin da aka lura da shi)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Kowane ginshiƙi yana nuna abin lura na farko da aka rubuta a ranar UTC, a lokacin da aka nuna. Ana tsallake kwanakin da babu bayanai. Waɗannan bayanan lura ba sa rubuta kowane canji ko nuna jimillar ƙarshen rana. Kiyasin da ba a sani ba ba sifili ba ne. Yi amfani da aikin Fitarwa na wannan sashe don bayanan lura na yau da kullum; aikin Fitarwa na sandar kayan aiki yana fitar da sakamakon zangon aiki.
scrum-daily-truncated: Bayanan lura 366 na baya-bayan nan kawai ake nunawa.
scrum-daily-empty: Ba a rubuta bayanan lura na yau da kullum don wannan zangon aiki ba.
scrum-scope-history: Faɗin aiki da aikin da ya rage, sauyi bayan sauyi
scrum-scope-history-help: An sake ginawa daga tarihin allo tun farkon zangon aiki: layi ɗaya ga kowane sauyi a katunan zangon, kimantawa ko aikin da aka kammala.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Tarihin bai sake samar da hoton halin wannan zangon aiki ba: an yi wasu sauye-sauye ba tare da rubuta su a tarihi ba, don haka waɗannan ƙimomi ba su cika ba.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Sauye-sauyen farko kawai aka iya karantawa; sake ginin bai cika ba.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Babu sauye-sauye tun farkon zangon aiki.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: An sauya kasancewa cikin zangon aiki
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: An adana kati a ma’ajiyar tarihi ko an dawo da shi
scrum-observed-scope: Ayyukan da aka tsara da aka lura da su
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Abin lura na farko da aka rubuta a kowace ranar UTC; ana tsallake kwanakin da babu bayanai. Bayanan lura ba sa rubuta kowane canji ko jimillar ƙarshen rana. Kiyasin da ba a sani ba ba sifili ba ne.
scrum-import-pending: Shigo da bayanan Scrum bai kammala ba. Ba a samun damar gyaran Scrum da fitar da rahotanni.
scrum-import-discard: Soke shigo da bayanan da bai ƙare ba
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Ana iya kammala shigo da bayanan da sake kunnawa ya katse a nan bayan ya tsaya. Idan ba a taɓa adana shirinsa gaba ɗaya ba, sokewa kawai za a iya yi; wannan ba ya canza kome a kan allo.
scrum-import-into-board: Shigo da tsarin Scrum cikin wannan allo
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Zaɓi fitarwar allon WeKan ko fayil ɗin canja wurin Scrum. Sprint da saki da wannan allo ya riga yana da su ana haɗa su, ba a taɓa ninka su ba. Ana daidaita katuna ta ID, ko ta lambar kati da take; katunan da ba su dace ba ana lissafa su kuma a bar su ba tare da canji ba. Yi samfoti da farko don ganin abin da zai canza.
scrum-import-invalid-file: Wannan fayil ba JSON mai inganci ba ne.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprint: __created__ sababbi, __matched__ sun riga sun kasance a wannan allo, __skipped__ ba a shigo da su ba
scrum-import-preview-releases: Saki: __created__ sababbi, __matched__ sun riga sun kasance a wannan allo, __skipped__ ba a shigo da su ba
scrum-import-preview-cards: Katuna: __updated__ za a sabunta, __unchanged__ ba a canza ba, __unmatched__ ba su dace ba
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Babu abin da za a canza: wannan allo ya riga yana da wannan tsari.
scrum-import-into-board-done: An shigo da tsarin Scrum kuma an rubuta shi a Tarihi.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Ba a sami wani kati a wannan allo ba: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Wani kati ya dace da kati fiye da ɗaya a wannan allo: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Wani kati na wani allo ne kuma an bar shi ba tare da canji ba: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Wani sprint ko saki ya dace da fiye da ɗaya a wannan allo: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Ba a iya shigo da wani sprint, saki ko taron ba: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Ba a matsar da wani kati cikin sprint da ya ƙare ba: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Zaɓi ƙima ga kowane saɓani. Ana sake ƙoƙarin daidaita bayanai bayan kowane zaɓi. Ba a aika komai zuwa tsarin tushe.
sync-conflict-refresh: Sake gudanar da daidaita bayanai don duba ƙimomin yanzu.
sync-conflict-review-complete: An duba katunan da aka sanya maka. Babu saɓanin filaye da ya rage. Ba a gudanar da daidaita bayanai ga dukan jerin ba.
sync-conflict-keep-mapping: Za a ci gaba da daidaita bayanan wannan kati
sync-conflict-detach: Riƙe maimaitaccen kati a matsayin kati na gida
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Cire alaƙar daidaita bayanai ta wannan maimaitaccen kati kawai. Abubuwan da ke cikinsa za su kasance a WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Katunan ƙasa masu aiki sun hana matsarwa zuwa ma’ajiya
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Abin da ke tushen ya ɓace, amma katunan ƙasa masu aiki suna hana matsarwa zuwa ma’ajiya. Riƙe wannan kati a gida ta cire alaƙar daidaita bayanansa. Ba a canza katunan ƙasa.
sync-conflict-creation: Ƙirƙiri katin daidaita bayanai na maye gurbi
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Bar katin da ya gabata ba tare da canji ba kuma ƙirƙiri sabon katin daidaita bayanai a wannan jeri. Sake gwadawa zai yi amfani da katin maye gurbin.
sync-preview-saved: Bisa saitunan da aka ajiye. Daidaita yanzu yana sake samo tushe da duba shi.
sync-preview-unavailable: Ajiye tushen daidaita bayanai kafin neman duban farko.
sync-preview-blocked: Warware saɓanin da ke ƙasa kafin duba shirin canje-canje.
sync-preview-omissions: Filayen da ba a daidaita bayanansu ba
sync-preview-scope: Ƙidayar tana nufin filayen tushe da aka daidaita tsarin su. Mai fassara tsarin bayanan tushe na iya tsallake ƙarin bayanai.
sync-preview-excluded: An ware ta zaɓin filayen da aka ajiye
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Abubuwan da mai fassara tsarin bayanai ya bayar da rahoton tsallakewa
sync-source-heading: Filayen tushe da ba a kwafa kai tsaye ba
sync-source-scope: Hanyoyi suna haɗa yawan bayyanar filaye a abubuwan tushe. Ana bayar da rahoton abubuwan da ba su da alaƙa gaba ɗaya; ba a nuna ƙimominsu.
sync-source-excluded: An ware ta zaɓin filayen da aka ajiye
sync-source-converted: An canza zuwa rubutu ko wani tsarin wakilci
sync-source-fallback: Madadin ƙimar da mai fassara tsarin bayanai bai yi amfani da ita ba
sync-source-excluded-item: Abin da mai fassara tsarin bayanai ya ware
sync-source-occurrences: Yawan bayyanar filaye ko abubuwan da aka bayar da rahoto
sync-source-truncated: An iyakance rahoton zuwa hanyoyi 100 da sunayen filaye da aka taƙaita.
sync-source-omitted: Ƙarin bayyanar abubuwa a wajen hanyoyin da aka nuna
sync-report-button: Gudanar da daidaita bayanai na baya-bayan nan
sync-report-retention: Gudanarwa 20 na baya-bayan nan. Ana riƙe rahotanni na kwanaki 30.
sync-report-partial: Gudanarwar da ta gaza ko ba ta kammala ba na iya canza wasu katuna. Waɗannan rahotanni ba sa ci gaba da gudanarwa ko soke ta.
sync-report-unfinished: Ana yi ko an katse; ba a rubuta sakamako ba
sync-report-failed: Ya gaza; wasu canje-canje na iya faruwa
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: An kammala tare da tsallake ko canza wasu filaye
sync-report-unavailable: Rahotannin gudanarwa suna buƙatar damar rubutawa ga dukan jeri da sabar da take samuwa.
sync-report-empty: Babu gudanar da daidaita bayanai da aka rubuta.
sync-recovery-heading: Binciken matsalolin gudanar da daidaita bayanai
sync-recovery-description: Rahotannin daidaita bayanai da aka riƙe daga kwanaki 30 da suka gabata. Nema da ID na allo ko jeri. Sakamakon da bai kammala ba na iya kasancewa yana gudana ko an katse shi. Sabunta don sake dubawa; waɗannan rahotanni ba za su iya ci gaba da canje-canje ko soke su ba.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Ba a iya karanta binciken matsalolin daidaita bayanai ba. Duba damar mai gudanarwa da samuwar sabar.
sync-estimate-field: Filin kiyasin Jira da aka haɗa
sync-estimate-field-hint: Zaɓi filin lamba mai ID na filin Jira da ma’aunin kiyasi, kamar wanda aka ƙirƙira ta shigo da Jira tare da haɗa filaye. Ana duba canje-canjen gida a matsayin saɓani. Ana ƙyale ƙimomin tushe da ba su nan; ƙimar null da aka bayyana a sarari tana goge ƙimar da aka haɗa.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Ana rubuta nauyi ko kimantawar lokaci ta GitLab a filin lamba da ka zaɓa. Ana duba sauye-sauyen cikin gida a matsayin saɓani; batun da ba shi da nauyi yana goge ƙimar da aka haɗa.
email-recovery-description: Layi ɗaya ga kowane mai karɓa. Nema da ID na mai amfani. Ba a haɗa abubuwan saƙo da filayen imel na mai karɓa ba. Dakatarwa tana riƙe saƙonnin yanzu da na gaba; Ci gaba yana sake gwada saƙonnin da ke jira yanzu. Sokewa tana cire saƙonnin da aka sa a jira har zuwa lokacin buƙatar. Idan ana aikawa, sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba. Ba za a iya janye saƙon da ake aikawa ba, kuma ana iya maimaita isarwar da ba a tabbatar da ita ba. Rashin nasara na dindindin da ƙoƙarin da ya kai iyakar sake gwadawa suna nan don dubawa. Sake gwada saƙonnin da suka gaza yana fara sabon zagayen ƙoƙari kuma yana kiyaye dakatarwar da take akwai.
email-recovery-changed: Canji na ƙarshe da mai gudanarwa ya yi
email-recovery-pause: Dakatar da isarwa na ɗan lokaci
email-recovery-empty: Babu saƙonnin da ke jira ko masu karɓa da aka dakatar.
email-recovery-unavailable: Ba a iya karanta jerin jiran imel ba. Duba damar mai gudanarwa da samuwar sabar.
email-recovery-busy: Ana isarwa ko gudanar da wani aiki a jerin jira. Sabunta kuma sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
email-recovery-failed: Ba a iya tabbatar da aikin ba. Sabunta jerin jira kuma sake gwada aikin ɗaya idan ya zama dole.
email-recovery-superseded: Wani sabon aikin mai gudanarwa ya maye gurbin wannan buƙatar. Ana nuna matsayin jerin jira na yanzu.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: A soke duk saƙonnin da ke jira yanzu ga wannan mai karɓa? Za a cire abubuwan da ke cikinsu kuma ba za a iya dawo da su ba. Za a riƙe sabbin saƙonnin da aka ƙirƙira bayan wannan buƙatar.
email-recovery-retry: Sake gwada saƙonnin da suka gaza
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Ƙin karɓar SMTP na ɗan lokaci
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Tabbatar da shaidar imel yana buƙatar kulawa
