email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Mai karɓa ba ya samuwa ko an kashe asusunsa
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ba a iya tabbatar da isarwa ba; duba kafin sake gwadawa
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Ba a iya ajiye shaidar isarwa ba
sync-time-estimate-hint: Kiyasin lokaci yana amfani da filayen lambobi na lokacin asali da lokacin da ya rage waɗanda shigo da Jira ya ƙirƙira. Dole ne filin da ya dace guda ɗaya tak ya kasance a wannan allo. Ana duba gyaran gida a matsayin saɓani; ana ƙyale ƙimomin tushe da ba su nan kuma ƙimar null da aka bayyana a sarari tana goge ƙimar.
sync-planning-hint: Ana daidaita sprint da saki ne kawai yayin da aka kunna Scrum a wannan allo. Sprint ko saki da ya ɓace ana ƙirƙirar shi a wannan allo, tare da kwanakin da tushen ya bayar; wanda ke akwai ana daidaita shi ta ID ɗin tushensa da farko, sannan ta suna. Canjin tsari na gida yana nan har sai tushen ya canza tsarin wannan batu, kuma Sync na farko ba ya taɓa cire tsari.
activity-recovery-description: Ana sake gwada sanarwar da ba su kammala ba ta atomatik. Duba ayyukan da suka ɓace ko suka canza kafin sake gwadawa. Sake gwadawa ba ya sake ƙirƙirar aiki.
activity-recovery-empty: Babu sanarwar ayyukan da ke jira.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Ba a iya loda sanarwar ayyukan da ke jira ba.
activity-recovery-status-processing: An keɓe isarwa ga mai aiwatarwa
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Bayanan dawo da aiki ba su inganta ba
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Shirin da aikin da ke jira ba su dace ba
activity-recovery-busy: Wani mai aiwatarwa yana kula da wannan sanarwar. Sabunta kuma sake gwadawa.
activity-recovery-denied: Damar mai karɓa ko zaɓin sanarwarsa ba su ƙara ba da izinin isarwa ba.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Aikin asali ya ɓace ko ya canza. Ba a sake ƙirƙirar komai ba.
activity-recovery-failed: Ba a iya kammala isar da sanarwa ba. An riƙe aikin da ke jira.
activity-recovery-pause: Dakatar da isarwa na ɗan lokaci
activity-recovery-paused: An dakatar da isar da sanarwar ayyuka na ɗan lokaci.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Wannan sanarwar ta canza tun lokacin da aka loda ta. Duba matsayin da aka sabunta kafin sake gwadawa.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ba a iya tabbatar da saitin isarwa ba. Sabunta kuma duba matsayinsa na yanzu.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: An soke isar da sanarwar aiki.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: A soke ragowar isarwar wannan aiki har abada? Ba za a iya ci gaba da ita ba. Ba a janye imel ɗin da ke jira da sanarwar da aka riga aka isar.
rule-email-recovery-description: Duba ƙoƙarin imel na ƙa’ida da aka rubuta. Ƙoƙarin da ba a tabbatar ba na iya kasancewa yana aikawa ko an katse shi. Buɗe ɗaya da "Duba" don sake aika shi, yi alamar an aika ko cire shi.
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Bayanan ƙoƙari ba su inganta ba
rule-email-recovery-empty: Babu ƙoƙarin imel na ƙa’ida da ya dace da wannan nema.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ba a iya loda ƙoƙarin imel na ƙa’ida ba. Sabunta don sake gwadawa.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ba ya sake aika imel da ba a tabbatar ba da kansa. Sake aikawa yana zuwa ne kawai ga masu karɓa da ba a tabbatar ba. Yi masa alamar an aika idan ka san ya isa, ko ka cire shi.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Aikawar farko tana iya ci gaba har yanzu. Za ka iya yanke shawara bayan __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Sake aika wa masu karɓa da ba a tabbatar ba
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: A sake aika wannan imel ga masu karɓa da ba a tabbatar ba? Duk wanda sabar imel ɗinsa ta karɓa ba tare da sanar da WeKan ba zai karɓe shi sau biyu.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: A yi wa wannan imel alamar an aika wa kowa? Yi haka ne kawai idan ka san ya isa.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: A cire wannan imel? Ba za a aika shi ga masu karɓa da ba a tabbatar ba.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Aikawar farko tana iya ci gaba har yanzu. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: An riga an yanke shawara kan wannan imel.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Sake aikawa da aka fara a baya yana iya ci gaba har yanzu. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: An riga an tabbatar da kowane mai karɓa. Maimakon haka, yi alamar an aika.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Sabar imel ba ta amsa ba. Imel ɗin da aka sake aikawa yana iya isa ko bai isa ba; ana nuna cewa yana ci gaba.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Wani mai gudanarwa yana yanke shawara kan wannan imel. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imel ɗin da aka adana bai ƙara dacewa da wannan yunƙurin ba, don haka ba za a iya yanke shawara a kansa a nan ba.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Bayanan wannan yunƙurin da aka adana ba su da inganci, don haka ba za a iya yanke shawara a kansa a nan ba.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ba a iya yanke shawara kan wannan imel ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa
rule-email-legacy-description: Wata tsohuwar sigar WeKan ce ta shirya waɗannan imel na ƙa'idoji ba tare da rubuta inda abubuwan da ke cikinsu suka fito ba, don haka WeKan ba zai aika su da kansa ba. Bayan ka tabbatar cewa marubucin ƙa'idar har yanzu yana da damar shiga, sake haɗa imel domin a sake shirya shi daga halin katin na yanzu, ko ka watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: A sake shirya wannan imel daga halin katin na yanzu? Abubuwan da ke cikinsa na iya bambanta da waɗanda aka shirya a baya.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: A watsar da wannan imel? Ba za a taɓa aika shi ba.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Babu imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ba a iya loda imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa ba. Sabunta shafin don sake gwadawa.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Marubucin ƙa'idar ba shi da damar shiga wannan kati yanzu, ko ƙa'idar ta canza, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa imel ɗin ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Aikin da ya jawo wannan imel ya canza, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Katin da wannan imel ya fito daga gare shi ba ya samuwa yanzu, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ba a ƙara adana bayanan gudanar da ƙa'idar da ta shirya wannan imel ba, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: An riga an aika wannan imel, an yi yunƙurin aikawa ko an watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: An riga an sake haɗa wannan imel.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ba a iya kammala wannan aiki ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ayyukan List Sync da ba za a iya maimaitawa ba
stuck-sync-operation-description: Kowanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan List Sync da aka ajiye ya tsaya a tsakiya kuma ba za a iya kammala shi ba kuma, saboda an cire jerinsa, an sake ƙirƙira shi ko an sake saita shi, ko mai amfani da ya fara shi ya rasa damar rubutu. Yayin da ɗaya ke jiran, wannan jerin ba zai iya Sync ba. Watsar da shi don jerin ya sake Sync: canje-canjen da aka riga aka yi suna nan, sauran canje-canjen da aka ajiye ba za a taɓa rubuta su ba, kuma Sync na gaba yana sake kwatanta jerin da tushensa.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: An cire jerin, an sake ƙirƙira shi ko saitunan Sync ɗinsa sun canza
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Mai amfani da ya fara shi ba shi da damar rubutu ga dukkan jerin kuma
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Wani tsohon sigar WeKan ne ya ajiye shi ba tare da abin da ya fara shi ba
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Bayanin wanda ya fara shi ya ɓace
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: Ba a iya duba shi yanzu ba
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Za a iya sake maimaita shi yanzu kuma zai kammala da kansa, don haka ba za a iya watsar da shi ba.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: A watsar da wannan aikin List Sync da aka ajiye? Canje-canjen da ya riga ya yi suna nan; sauran ba za a taɓa rubuta su ba. Sannan jerin zai iya sake Sync.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Babu ayyukan List Sync da ke jiran dubawa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Mafi tsofaffi 50 kawai ake nunawa. Watsar da wasu kuma sabunta don ganin ƙari.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ba a iya loda ayyukan List Sync ba. Sabunta don sake gwadawa.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Wannan aiki ba ya jira kuma.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Ba a gano wannan aiki ya makale ba, don haka ba za a iya watsar da shi ba.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Za a iya sake maimaita wannan aiki yanzu kuma zai kammala da kansa, don haka ba a watsar da shi ba.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Wannan jerin yana Sync yanzu. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ba a iya kammala wannan aiki ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
interrupted-import-heading: Shigo da alluna da suka tsaya kafin su kammala
interrupted-import-description: Kowanne daga cikin waɗannan shigo da alluna ya tsaya a tsakiya - sabar ta sake farawa, ko shigowar ta kasa - kuma ya bar allo da bai cika ba. Ba za a iya ci gaba da shigowa ba, saboda ba a ajiye fayil ɗin tushensa ba. Bar allon yadda yake, ko watsar da shi kuma sake shigo da fayil ɗin. Watsarwa tana cire allon da wannan shigowa ta ƙirƙira da duk abin da ke kansa, har da duk abin da aka ƙara masa tun daga lokacin.
interrupted-import-created: Abin da aka ƙirƙira zuwa yanzu
interrupted-import-state-stopped: Ya tsaya ba tare da kammalawa ba, a __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Ana watsarwa; sake watsarwa don kammalawa
interrupted-import-scrum: Matakin Scrum ɗinsa yana da wurin dubawa na kansa (__state__, __next__ daga matakai __total__). Idan ka bar allon, kammala ko watsar da shi daga dawo da shigo da Scrum na allon.
interrupted-import-counts: layuka __swimlanes__, jerin abubuwa __lists__, katuna __cards__, jerin dubawa __checklists__, sharhuna __comments__, abubuwan haɗawa __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: A bar wannan allo da bai cika ba yadda yake? Ba a cire komai ba, kuma ba za a ƙara lissafa shigowar a nan ba.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: A watsar da wannan shigowa? Za a cire allon da ya ƙirƙira da duk abin da ke kansa har abada.
interrupted-import-empty: Babu shigo da alluna da aka katse da ke jiran dubawa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Mafi tsofaffi 50 kawai ake nunawa. Bar ko watsar da wasu kuma sabunta don ganin ƙari.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ba a iya loda shigo da alluna da aka katse ba. Sabunta don sake gwadawa.
interrupted-import-missing: Ba a rubuta wannan shigowa kuma.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Wannan shigowa ba ta jiran yanke shawara kuma.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ba wannan shigowa ce ta ƙirƙiri allon da ke da wannan id ba, don haka ba a taɓa shi ba.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Ana ci gaba da rubuta ko dawo da matakin Scrum ɗinsa. Sake gwadawa bayan 'yan mintuna.
interrupted-import-failed: Ba a iya kammala wannan aiki ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
saml-login-not-started: Ba a fara wannan shiga ta SAML a wannan shafin burauzar ba. Da fatan za a sake shiga.
history-request-pending-undo: Sabar ba ta tabbatar da sokewar canjinka na ƙarshe ba tukuna.
history-request-pending-redo: Sabar ba ta tabbatar da sake aiwatar da canjinka na ƙarshe ba tukuna.
history-request-hint: Sake gwadawa yana maimaita buƙatar ɗaya, don haka ba zai taɓa soke canji na biyu ba.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Sokewa, maimaitawa ko maido da canje-canjen Scrum ya tsaya a kan rikici. An toshe gyare-gyaren Scrum a wannan allo har sai an warware shi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: An rubuta canje-canje __applied__ daga __total__, ba a rubuta __pending__ ba, kuma wani ya canza __conflicted__ tun daga lokacin.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Mayarwa baya tana mayar da kowane bayanin da aka canza yadda yake a da; ana bayar da ita ne kawai idan babu wani da ya canza waɗannan bayanai tun daga lokacin. Barin allon yadda yake yana cire aikin da ya tsaya kuma ba ya canza wani bayani. Ko ta yaya, ana rubuta shi a Panel na Admin, Matsaloli, Dawowa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: A bar kowane bayani yadda yake yanzu, har da canje-canjen da aikin da ya tsaya ya riga ya rubuta?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Mai gudanar da allo zai iya mayar da shi baya ko ya bar allon yadda yake.
login-setting-clear-secret: Cire ƙimar da aka adana a panel na admin
login-setting-after-restart: Zai fara aiki bayan an sake kunna WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Yanayin sabar ne kawai ke saita waɗannan. Ana nuna su a nan don karatu kawai.
email-to-card-description: Imel da aka aika zuwa adireshin allonka yana zama kati a kan wannan allo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL na webhook mai shigowa na mai ba da sabis na imel (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark ko mai isar da MIME kai tsaye)
email-to-card-secret-saved: An ajiye - bar shi babu komai don a riƙe shi
email-to-card-clear-secret: Cire sirrin webhook da aka ajiye
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Akwatunan imel na IMAP da za a karanta
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Allon da imel zuwa wannan grain ke zuwa
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Babu - sai imel masu alamar allo a cikin take kawai
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Saka wannan a cikin take don isa wannan allo da sunanka:
email-to-card-parts: Sassan imel da za a yi amfani da su
email-to-card-part-description: Jikin imel a matsayin bayanin kati
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Bar saƙonnin baya da aka nakalto
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Layin mai aikawa a saman bayanin
email-to-card-your-address: Adireshin imel ɗinka na wannan allo
email-to-card-address-private: Ka riƙe shi a ɓoye: duk wanda ke da shi zai iya ƙara katuna da sunanka.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Ba a saita karɓar imel a cikin Panel na Admin ba.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Wani admin na allo bai kunna imel ga wannan allo ba.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Ka kashe adiresoshin allonka a cikin Saitunan Memba.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ɗin bai sami adireshin imel ɗinsa ba tukuna. Sake loda shafin.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Kana buƙatar izinin rubutu a wannan allo.
inbound-domain-invalid: Wannan ba ingantaccen sunan yanki ba ne.
inbound-account-invalid: Akwatin imel na IMAP yana buƙatar ingantaccen sunan sabar.
feature-views-email-desc: Allon a matsayin akwatin wasiku: jerin imel shine Akwatin shiga, jeri manyan fayiloli ne, alamomi alamomi ne, kuma mambobi suna rubutawa da amsa imel daga adireshin allon.
email-view-not-receiving: Wannan allo bai karɓar imel tukuna. Kunna shi a Saitunan Sanarwa na allon → Imel zuwa kati.
email-view-invalid-address: Ɗaya daga cikin adiresoshin ba ingantaccen adireshin imel ba ne.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Mafi yawa masu karɓa 20 a kowane saƙo.
email-view-too-many: An aika imel da yawa a cikin awa ta ƙarshe. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
email-view-no-list: Allon yana buƙatar jeri don imel.
email-view-send-failed: Ba a iya aika imel ɗin ba.
feature-views-chat-desc: Allon a matsayin wurin hira: wuraren aiki, allunan, layuka, jeri da katuna a matsayin bishiyar tashoshi, katin a tsakiya kuma sharhunansa a matsayin saƙonnin hira.
chat-view-pick-card: Zaɓi kati daga tashoshi don ganinsa a nan.
chat-view-no-messages: Babu saƙonni tukuna. Rubuta na farko.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Katunan iri ɗaya a cikin rukunan ginshiƙai da yawa masu suna - bisa kammalawa, fifiko, muhimmin mataki ko wani abu dabam - ana motsa su tsakanin ginshiƙai ta hanyar ja.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu na allo → Dokoki suna ba da shawarar dokoki daga abin da mutane ke yi da hannu akai-akai.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu na allo → Taƙaitawa yana nuna abin da kowa ya yi a kan allo a rana ko mako na ƙarshe, da abin da ya wuce lokaci.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu na allo → Tun ziyararka ta ƙarshe yana nuna abin da wasu suka canza a kan allo.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Neman duka yana fahimtar jumloli kamar "katunana da suka wuce lokaci" yana mai da su masu aiki.
column-sets-empty: Babu rukunin ginshiƙai tukuna. Mai gudanarwa na allo zai iya ƙirƙirar ɗaya: ba shi suna, sannan ka ƙara ginshiƙansa.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Allon a matsayin mai bin diddigin batutuwa na GitHub ko Gitea: katuna a matsayin batutuwa, alamomi da matakai, sharhi a matsayin tattaunawa, haɗe-haɗe a matsayin fayiloli, da tarihin allo tare da sokewa.
vcs-no-issues: Babu batun da ya dace da wannan bincike.
vcs-no-milestones: Babu matakai tukuna. Alama mai ranar ƙarshe mataki ne.
vcs-no-description: Ba a ba da bayani ba.
vcs-issue-title-too-long: Take ya yi tsayi da yawa.
vcs-issue-body-too-long: Bayani ya yi tsayi da yawa.
vcs-no-list: Wannan allon ba shi da jeri ko layi don batun.
card-qr-code-desc: Duba shi don buɗe wannan kati a waya ko kwamfutar hannu.
card-qr-code-too-long: Mahaɗin wannan kati ya yi tsayi da yawa don lambar QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Babu wiki tukuna. Shigo da ƙungiyar GitHub yana kawo wiki na ma'ajiya nan.
github-org-import-desc: Kowace ma'ajiya ta ƙungiya ko mai amfani tana zama allonta na kanta, wanda ake buɗewa a Board View / Version Control: batutuwanta tare da sharhinsu, alamominsu da fayilolinsu, fitowarta, ayyukan GitHub Actions ɗinta a matsayin Dokoki, da wiki ɗinta.
github-org-import-token-hint: Ana buƙata don ma'ajiyoyi masu zaman kansu da iyakar API mafi girma. Ana amfani da shi ne kawai yayin da shigo da yake gudana kuma ba a taɓa ajiye shi ba.
github-org-import-issues: Batutuwa, tare da sharhi, alamomi da fayiloli
github-org-import-actions: Ayyukan GitHub Actions a matsayin Dokoki
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Rubuta sunan ƙungiya ko mai amfani, ko adireshin GitHub ɗinsa.
github-org-import-no-repos: Babu ma'ajiyoyin da za a shigo da su.
github-org-import-running: Ana gudanar da shigo da ƙungiya tuni.
optional-apis-desc: API na REST masu siffar API na sauran masu bin diddigi, domin manhajojinsu da rubutun umarninsu su iya amfani da wannan WeKan a matsayin bayan fagensu: abin da suka adana ana ajiye shi a cikin WeKan, a kan allunan WeKan. Kowanne a kashe yake har sai an yi masa alama a nan. Babu ɗayansu da ke da nasa haƙƙoƙi: abokin hulɗa yana shiga da tokin API na WeKan kuma zai iya gani da canza abin da wannan mutumin zai iya gani da canzawa a cikin WeKan kawai. Dukansu suna buƙatar REST API na WeKan ya kasance a kunne (WITH_API=true). Adireshin da ke ƙarƙashin kowanne shi ne abin da abokin hulɗa ke amfani da shi a matsayin sabar sa.
optional-api-trello-desc: Manhajoji da rubutun umarni da aka rubuta don REST API na Trello (misali Trellinator) suna aiki da WeKan: alluna, jeri, katuna, alamomi, mambobi, sharhuna da jerin dubawa. Tokin Trello tokin API ne na WeKan. Share kati yana matsar da shi zuwa ma'ajiya a cikin WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Abokan hulɗa na REST API v2 na Jira suna aiki da WeKan: shiri allo ne (mabuɗinsa shi ne mabuɗin allon), batu kati ne (DEV-7), matsayi jeri ne, kuma sauyi yana matsar da katin. Bincike yana karɓar JQL mai sauƙi: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text da ORDER BY. Shiga da tokin API na WeKan a matsayin kalmar sirri. Share batu yana matsar da shi zuwa ma'ajiya.
optional-api-github-desc: Abokan hulɗa na REST API na GitHub don batutuwa suna aiki da WeKan: ma'ajiyar lamba allo ne, batu kati ne, tare da alamomi, matakai (alamomi masu ranar ƙarewa), sharhuna, da buɗe ko rufe kamar a cikin Ganin allo / Sarrafa sigar. Tokin tokin API ne na WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Abokan hulɗa na REST API na Gitea da Forgejo don batutuwa suna aiki da WeKan kamar yadda API mai dacewa da GitHub ke yi: ma'ajiyar lamba allo ne kuma batu kati ne. Tokin tokin API ne na WeKan.
bots-none: Babu bot tukuna. Bot mai gudanarwa ne a kan sabar ka - wakilin AI, aikin CI, rubutun umarni - wanda wannan allo ke miƙa masa katuna.
bots-no-runs: Babu bot da ke aiki yanzu.
bot-not-found: Wannan bot ɗin ba ya cikin wannan allo.
bot-option-not-found: Wannan amsar ba ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda bot ɗin ya bayar ba ce.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks masu fita ba za su iya kaiwa adiresoshi a kan cibiyar sadarwar WeKan ta kanta ba, don kada wani ya iya nuna webhook na allo zuwa wani sabis na ciki. Jera a nan masu masaukin da ke kan wannan cibiyar sadarwa waɗanda webhooks za su iya kaiwa - Node-RED, sabar hira - ɗaya a kowane layi, a matsayin suna ko adireshi, tare da tashar jiragen ruwa (port) don ba da izinin wannan tashar kawai. Babu komai: babu ko ɗaya. Masu gudanar da shafin ne kaɗai za su iya canza wannan jeri.
account-webhook-desc: Adireshi ɗaya da WeKan ke sanarwa lokacin da wani ya shiga ko aka ƙirƙiri sabon asusu. Ba a aika komai har sai an yi alama a kan wani lamari a ƙasa. Yana ɗauke da lamarin, sunan mai amfani da lokaci; yi alama a kan ƙarin filaye kawai idan mai karɓa yana buƙatar su.
account-webhook-on-register: Lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri sabon asusu
account-webhook-field-ip: Adireshin IP da shigar ta fito
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: Ba mai masauki ba ne, ba a adana ba:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: A soke duk sanarwar da ke jira ta ayyukan da suka wuce kwanaki nawa?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: An soke %s, an isar da %s, %s tsofaffi har yanzu suna jira.
vcs-synced-from: An daidaita daga %s: buɗe kuma rufe shi a can.
vcs-synced-issue: An daidaita wannan batu: buɗe kuma rufe shi a cikin mai bin diddigin sa.
sync-write-back: Mayar da canje-canje zuwa GitLab: take, bayani, sharhi, rufewa da sake buɗewa
sync-write-back-error: Mayar da canje-canje zuwa GitLab ya kasa
email-bounces-description: Abin da WeKan ke yi da imel da ya dawo: adireshi da aka rubuta ba daidai ba, akwatin saƙo da ya cika, amsa ta rashin zuwa ofis, ƙorafin spam. Kowane iri yana da nasa ayyuka, ana yin su idan ya dawo sau nawa aka saita.
email-bounces-enabled: Sarrafa dawowar imel a cikin WeKan
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Sanar da wanda ya gayyace shi
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adireshin babu shi: kuskuren rubutu, asusun da aka share, yanki da ba a sani ba.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ba a isar da shi yanzu ba: akwatin saƙo ya cika, sabar tana aiki. Sai da yawa a jere ne suke da ma'ana.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Amsoshin rashin zuwa ofis, hutu ko tsarin tikiti. An isar da imel ɗin.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Mai karɓa ya yi wa imel ɗin alama a matsayin spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: A cikin Amazon SES, aika sanarwar Bounce da Complaint, da ƙa'idar karɓa don adireshin da WeKan ke aikawa daga gare shi, zuwa wani batun SNS, sannan ka yi rajistar wannan adireshin a gare shi ta HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN na batutuwan SNS da za a karɓa, ɗaya a kowane layi
email-bounces-stopped-only: Adiresoshin da WeKan ba ya aika musu imel kawai
email-bounces-clear-hint: Manta dawowar wannan adireshin kuma a sake aika masa imel
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Wannan ba ARN na batun SNS ba ne.
email-bounces-providers-description: Idan WeKan yana aikawa ta ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka, kunna shi, ba aikin wannan adireshin webhook don abubuwan dawowar imel da ƙorafin spam, kuma liƙa a nan maɓallin da yake sa hannu da shi, ko kalmar sirrin da ka saka a adireshin kamar https://user:password@… ko ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Aikin da aka kunna yana buƙatar maɓallin sa hannunsa ko kalmar sirrinsa.
activity-pub-enabled: Allunan jama'a suna wallafa ayyukan katunansu a fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: A kashe yake ta asali. Idan aka kunna shi, ana iya bin kowane allon jama'a daga Mastodon da sauran sabobin fediverse a matsayin @board-<id> a adireshin wannan WeKan, kuma sabbin ayyukan kati suna isa ga mabiyansa. Karatu kawai ne: babu abin da sabar fediverse ta aiko da zai canza allo, kuma ba a taɓa wallafa allunan sirri ba.
caldav-sync-desc: Saka ranakun ƙarshe na katunan wannan allo a cikin kalanda - Nextcloud Calendar ko kowace kalandar CalDAV. Ranar ƙarshe da aka matsar a kalanda tana dawowa kan katin. Yi amfani da kalmar sirri ta manhaja, ba taka ba.
caldav-enabled: Daidaita ranakun ƙarshe da wannan kalanda
caldav-invalid-url: Dole adireshin kalanda ya zama adireshin http:// ko https://, ba tare da sunan mai amfani ko kalmar sirri a ciki ba.
caldav-not-linked: Da farko ajiye adireshin kalanda kuma ka kunna daidaitawa.
webdav-storage-description: Ajiye abubuwan haɗawa a cikin babban fayil a kan sabar WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud ko wata daban. Yi amfani da kalmar sirri ta manhaja da aka ƙirƙira don WeKan. Ana iya amfani da sabar da ke kan cibiyar sadarwar WeKan kanta a nan, tunda mai gudanar da shafin ne kaɗai ke saita wannan adireshin.
sqrl-desc: A kashe yake ta asali. Idan aka kunna shi, shafin shiga yana ba da SQRL, kuma mambobi suna fara ƙara shaidar SQRL ɗinsu a Saitunan mamba. SQRL yana buƙatar WeKan a adireshin https://.
sqrl-scan: Duba lambar da manhajar SQRL ɗinka, ko ka buɗe manhajar SQRL ɗinka a wannan na'urar.
sqrl-expired: Wannan lambar SQRL ta ƙare. Sake farawa.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL yana buƙatar WeKan a adireshin https://.
sqrl-description: Shiga da shaidar SQRL ɗinka maimakon kalmar sirri. Ƙara ta a nan sau ɗaya da manhajar SQRL ɗinka; za ka iya cire ta a nan a kowane lokaci.
sqrl-none: Ba a ƙara wata shaidar SQRL ba.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: An kashe shiga da SQRL don wannan asusun daga manhajar SQRL ɗinka. Sake kunna shi a can da lambar ceto ɗinka.
sqrl-only-on: Manhajar SQRL ɗinka ta kulle wannan asusun zuwa SQRL: an ƙi duk wata hanyar shiga.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Manhajar SQRL ɗinka ta kulle wannan asusun gaba ɗaya: an ƙi sake saita kalmar sirri da canza imel.
sqrl-only: Wannan asusun yana shiga da SQRL kaɗai.
sqrl-hardlock: An kulle wannan asusun zuwa SQRL: ba za a iya dawo da shi ko canza shi ta wata hanya ba.
windows-sso-failed: Shiga da Windows ya kasa. Mai yiwuwa ba a yarda da asusunka na Windows a nan ba.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Ba a sami tubalan da suka dace ba
enrollment-password-instructions: Tabbatar da kalmar sirrinka don fara saitawa. Wannan matakin ba zai shigar da kai ba. Ba za a iya sauya hanyar tantancewa da ke aiki a nan ba.
enrollment-setup-denied: Ba za a iya fara saitawa ba. Duba bayanan shiga naka, sannan ka duba ko an riga an kunna lambobin amfani sau ɗaya.
enrollment-code-instructions: Yi amfani da lambobi masu dogaro da lokaci: SHA1, lambobi shida da tazarar daƙiƙa 30. Kada ka ba kowa maɓallin sirri. Wannan saitin zai ƙare bayan minti biyar.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: An riga an yi amfani da lambar tabbatarwa. Kafin ka shiga, jira manhajar tantancewa ta nuna sabuwar lamba.
registration-first-admin: Asusu na farko a wannan yankin zai sami izinin mai gudanarwa na gaba ɗaya.
auth-too-many-attempts: An yi ƙoƙarin shiga sau da yawa. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Ana ƙirƙirar asusun masu gudanarwa na gaba ɗaya a cikin wannan tsarin. An kashe rajistar jama'a.
registration-password-unavailable: Ba a iya yin rajista da kalmar sirri.
expedite-limit: Kati ɗaya kawai a buɗe na allo zai iya zama Gaggawa a lokaci ɗaya.
list-policy-placeholder: Yaushe kati zai iya shigowa wannan jerin, kuma yaushe aka kammala shi a nan?
commitment-point-hint: Ana ɗaukar alƙawarin aiki daga wannan jerin zuwa gaba; jerin da ke gabansa zaɓuɓɓuka ne.
person-wip-over: __user__ yana da katunan buɗaɗɗu __count__; iyakar WIP ga kowane mutum __limit__ ce.
feature-list-policies-desc: Manufar kowane jerin (yaushe kati zai iya shigowa da kuma yaushe aka kammala shi a can) a kan kan jerin. Ana kunna shi ga kowane allo a Saitunan allo / Jerin.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Jerin da ake ɗaukar alƙawarin aiki daga gare shi, an yi masa alama a kansa. Ana zaɓa ga kowane allo a Saitunan allo / Jerin.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Katunan buɗaɗɗu nawa mutum ɗaya zai iya riƙe a kan allo; kati da aka buɗe yana gargaɗi game da duk wanda ya wuce ta. Ana saita shi ga kowane allo a Saitunan allo / Jerin.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Taron tsaye na kullum a menu na allo: mambobin allon a cikin tsari da aka gauraya, kowanne da iyakacin lokaci ɗaya. Ana kashe shi ga kowane allo a cikin Saitunan Scrum nasa.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Allon nazari a menu na allo: sabon allo na sirri da jerin Fara yi, Daina yi, Ci gaba da yi da Abubuwan da za a yi. Ana kashe shi ga kowane allo a cikin Saitunan Scrum nasa.
show-split-lists: Bada damar raba jerin zuwa Ana yi da An gama
list-split: Raba zuwa Ana yi da An gama
split-done: An gama a nan, yana jiran a ja shi gaba
mark-split-done: Yi alama a matsayin an gama a nan
feature-split-lists-desc: Jerin da aka raba zuwa Ana yi da An gama: katin da aka yi wa alama an gama a can yana jira, a dushe, a ja shi zuwa jerin na gaba, kuma kan jerin yana ƙidaya duka biyun. Ana bari a kowane allo a Saitunan allo / Jerin, sannan a kunna shi a menu na kowane jerin.
workload-intro: Awanni da aka kiyasta da maki na labari na katunan da aka ba kowane mutum, mako bayan mako, idan aka kwatanta da awannin da yake da su: lokacin aikinsa, rashin zuwansa da hutun jama'a. Danna mako don ganin katunansa.
workload-truncated: Ya yi yawa a nuna lokaci ɗaya: rahoton yana nuna mutane da katunan farko kawai. Zaɓi makonni kaɗan ko alluna kaɗan.
workload-unestimated: Katunan da ba a kiyasta ba
workload-allocations-intro: Yawan lokacin mutum da ke zuwa ga allo, ko waɗanne matsayi allo zai buƙata kafin a sanya sunan kowa.
workload-invalid-estimate: Kiyasin dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 10000 awanni.
feature-workload-desc: Nauyin aiki da iya aiki a menu na mai amfani: awanni da aka kiyasta da maki na labari na katunan kowane mutum, mako bayan mako, idan aka kwatanta da lokacin aikinsa, rashin zuwa da hutun jama'a, tare da rarrabawa ga alluna da matsayi na wucin gadi.
billing-intro: Allunan da kai ne mai gudanarwarsu: kasafin kuɗinsu, abin da aikinsu ya ci da wanda zai ci bisa farashin kowace awa da ka saita, da takardun kuɗi na awannin da aka yi aiki. Masu gudanar da allo ne kaɗai ke ganin wannan.
billing-no-boards: Ba kai ne mai gudanar da kowane allo ba.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h ba su da farashin kowace awa kuma ba a sa musu farashi ba. Saita farashi don allon ko don waɗannan mutane.
billing-nothing-to-invoice: An riga an yi takardar kuɗi ga duk awannin da ake biya.
billing-set-rate-first: Da farko saita farashin kowace awa ga wannan allo.
feature-billing-desc: Kasafin kuɗi da lissafin biya na menu mai amfani: kasafin kuɗin allo a kuɗi ko awanni, farashin kowace awa, kuɗin aikinsa da hasashensa, da takardun kuɗi na awannin da ake biya da aka yi. Masu gudanar da allo ne kaɗai ke ganinsa.
billing-include-undated: Haɗa lokacin da aka rubuta kafin a fara adana kwanan wata
billing-method-link: Mahaɗin biya (kati, walat, biya ta intanet)
billing-method-swiss-qr: Takardar kuɗi ta QR ta Switzerland
billing-pay-by-scanning: Biya ta hanyar dubawa da manhajar bankinka ko ta biya
billing-reference-rf: Lambar shaidar mai bin bashi RF
billing-reverse-charge: Juyar da caji: mai saye ne ke biyan harajin VAT
billing-undated-included: Ya haɗa da awanni __hours__ da aka rubuta kafin a fara adana kwanan wata.
time-entry-undated: Kafin a fara adana kwanan wata
billing-method-mnb: Lambar QR ta canja kuɗi nan take ta Hungary
billing-field-promptpay-target: Lambar waya, lambar shaidar ƙasa ko ID na e-walat
billing-field-proxy: Lambar waya, UEN, ID na FPS ko imel
billing-unbilled: Aikin da ba a lissafa kuɗinsa ba
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h ba su da kuɗin kashewa na awa kuma ba sa cikin kuɗin kashewa.
billing-bill-time: Lissafa kuɗin lokaci bisa awa (a kashe: farashi tsayayye, kuɗaɗen aiki da kashe-kashe kaɗai ake lissafawa)
billing-approve-time: Amince da lokaci kafin a lissafa kuɗinsa
billing-quote-valid-days: Ƙiyasin farashi yana aiki na kwanaki
billing-fees: Kuɗaɗe tsayayyu da na kowane wata
billing-fees-intro: Mataki ko farashi tsayayye ana lissafa shi sau ɗaya, daga ranarsa; kuɗin wata-wata kowane wata daga ranarsa har ƙarshensa.
billing-nothing-to-approve: Babu lokacin da ke jiran amincewa.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h suna jiran amincewa kuma ba sa cikin wannan takardar kuɗi.
billing-quotes-intro: Ƙiyasin farashi yana sanya farashi ga aikin da ya rage - ƙiyasin kowane kati a buɗe ban da lokacin da aka kashe - da kuɗaɗen da ba a lissafa ba tukuna.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Karɓar ƙiyasi yana mai da shi kasafin kuɗin allo
workload-utilization-title: Awannin da ake biya da aka rubuta idan aka kwatanta da lokacin aiki na waɗannan makonni
workload-no-candidates: Babu wanda ke da wannan ƙwarewa
cloud-panel-settings-intro: A Yankin Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin yana kula da yankunan abokan ciniki, rumbunan bayanansu, DNS na CloudFlare da hanyoyin Caddy, kuma kowane abokin ciniki yana ganin takardun kuɗinsa yana kuma magana da SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin wani mai gudanarwar WeKan ne da yake akwai.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Adireshin da yankunan ke nunawa (adireshin IP ko sunan mai masauki)
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ tana da bayanan __type__ tun da: an bar ta yadda take.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy yana tura Yankin Cloud Panel da kowane yanki da aka raba zuwa wannan WeKan, da kowane yanki mai nasa rumbun bayanai zuwa nasa akwatin WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-upstream: Wannan WeKan, yadda Caddy ke isa gare shi (host:port)
cloud-panel-database-uri: Layin haɗi (ko sassan da ke ƙasa)
cloud-panel-customers: Abokan ciniki da ke shiga nan (sunayen masu amfani ko adireshin imel)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Ajiye bayanan DNS nasa a CloudFlare
cloud-panel-test-ok: An haɗa: masu amfani __users__, alluna __boards__, katunan __cards__.
cloud-panel-import-users: Asusu: sababbi __created__, __matched__ suna nan tun da.
cloud-panel-import-files: Abubuwan haɗawa __count__: kwafi fayiloli daga ma'ajiyar fayiloli ta tsohon WeKan ma.
cloud-panel-chat-import: Shigo da tattaunawar da ta gabata
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin yana kan adireshin da mai canjin muhalli CLOUD na sabar ya ambata kawai, domin masu kula da Cloud nasa da kuma abokan cinikin yankunan da yake lissafawa.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Adiresoshin IPv4 da IPv6, da jerin adiresoshi kamar 203.0.113.0/24, daga inda mai kula da Cloud zai iya shiga. Ɗaya a kowane layi. Fanko: kowane adireshi.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Adireshinka __address__ ba ya cikin wannan jerin. Ajiye shi zai kulle ka waje, saboda haka ba a ajiye shi ba.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Adiresoshin IPv4 da IPv6 da kewayon adireshi, ɗaya a kowane layi, waɗanda za a iya amfani da Panel na Admin da admin REST API daga gare su. Babu komai: kowane adireshi.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Mai canza muhallin sabar ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ne ke yanke shawara maimakon wannan jeri.
admin-panel-address-refused: Ba za a iya amfani da Panel na Admin daga adireshinka __address__ ba.
website-view-empty: Har yanzu ba a wallafa komai a wannan shafin yanar gizo ba.
feature-views-website-desc: Allon a matsayin shafin yanar gizo: katunan jerin Published nasa, layin Pages a matsayin menu da sauran katunan a matsayin rubuce-rubuce, sabon farko, tare da abubuwan haɗawarsu. Allon jama'a zai iya buɗewa a wannan duba, don baƙi su ga shafin yanar gizon a adireshin allon.
feature-views-shop-desc: Kayayyakin katunan allo a matsayin shagon yanar gizo: kati mai farashi kaya ne, alamominsa su ne rukunai, kuma oda kati ne a jerin Odoji. Allo na jama'a zai iya buɗewa a ciki, don baƙi su yi siyayya a adireshin allon.
shop-decrement-stock: Cire kayayyakin da aka yi oda daga ajiya
shop-sale-lists: Jerin abubuwa na sayarwa (babu zaɓi: kowane jeri banda jerin Odoji)
shop-category-labels: Alamomin da ake nunawa a matsayin rukunai (babu zaɓi: kowace alama)
shop-orders-private: Ana rubuta odoji a kan allo na sirri, saboda allo na jama'a yana nuna kowane kati ga kowa.
shop-guest-checkout: Baƙi marasa asusu za su iya yin oda
shop-show-on-public: Nuna Shagon maimakon allo na jama'a
shop-show-on-public-note: Allo na jama'a yana buɗewa a gani ɗaya kawai. Zaɓar Shagon a nan yana maye gurbin __view__ ga baƙi, kuma zaɓar Shafin yanar gizo ko wani gani a Saitunan allo / Ganin allo yana maye gurbin Shagon.
shop-empty: Babu kayayyaki tukuna. Kati mai farashi a jerin sayarwa shi ne kaya.
shop-accept-terms: Na yarda da sharuɗɗa da ka'idoji
shop-privacy-note: Ana rubuta sunanka da bayanan tuntuɓarka a kan odar don shagon ya kawo maka ita, ba a wani wuri ba.
shop-price-changed: Wani farashi ya canza. Duba sabon jimilla ka sake yin oda.
shop-confirmation-email: Aika wa mai saye tabbacin oda ta imel
import-board-instruction-wordpress: A WordPress, zaɓi Tools, Export, All content da Download Export File, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .xml a nan ko ka liƙa rubutunsa. Squarespace, Wix da sauran shafuka da ke fitar da fayil na WordPress suna aiki haka. Kowane shafi da rubutu ya zama kati a jerin matsayinsa, shafuka a layin Pages kuma rubuce-rubuce a Posts, tare da abin da ke ciki, rukunoninsa da alamunsa a matsayin alamomi, da sharhunansa da aka amince da su.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Ajiye rubuce-rubuce da shafukan REST API na WordPress (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts da /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) a matsayin fayil ɗaya na .json, sannan ka zaɓe shi a nan ko ka liƙa shi. Kowane shafi da rubutu ya zama kati a jerin matsayinsa.
import-board-instruction-ghost: A Ghost, zaɓi Settings, Labs, Export your content, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .json a nan ko ka liƙa shi. Kowane shafi da rubutu ya zama kati a jerin matsayinsa, tare da tags nasa a matsayin alamomi.
import-board-instruction-blogger: A Blogger, zaɓi Settings, Back up content, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .xml a nan ko ka liƙa rubutunsa. Kowane rubutu da shafi ya zama kati, daftari a jerin Draft, tare da alamominsa da sharhunansa.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Matse tushen shafin tsayayye na Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro ko wani zuwa .zip - fayilolin Markdown tare da front matter nasu, da hotunansu - sannan ka zaɓi .zip a nan. Kowane fayil na Markdown ya zama kati: rubuce-rubuce daga manyan fayilolin posts ko masu kwanan wata a sunan fayil, sauran shafuka, daftarori a jerin Draft, da hotunan da yake amfani da su a matsayin abubuwan haɗawarsa.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Matse fayilolin shafin yanar gizo zuwa .zip - shafukansa na .html da hotuna, kamar yadda wget ko HTTrack ke ajiye su, ko fitarwar Medium - sannan ka zaɓi .zip a nan. Kowane shafi ya zama kati tare da babban rubutunsa, da hotunan da yake amfani da su a matsayin abubuwan haɗawarsa; ana barin rubutun shiri, menu da fom.
import-board-instruction-substack: A Substack, zaɓi Settings, Exports, Create new export, sannan ka zaɓi .zip da aka sauke a nan. Kowane rubutu ya zama kati tare da rubutunsa, an wallafa ko daftari.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Layuka suna raba allo zuwa ratsi na kwance, don haka kowane kati yana cikin jeri da kuma layi. Layi zai iya wakiltar ƙungiyar aiki, mutum, abokin ciniki ko irin aiki, yayin da jerin abubuwa suke nuna matakan aikin.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Danna + a kan layin, ko zaɓi Ƙara Layi a cikin menu ɗinsa, rubuta suna sannan ka zaɓi ko zai kasance sama ko ƙasa da layin da aka zaɓa. Liƙa layuka da yawa na rubutu zai iya ƙirƙirar layi ɗaya ga kowane layin rubutu. Danna suna don sake sunansa, yi amfani da kibiya don ninkewa ko buɗe layi, ja maƙallinsa don sake tsara layuka, kuma ja gefensa na ƙasa don canza tsayinsa sai dai idan manajan allo ya kulle canza girma.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Jerin abubuwa su ne ginshiƙan da ke ɗauke da katunan. A kan allon kanban kowane jeri mataki ne na aikin, kuma kati yana tafiya daga jeri zuwa jeri yayin da aikin ke ci gaba. A ganin Layuka jeri zai iya kasancewa na layi ɗaya.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Danna alamar ƙara jeri a ƙarshen dama na kan jeri, ko Ƙara a cikin menu na jeri, rubuta suna sannan ka zaɓi bayan wane jeri zai zo; liƙa layuka da yawa zai iya ƙirƙirar jeri ɗaya ga kowane layi. Danna sunan jeri don sake sunansa, kuma kibiyar da ke kansa tana ninkewa ko buɗe shi gare ka kaɗai. Menu na jeri yana da kwafi, matsarwa da ma'ajiya, kuma za ka iya jan maƙallin da ke tsakanin jerin abubuwa don canza faɗinsu idan an ba da izinin canza girma.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Ganin Tebur yana nuna katunan allo a matsayin tebur irin na spreadsheet, jere ɗaya ga kowane kati, tare da jerinsa, layinsa, mutane, alamomi da kwanakin wata. Yana da amfani wajen duba katuna da yawa lokaci guda da kuma ƙara ko matsar da katuna ba tare da jan su tsakanin jerin abubuwa ba.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Danna kan ginshiƙi don tsarawa, kuma sake danna shi don juya tsarin. Rubuta a akwatin nema don samun sunayen katuna, jerin abubuwa, layuka da alamomi, kuma yi amfani da Na baya da Na gaba don tafiya jeri 25 a lokaci guda. Maɓallin Gyara yana buɗe kati a saman tebur. Naɗa sunaye da Haɗa ta layi suna canza tsari kuma ana tuna su a wannan burauza. Ba a nuna katunan da ke ma'ajiya, kuma Tace na gefe yana rage jerukan.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Ganin Kalanda yana sanya katunan allo a kan kalanda bisa kwanakinsu: kati mai ranar farawa da ranar ƙarewa a matsayin sanda a tsakaninsu, kuma ranakun karɓa, ƙarshe da ƙarewa a matsayin shigarwa nasu. Abubuwan jerin dubawa masu kwanan wata ma suna bayyana.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Yi amfani da Yau, Na baya da Na gaba don zagayawa, kuma canza tsakanin rana, mako da wata, kowanne a matsayin grid ko jeri. Ja kati don ba shi sabuwar ranar ƙarshe, ko miƙe shi don canza ranar ƙarewarsa. Danna rana, ko ja a kan sa'o'i a grid na mako ko na rana, don ƙirƙirar sabon kati mai ƙarshe a lokacin; zai tafi layin farko da jerin farko na allo.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Yanayin Kalanda yana nuna kowane kati a ranar ƙarshensa, tare da alamominsa da cikakken sunansa, a grid na wata ko mako. Duba ne na karatu kawai na abin da zai ƙare yaushe, kamar kalandar Trello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Yi amfani da Yau, Na baya da Na gaba don tafiya da wata ko mako, kuma Mako ko Wata don canza grid; ana tuna zaɓin a wannan burauza. Danna kati don buɗe shi. Ba a nuna katunan da ke ma'ajiya kuma Tace na gefe yana aiki. Don canza kwanaki ta hanyar ja, yi amfani da ganin Kalanda maimakon haka.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Kalandar Alluna da Yawa tana nuna katuna masu kwanan wata na kowane allo da kake memba a cikinsa a kalanda ɗaya, don ka ga duk abin da zai ƙare a wannan mako ko a wane allo yake. Kowace shigarwa tana farawa da sunan allonta a cikin baka.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Buɗe ta daga menu na Ganin allo na kowane allo kuma jira har katunan dukan allunanka sun loda. Yi amfani da Yau, Na baya da Na gaba da ganin rana, mako da wata, kowanne kuma a matsayin jeri. Ranakun karɓa, ƙarshe da ƙarewa suna da shigarwa nasu. Danna shigarwa don buɗe wannan kati a allonsa. Ba za a iya jan kwanaki a nan ba.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Ganin Lokaci yana tattara bin diddigin lokacin allo a wuri ɗaya: lokaci nawa aka kashe, wa ya kashe kuma a kan waɗanne katuna, da lokaci nawa ya rage kafin katuna su ƙare. Ana shigar da lokaci a kan katunan kansu; wannan ganin yana ba da rahoto ne kawai.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Karanta taƙaitaccen lokacin da aka kashe a sama, sannan rarrabawa ta wanda aka ba wa da ta kati, tare da katunan da suka wuce lokaci an yi musu alama. A ƙasa an jera kowane canji ga sa'o'in da aka rubuta na kati ta mutumin da ya yi shi. Danna Fitar da don ajiye rahoton a matsayin PDF ko Excel. Mambobin da kawai za su iya ganin katunan da aka ba su suna samun taƙaitaccen bayani na katunansu, yayin da sauran sassan suka kasance babu komai.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Ganin Tsarin lokaci yana nuna allo kamar yadda yake a wani lokaci a baya, ta amfani da tarihin allo. Yana taimaka maka ganin abin da ya canza da mayar da kati yadda yake.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Danna wani wuri a kan layin don ganin kowane kati kamar yadda yake a lokacin, an haɗa ta jerinsa a lokacin, tare da sunansa, bayaninsa, alamominsa, mambobinsa da ranar ƙarshensa. Danna Yanzu don komawa yanzu. A kan kati, Mayar zuwa wannan yanayi yana mayar da waɗannan ƙimomi bayan ka tabbatar. Ba a share komai ba: ana rubuta mayarwar a matsayin sabon tarihi, kuma ana nuna maɓallin ga mutanen da za su iya canza wannan kati kawai.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Ƙididdiga tana nuna matsayin allo a kallo ɗaya: yadda ake loda katunansa da yawan layuka, jerin abubuwa, katuna, katunan ma'ajiya, alamomi, mambobi da filayen keɓaɓɓu da yake da su.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Buɗe Ƙididdiga daga rukunin Taƙaitawa na menu na Ganin allo kuma karanta teburin Matsayin allo. Loda katuna yana faɗin ko wannan allo yana loda katunan da ake gani kawai ko duk katuna, da ko an zaɓi hakan kai tsaye saboda allo babba ne. Ana ƙirga adadin a kan sabar, don haka daidai suke ko da a kan babban allo. Ana iya zaɓa da kwafa kowace ƙima, kuma buɗe ganin ba ya canza komai.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Haɗa ta Wanda aka ba wa yana jera kowane kati ƙarƙashin mutumin da aka ba shi, maimakon ƙarƙashin jerinsa, don ka ga wa ke da me ba tare da buɗe kowane jeri ba. Ya dace da taron ƙungiyar aiki.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Buɗe shi daga menu na Ganin allo. Kowane wanda aka ba wa yana samun sashe da katunansa, ranar ƙarshe inda aka saita ta da agogo idan kati ya wuce lokaci; katunan da ba a ba kowa ba suna ƙarƙashin Ba wanda aka ba wa. Danna sunan kati don buɗe katin. Haɗawar tana amfani da filin Wanda aka ba wa na kati, ba Mambobinsa ba. Mutanen da matsayinsu ya ba su damar ganin katunan da aka ba su kawai ba sa samun bayani a nan.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Ganin Gantt suna zana katunan allo a kan kalanda don ka ga abin da zai fara, abin da zai ƙare da abin da ya haɗu. Gantt tebur ne mai jere ɗaya ga kowane kati da alama ga kowace ranarsa, yayin da Frappe Gantt da DHTMLX Gantt suke zana kowane kati a matsayin sanda daga farko zuwa ƙarshe.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Zaɓi Gantt, Frappe Gantt ko DHTMLX Gantt a rukunin Kalanda da lokaci na menu na Ganin allo; katuna suna buƙatar aƙalla ranar karɓa, farawa, ƙarshe ko ƙarewa ɗaya. A Gantt, kowane mako mai kwanaki yana samun teburinsa; danna sunan kati don buɗe katin ko alamar rana don gyara wannan ranar. A Frappe Gantt da DHTMLX Gantt, mambobi masu izinin rubutu za su iya jan sanda don sake tsara lokacin katin.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Product Backlog jerin aiki ne da aka tsara wanda ƙungiyar Scrum ba ta ɗauka cikin sprint ba tukuna. Yana nuna katunan allo da ba su da sprint na yanzu, an tsara su ta matsayin backlog, ba tare da matsar da su daga jerin abubuwansu ba.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Nemo kati a tebur kuma, a cikin tantanin Ayyuka, saita Sprint ɗinsa, matsayin backlog, Fitarwa, Nau'in aiki da Sharuɗɗan karɓa, sannan danna Ajiye. Ƙananan matsayi suna zuwa farko. Riƙe Ctrl, ko Cmd a Mac, don sanya kati a fitarwa da yawa. Danna sunan kati don buɗe katin, da Nuna ƙari don loda katuna 100 na gaba. Gyara yana bin izinin kati na yau da kullum.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Sprint ɗan gajeren lokaci ne kayyadadde wanda ƙungiyar Scrum ke kammala zaɓaɓɓen aiki zuwa wata manufa. Ganin Sprints shi ne inda ake tsara, farawa, rufe ko soke sprints na allo, tare da fitarwarsa da taron Scrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Da farko manajan allo yana buɗe saitunan Scrum, ya kunna tsara Scrum kuma ya zaɓi tushen kimantawa, ma'auni, manufar kammalawa da ranakun aiki. Sannan ƙirƙiri sprint da aka tsara mai suna, manufa, farawa da ƙarewa, sanya masa katuna daga Product Backlog, kuma danna Fara sprint. Don gamawa, zaɓi inda aikin da bai ƙare ba zai tafi kuma danna Rufe sprint, ko ba da dalili kuma danna Soke sprint. Manajojin allo ne kawai ke gudanar da sprints.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Rahoton sprint yana faɗin abin da ya faru a sprint ɗaya da aka rufe: abin da aka yi alkawari, aka kammala, aka ƙara, aka cire da wanda ya rage bai ƙare ba. Velocity yana jera waɗannan sakamako ga kowane sprint da aka rufe, don a tsara sprint na gaba daga abin da ƙungiyar ta yi da gaske.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: A Rahoton Sprint, zaɓi sprint kuma zaɓi Katuna ko Kimantawa sama da sandunan, sannan karanta faɗin aiki na kullum da aikin da ya rage da tarihin canji bayan canji a ƙasa. A Velocity, karanta jere ɗaya ga kowane sprint da aka rufe. Sakamakon suna fitowa daga hotunan da aka ɗauka lokacin da kowane sprint ya fara da aka rufe shi, don haka canjin kimantawa daga baya ba ya sake rubuta su. Fitar da yana ajiye sakamakon a matsayin PDF ko Excel, kuma Sabunta yana sake loda rahoton.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Waɗannan jadawalin Scrum suna nuna ci gaba a kan lokaci. Burndown yana nuna yawan aikin da ya rage kowace rana kuma Burnup yawan abin da aka yi, Velocity yana nuna yawan abin da kowane sprint da aka rufe ya kammala, Release Burndown yana bin aikin da ya rage a fitarwa, kuma Epic Progress yana nuna nisan da katunan iyaye suka kai.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Zaɓi jadawalin ƙarƙashin Scrum a menu na Ganin allo. Kowanne yana zana daga katuna da sprints na allo kansa kuma yana nuna lambobin a tebur ƙarƙashin jadawalin. Velocity yana buƙatar aƙalla sprint ɗaya da aka rufe, kuma yana ba ka damar zaɓar Katuna ko Kimantawa. Danna Fitar da a sama don ajiye lambobin iri ɗaya a matsayin PDF ko Excel. Jadawalin da ba shi da abin zana tukuna yana cewa Babu sakamako.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Taswirar hanya tana haɗa katuna zuwa jeruka bisa ƙimar filin keɓaɓɓe, kamar fitarwa ko epic, kuma tana zana katunan kowane jere a tsarin lokaci. Yana da amfani don taswirar fitarwa ko jigo idan an riga an adana wannan rukuni a filin keɓaɓɓe.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Allo yana buƙatar aƙalla filin keɓaɓɓe ɗaya na rubutu ko jerin zaɓi. Zaɓi filin a Haɗa ta a sama; kowace ƙima tana samun ƙaramin jadawalin Gantt na katunanta, kuma katunan da ba su da ƙima suna ƙarƙashin Babu ƙima. Ana sanya katuna bisa kwanakinsu, don haka ba su ranakun farawa da ƙarshe don ganin su a tsarin lokaci.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Waɗannan jadawalin Taƙaitawa suna amsa yawan aikin allo da yadda aikinsa ya bazu: Dashboard da Pulse suna taƙaita allo, Workload yana nuna wa ke da me, Distribution yadda aka raba katuna, Dependency Map yadda katuna ke hana ko dogara da juna, kuma Activity Heatmap lokacin da mutane ke aiki a allo.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Zaɓi jadawali a rukunin Taƙaitawa na menu na Ganin allo. Kowane shafi yana zana jadawalin daga katuna da tarihin allo kuma yana nuna teburin lambobin da ke bayansa. Danna Fitar da a sama don ajiye bayanan iri ɗaya a matsayin PDF ko Excel. Idan babu abin zana tukuna, jadawalin yana cewa Babu sakamako.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard yana tara kowane allo da kake memba a cikinsa a shafi ɗaya mai gungurawa, kowanne da jerin abubuwansa da katunansa, don ka yi aiki a kan dukan allunanka lokaci guda.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Buɗe Bigboard daga menu na Ganin allo kuma jira yayin da katunan kowane allo ke lodawa. Kowane sashen allo yana aiki kamar allo na yau da kullum: ja katuna tsakanin jerin abubuwa, buɗe katuna kuma gyara jerin abubuwa. Za ka iya kuma jan kati zuwa jerin wani allo a shafin, wanda ke matsar da shi zuwa wannan allo. Ana iya jan jerin abubuwa ne kawai a cikin allonsu. Danna sunan allo don buɗe shi shi kaɗai.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Jadawalin kwararar Kanban suna nuna yadda aiki ke tafiya ta cikin allo: kwarara ta tarawa, lokacin sarrafawa da zagaye, lokacin jagora, ingancin kwarara, yawan aiki da aka gama, WIP, aikin da ya tsufa, abubuwan hanawa, hasashen lokacin da aiki zai ƙare, halayen tsari da ko manyan kimantawa suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo. Suna taimaka maka gano inda aiki ke taruwa da tsawon lokacin da yake ɗauka da gaske.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Zaɓi jadawali a rukunin kwararar Kanban na menu na Ganin allo. Karanta bayanin da ke ƙarƙashin sunan, wanda ke faɗin yadda yake aunawa, sannan jadawalin da teburin da ke ƙarƙashinsa. Wasu shafuka suna da saituna, kamar katunan manufa da rana don Monte Carlo Forecasts ko filin girma don Work Item Size vs. Cycle Time, ana amfani da su da Aiwatar. Fitar da a sama yana ajiye teburan a matsayin PDF ko Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Waɗannan rahotanni suna nuna yadda aiki ke tafiya ta cikin allo mako bayan mako: katunan da aka ƙirƙira da aka gama, kwarara ta gaskiya, tsawon lokacin da katuna ke zama a kowane jeri, matsakaicin shekarun katunan da ke buɗe, aikin da aka gama kowane mako da yawan lokacin da ake cika ranakun ƙarshe.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Zaɓi rahoto a rukunin kwararar Kanban na menu na Ganin allo: Created vs. Resolved, Net Flow, Time in List, Average Age, Throughput Run Chart ko Due Date Performance. Kowanne yana nuna jadawali kuma, ƙarƙashinsa, teburin lambobin da aka zana shi daga ciki. Danna Fitar da a sama don ajiye wannan tebur a matsayin PDF ko Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Ganin Taswira yana nuna katunan allo a matsayin alamomi a kan hoton da manajan allo ya ɗora, kamar zanen bene ko taswirar wuri. Ya dace da aikin da ke faruwa a wurare, kamar ɗakuna, injuna ko filaye.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Manajan allo yana danna Ɗora hoton taswira ya zaɓi fayil na PNG, JPEG, GIF ko WebP, kuma zai iya cire shi daga baya ba tare da rasa wuraren katuna ba. Mutanen da za su iya canza allo suna ganin katunan da ba su kan taswira tukuna; ja ɗaya zuwa kan hoton, ko zaɓe shi ka danna inda ya dace, kuma ja alama don matsar da ita. Alama tana ɗaukar launin alamar farko ta kati, kuma danna ta yana buɗe katin.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Ganin Imel yana nuna allo a matsayin akwatin wasiƙa: katuna su ne saƙonni, jerin abubuwa su ne manyan fayiloli kuma alamomi su ne alamomi. Za ka iya rubutawa da amsa imel daga adireshin allo kansa, don haka amsoshi suna dawowa allo a matsayin katuna da sharhi.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Danna Akwatin shiga, An aika, Duk wasiƙu, jeri ko alama don zaɓar abin da ake nunawa, rubuta a akwatin nema don rage jerukan, kuma danna jere don buɗe katin, wanda sharhinsa su ne tattaunawar. Rubuta yana rubuta sabon imel kuma kibiyar amsa tana amsa ɗaya, ana aikawa daga adireshin allo. Dole ne allo ya fara karɓar imel, wanda ake kunnawa a Saitunan Sanarwa na allo ƙarƙashin Imel zuwa kati.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Ganin Hira yana nuna allo a matsayin wurin aikin hira: kowane kati mai tattaunawa tashar ce kuma sharhinsa su ne saƙonni. Bishiyar tashoshi tana ƙunshe da kowane allo da za ka iya gani, tare da yawan saƙonnin da ba ka karanta ba.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Buɗe wurin aiki da allo a Tashoshi kuma danna kati; yana buɗewa a tsakiyar faifai kuma saƙonninsa a faifan hira. Rubuta saƙo kuma danna Enter ko Aika; Shift+Enter yana fara sabon layi. Don fara tattaunawa a kan katin da ba shi da saƙonni, danna Nuna duk katunan wannan allo kuma zaɓi katin. Ana juya faifan don harsunan da ake rubutawa daga dama zuwa hagu.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Ganin Sarrafa Sigar yana nuna allo a matsayin mai bin diddigin matsaloli na ma'ajiyar lamba: katuna su ne matsaloli, alamomi su ne alamomi, alamomi masu ranar ƙarshe su ne matakai, sharhi su ne tattaunawar kuma abubuwan haɗawa su ne fayiloli. Yana kuma shigo da kuma daidaita matsaloli daga GitHub, GitLab, Gitea da Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Duba matsalolin da ke buɗe da waɗanda aka rufe, tace ta alama ko mataki, kuma buɗe matsala don karantawa da ƙarawa a tattaunawarta. Ana ɗaukar kati a matsayin rufaffe idan yana ma'ajiya ko a jeri kamar Closed ko Done. Sababbin matsaloli suna zama katuna a jerin buɗaɗɗe na allo, kuma Rufe ko Sake buɗewa yana matsar da katin tsakanin jerin buɗaɗɗe da na rufaffe. Duk bayanan kati ne na yau da kullum, don haka ana adana canje-canje a tarihin allo.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Saitin ginshiƙai suna ba ka damar shirya katunan iri ɗaya ta wasu hanyoyi, kamar ta fifiko, mataki ko girma, ba tare da matsar da wani kati daga jerinsa ba. Kowane saiti yana da ginshiƙansa masu launi.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Manajan allo yana rubuta suna a Sabon saitin ginshiƙai ya danna Ƙara, sannan ya ƙara ginshiƙai masu suna da launi. Zaɓi saiti a sama; kowane kati yana cikin ɗaya daga ginshiƙansa ko a Ba a sanya ba. Ja kati zuwa wani ginshiƙi don canza wurinsa a wannan saitin kawai; jerinsa, layinsa, alamominsa da mambobinsa ba sa canzawa. Kowane kati yana kuma nuna ƙananan alamomi na ginshiƙinsa a sauran saitin.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Ganin Gidan yanar gizo yana nuna allo a matsayin gidan yanar gizo da aka gina daga katunansa da abubuwan haɗawarsa, misali shafin da aka shigo da shi daga WordPress, Ghost, Blogger ko shafi mara canzawa. Allo na jama'a zai iya buɗewa a wannan ganin, don haka baƙi suna ganin shafin a adireshin allo.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Katuna a jerin da ake kira Published suna kan shafin, ko katunan kowane jeri idan babu irin wannan jeri; katunan ma'ajiya ba sa bayyana ko kaɗan. Katuna a layin da ake kira Pages suna samar da menu, tare da ƙananan ayyuka a matsayin ƙananan shafuka, kuma sauran katunan rubuce-rubuce ne a shafin farko, sabo a farko. Bayanin kati shi ne rubutun shafi kuma abubuwan haɗawarsa su ne hotunansa da fayilolinsa. Don amfani da shi a matsayin ganin allo na jama'a, zaɓe shi a Saitunan Allo / Ganin allo.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Ganin Shago yana nuna kayayyakin da ke kan katunan allo a matsayin shagon yanar gizo, tare da hotuna, farashi, rukunai, shafin kaya, kwando da wurin biya. Kati a jerin da ake sayarwa yana zama kaya idan filin farashinsa yana da lamba, kuma alamominsa suna zama rukunai.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Manajan allo yana saita shago a Saitunan Allo / Shago: filayen farashi, lambar kaya da hajja, jerin Oda na sirri, kuɗi, VAT, hanyoyin biya, jerin abubuwan da ake sayarwa da alamomin da ake nunawa a matsayin rukunai, sannan ya yi alama a Shagon a buɗe yake. Masu saye suna tace ta rukuni, suna ƙara kaya a kwando kuma suna biya. Kowane oda yana zama sabon kati a jerin Oda, kuma mai saye yana samun imel na tabbatarwa.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Tace yana nuna katunan da suka dace da abin da ka zaɓa kawai, kamar alamomi, mambobi, waɗanda aka ba wa, kwanaki, ƙimomin filayen keɓaɓɓu, rubutun kati ko tsawon lokacin da katuna suka yi a jeri. Ba ya canza wani kati ko izinin kowa, kuma ana iya ajiye haɗin tacewa a ƙarƙashin suna a sake amfani da shi.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Zaɓi alamomi, mutane, kwanaki ko wasu sharuɗɗa a gefen gefe, kuma allo yana nuna katunan da suka dace kawai. Ƙarƙashin Alamomi, OR yana daidaita kowace alamar da aka zaɓa kuma AND yana buƙatar dukansu; sake danna alamar da aka zaɓa yana cire ta. Rubutun kati yana aiki yayin da kake rubutawa. Rufe faifan yana barin tacewa a kunne har sai ka share shi. Nema na Duniya, shi ma a nan, yana samun katuna a duk allunanka.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Nema yana samun katuna da jerin abubuwan wannan allo waɗanda rubutunsu ya ƙunshi abin da ka rubuta, kuma yana nuna kowane kati da aka samu a kan allo kansa. A Duk Alluna maɓallin iri ɗaya yana rage jerin allunanka ta suna.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Rubuta a filin kuma danna Enter. Gefen gefe yana jera jerin abubuwa da katunan da suka dace, kuma kati na farko yana buɗewa a allo tare da mai ƙirga ƙarƙashin filin. Sake danna Enter don kati na gaba ko Shift+Enter don na baya; kibiyoyi suna yin haka kuma suna zagayawa. Danna kati ko jeri a sakamakon don nuna shi a allo, kuma sake danna Nema don rufe gefen gefe.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Zaɓi Da Yawa yana ba ka damar yin alama a katuna da yawa sannan ka yi abu ɗaya ga dukansu lokaci guda: saita alama ko memba, canza launi, matsar, kwafa ko kai su ma'ajiya. A Duk Alluna yana zaɓar alluna maimakon haka.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Kunna Zaɓi Da Yawa a kan allo, sannan yi alama a akwatunan katuna, ko yi amfani da Tace zuwa zaɓi a gefen Tace don zaɓar kowane kati da tacewa ke nunawa. Zaɓi aiki a gefen gefe, kamar Saita alama ga zaɓi, Matsar da zaɓi ko Matsar da zaɓi zuwa Ma'ajiya. Danna Kashe Zaɓi Da Yawa, X ɗin da ke kusa da maɓallin kan allo, idan ka gama. Kana buƙatar izinin canza allo.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Filayen keɓaɓɓu su ne ƙarin filayen allo kansa don katuna, kamar siga, kasafin kuɗi, abokin ciniki, akwatin alama ko zaɓi daga jeri. Ana ayyana fili sau ɗaya ga allo, kuma kowane kati zai iya riƙe ƙimarsa ta kansa.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Danna + don ƙirƙirar fili, ba shi suna da nau'i (rubutu, lamba, kwanan wata, jerin zaɓi, jerin zaɓi da yawa, akwatin alama, kuɗi ko samfurin rubutu) kuma zaɓi inda ake nuna shi: a kan kati, a kan ƙaramin kati, a sababbin katuna ko a kowane kati. Ba za a iya canza nau'in daga baya ba. Filayen lamba da kuɗi za su iya nuna jimlarsu a saman kowane jeri. Sannan ana cika ƙimomin kati a kan katin da aka buɗe.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Ma'ajiya tana riƙe da katuna, jerin abubuwa da layukan da aka matsar zuwa Ma'ajiya. Kai abu ma'ajiya yana ɓoye shi ba tare da rasa shi ba, don haka ana iya mayar da shi daga baya, yayin da sharewa ke cire shi gaba ɗaya.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Zaɓi shafin Katuna, Jerin abubuwa ko Layuka kuma danna Mayar kusa da abu, ko Mayar da duka. Kati ba zai iya dawowa ba yayin da jerinsa ke ma'ajiya ko ya cika a iyakar WIP ɗinsa, kuma Ma'ajiya tana faɗin haka. Manajojin allo suna kuma ganin Share da Share duka, waɗanda ba za a iya sokewa ba. Ana mayar da alluna na ma'ajiya daga shafin Ma'ajiya na Duk Alluna maimakon haka.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Wuraren asali suna nuna inda aka sanya kowane layi, jeri da kati lokacin da aka yi shi, da waɗanda suka motsa tun lokacin. Yana da amfani bayan babban sake tsari, ko don ganin sunan da aka ƙirƙiri kati da shi.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Karanta rukunai uku, Layuka, Jerin abubuwa da Katuna. Kowane abu yana nuna sunansa na yanzu, An matsar idan ba ya inda aka sanya shi, wurin da aka ƙirƙire shi, sunansa na asali idan ya canza, da lokacin da aka yi shi. Danna Sabunta don sake karanta tarihin allo. Abubuwan da aka yi kafin a fara rubuta wurare ba su da jere.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Taƙaitawa rahoton taron tsaye ne na abin da ya faru a allo, mutum bayan mutum, an ɗauka daga bayanan allo kansa. Yana amsa abin da kowannenmu ya yi a rana ko mako na ƙarshe, da abin da ya wuce lokaci.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Zaɓi Rana ta ƙarshe ko Mako na ƙarshe. Kowane memba da ya yi wani abu ko yana da katunan da suka wuce lokaci yana samun rukunai na katunan An gama, An matsar, An ƙara da An yi sharhi, tare da katunansa da suka Wuce lokaci, kuma kowane kati yana buɗewa daga mahaɗinsa. Danna Kwafa a matsayin rubutu don kwafar dukan taƙaitawa, a shirye don liƙawa a hira ko imel.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Tun ziyararka ta ƙarshe yana jera abin da wasu mutane suka canza a wannan allo tun lokacin da ka buɗe shi na ƙarshe: sababbin katuna, matsarwa, sharhi, canjin ranar ƙarshe da mambobin da aka ƙara. Shigarwar menu tana nuna yawan canje-canje.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Buɗe allo yana rubuta ziyararka. Buɗe wannan ganin don ganin canje-canje an haɗa su ta kati, sabo a farko, kuma danna jere don buɗe wannan kati. Ba a jera canje-canjenka ba. Mai gudanarwa zai iya ɓoye wannan fasali a Panel na Admin / Saituna / Fasaloli.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Ganuwa tana yanke shawarar wa zai iya ganin allo: mutanen da aka ƙara a ciki kawai (Na sirri), kowane mai amfani da ya shiga wannan WeKan (Masu amfani da suka shiga), ko kowa da mahaɗin (Na jama'a). Gyara yana zama ga mambobin allo sai dai idan manajan allo ya ba da izini daban.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Manajan allo yana danna maɓallin ganuwa a kan allo ya zaɓi Na sirri, Masu amfani da suka shiga ko Na jama'a; zaɓin yanzu yana da alamar tabbatarwa kuma maɓallin sannan yana nuna sabon saiti. A allon Masu amfani da suka shiga ko Na jama'a, idan mai gudanarwa ya ba da izini, manajan zai iya kuma yin alama a Kowa da ya shiga zai iya gyarawa. Ga sauran mutane maɓallin yana nuna saitin kawai.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Kula yana saita yawan abin da kake ji game da wannan allo: Ana kallo yana sanar da kai kowane canji, Ana bi kawai canje-canje ga katunan da ka ƙirƙira ko kake memba a cikinsu, kuma An yi shiru ba komai. Saitin naka ne; sauran mambobi suna zaɓar nasu.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Danna maɓallin kula a kan allo kuma zaɓi Ana kallo, Ana bi ko An yi shiru; matakinka na yanzu yana da alamar tabbatarwa kuma maɓallin yana nuna sabon mataki. Idan an ƙi canjin, saƙo yana faɗin dalili kuma babu abin da ya canza. Ana ɓoye maɓallin idan mai gudanarwa ya kashe kula.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Tsara Katuna yana canza tsarin da ake nuna katuna a cikin kowane jeri: ta ranar ƙarshe, suna, lokacin ƙirƙira, ƙuri'u ko tsarin alamomin allo. Yana canza abin da kake gani ne kawai, kuma ba a matsar da wani kati ba.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Danna Tsara Katuna a kan allo kuma zaɓi tsari; katunan kowane jeri suna bin sa kuma maɓallin yana cewa Tsarawa a kunne. Danna X ɗin da ke kusa da shi don cire tsarawa da komawa tsarin da aka ja katunan zuwa ciki. Ana adana zaɓin a burauzarka har bayan sake lodawa. Don Tsarin alamomi, manajan allo zai iya canza tsarin alamomi da Matsar sama da Matsar ƙasa lokacin gyara alama.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Saitunan Allo suna tattara duk abin da aka saita don wannan allo ɗaya: dokokinsa, tsarawa, launi da bango, kwanaki, ganuwa, layuka, jerin abubuwa da katuna, fitarwa da shigowa, sanarwa, webhooks da ma'ajiya. Yawancin shigarwar na manajojin allo ne; matsayinka da saitunan shafin suna yanke shawarar waɗanda kake gani.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Buɗe gefen dama na allo da menu na hamburger kuma danna Saitunan Allo. Zaɓi shigarwa kuma taga ko shafinsa yana buɗewa. An haɗa shigarwar: dokoki da farko, sannan kamannin allo, sannan yadda ake zana shi, sannan abin da ke shiga da fita daga ciki, kuma a ƙarshe ma'ajiya.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Canza launi yana saita jigon launin wannan allo kansa, wanda kowane memba ke gani a wannan allo. Hanya ce ta bambance alluna a kallo ɗaya. Manajojin allo ne kawai za su iya canza shi.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Danna samfurin jigo; ana aiwatar da shi nan take, ba tare da maɓallin Ajiye ba. Don jigogi masu faɗi da masu haske za ka iya kuma zaɓar launukanka da ƙafafun launi kuma ka duba su a samfoti. Launin da ka saita wa kanka a Saitunan Memba har yanzu yana da fifiko a kan launin allo gare ka.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Sanarwar allo saƙo ne da manajan allo ke rubutawa ga kowa a wannan allo, ana nuna shi a sanda sama da jerin abubuwan allo. Yi amfani da ita don bayanan da kowane memba ya kamata ya gani, kamar wa'adi ko canji a yadda ake amfani da allo.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Rubuta rubutun, har zuwa haruffa 2000 na rubutu mara ado, yi alama a Nuna wa kowa a wannan allo, kuma danna Ajiye. Mambobi suna ganin sandar har sai sun rufe ta da X ɗinta, wanda ke ɓoye ta gare su kaɗai. Idan aka gyara sanarwar, ana sake nuna ta ga kowa.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Hoton bango hoto ne da ake nunawa a bayan jerin abubuwan allo, kuma a matsayin tayal ɗin allo a shafin Duk Alluna. Zai iya zama adireshin hoto a yanar gizo ko hoton da aka ɗora aka adana a WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Rubuta adireshin hoto a URL na Hoton Bango kuma danna Ajiye, ko yi amfani da Cire Hoton Bango don share shi. Don adana hoto, danna Ɗora hoton bango kuma zaɓi fayil; ana jera hotunan da aka ɗora a ƙasa, inda danna ɗaya ke mai da shi bangon allo, kuma alamomin suna saukewa ko share shi.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Kwanan wata yana ba manajan allo damar zaɓar tsarin kwanan wata ɗaya ga kowa a wannan allo, maimakon tsarin da aka saita don dukan shafin. Taga ɗaya yana da maɓallin lambar mako naka kuma, ga manajojin allo, daidaita kalanda wanda ke sanya ranakun ƙarshe na katuna a kalandar CalDAV kamar Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Yi alama a Tsarin Kwanan Wata na allo, zaɓi tsari kuma danna Ajiye; cire alamar don sake bin saitin shafin. Tsarin da memba ya kunna a Saitunan Memba har yanzu yana rinjaye. Nuna makon shekara yana kunna ko kashe lambobin mako gare ka nan take. Don daidaita kalanda, shigar da adireshin kalanda, sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri ta app, yi alama a akwatin daidaitawa kuma Ajiye.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Saitunan Duk Alluna suna yanke shawarar abin da tayal ɗin wannan allo ke nunawa a shafin Duk Alluna, kamar yawan katunan kowane jeri da hotunan mambobi. Suna kuma saita tsufan katuna, kai katunan da ba a taɓa ba ma'ajiya kai tsaye, da ko faɗin jerin abubuwa na kai ne ko na kowa.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Yi alama ko cire alama a jere kuma ana ajiye shi nan take. Idan tsufan katuna a kunne yake, rubuta lambobi uku na kwanaki bayan da katuna ke dushewa a matakai. Don ma'ajiya kai tsaye, rubuta kwanaki nawa ba tare da aiki ba kati zai iya zama kafin a kai shi ma'ajiya, ko bar shi babu komai don kashe hakan. Ba a taɓa kai samfura ma'ajiya ba.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Ganin allo yana zaɓar waɗanne ganuwa, kamar Layuka, Jerin abubuwa, Tebur, Kalanda, Gantt ko jadawali, ake bayarwa a menu na Ganin allo na wannan allo, da wanda allo ke buɗewa a ciki. Ana saita shi daban don lokacin da allo na jama'a ne da lokacin da na sirri ne.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Taga yana da jere ɗaya ga kowane ganin da akwatunan alama huɗu: ganin tsoho da ganuwan da ake nunawa ga allo na jama'a, da biyu iri ɗaya ga allo na sirri. Yi alama a akwatin Nuna na ganin don bayar da shi a menu da akwatin Tsoho don buɗe allo a ciki.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Layi yana riƙe da saitunan layuka na dukan allo: ko ana iya jan layuka, ko ana iya canza tsayinsu, ko duk layuka suna raba jere ɗaya na kan jerin abubuwa, da waɗanne filayen Scrum layi ke nunawa. Rukunan Iyakar WIP, iyakokin aiki da ake yi na tare a kan jerin abubuwa da yawa, suna nan ma.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Yi alama a akwatunan da kake so; akwatin Mai jan ido yana cikin tebur a sama. Jere ɗaya na kan jeri na tare yana nuna kowane layi tare da dukan jerin abubuwan allo ƙarƙashin jere ɗaya na kai wanda ke zama a sama, ba tare da canza jerin abubuwa ba. Danna Rukunan Iyakar WIP a ƙasa don ƙarawa ko gyara iyakokin tare.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Jeri yana riƙe da saitunan jerin abubuwa na dukan allo: ko ana iya jan jerin abubuwa, ko ana iya canza faɗinsu, ko kowane jeri yana da faɗi iri ɗaya, da filin Scrum da jeri ke nunawa. Yana kuma kunna manufofin kwararar Kanban: manufofin jeri, jerin abubuwa da aka raba zuwa Ana yi da An gama, wurin alƙawari da iyakar WIP ga kowane mutum.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Yi alama a maɓallan da kake buƙata; akwatin Mai jan ido yana cikin tebur a sama. Idan an ba da izinin canza girma, ja maƙallin da ke tsakanin jerin abubuwa don canza faɗi. Jere na manufar kwarara yana bayyana ne kawai idan an kunna wannan fasali don shafin, kuma da zarar ya kunna, ana saita bayanansa daga menu na kowane jeri.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Shago yana mai da katunan allo zuwa shagon yanar gizo da ake nunawa a ganin allo na Shago. Manajan allo yana zaɓar waɗanne filayen keɓaɓɓu ne farashi, lambar kaya da hajja, waɗanne jerin abubuwa ake sayarwa, waɗanne alamomi ne rukunai, inda ake rubuta oda da waɗanne hanyoyin biya ake bayarwa.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Saita jerukan kuma danna Ajiye; ana ajiye komai tare kuma sabar tana sake duba shi. Kati mai farashi a jerin da ake sayarwa yana zama kaya. Ana rubuta oda a matsayin katuna zuwa jerin Oda, wanda dole ne ya kasance a allo na sirri, kuma mai saye zai iya samun imel na tabbatarwa. Za ka iya kuma mai da Shago abin da baƙin allo na jama'a ke gani.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Kati yana yanke shawarar abin da ƙananan katuna da katunan da aka buɗe na wannan allo ke nunawa, da a wane tsari, kowanne daban. Yi amfani da shi idan allo ya dogara da filaye kaɗan, misali don sanya bayani ko filayen keɓaɓɓu a farko, ko don nuna ranar ƙarshe a farko a kan ƙananan katuna.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Taga yana da faifai biyu, Nuna a Ƙaramin Kati da Nuna a Kati. Yi alama ko cire alama a sashe ko fili don nunawa ko ɓoye shi, kuma ja jeruka don canza tsarinsu. Wasu sassa suna da menu nasu mai ƙarin saituna, kamar Ƙananan ayyuka da zaɓuɓɓukan jan kati.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Fitar da yana rubuta wannan allo, ko wani sashe nasa, zuwa fayil: tsarin WeKan kansa, spreadsheets, PDF, HTML, fayilolin kalanda da tsarin wasu kayan aiki da yawa. Shigo da yana ƙara abun ciki daga fitarwar WeKan zuwa wannan allo. Fitar da allo ba ajiyar dukan shafin ba ce.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: A Fitar da, zaɓi abin da za a haɗa da farko, sannan danna tsari kuma fayil ɗin yana saukewa. A Shigo da, zaɓi fayil ɗin fitarwar WeKan a tsarin json ko zip kuma ana ƙara abun cikinsa zuwa wannan allo. Shigo da yana buƙatar izinin rubutu a allo, kuma mai gudanar da shafin zai iya kashe kowanne.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Sanarwa tana saita tsoffin wannan allo don imel da sanarwar cikin app, tunatarwar ranar ƙarshe, imel zuwa kati, da yadda ake isar da sanarwa. Zaɓin da memba ya yi a fili har yanzu zai iya rinjayar tsohon allo.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Don tire na cikin app da imel, zaɓi Tsoho don bin saitin shafin, ko I ko A'a don rinjayar sa ga wannan allo. Ƙarƙashin Tunatarwar ranar ƙarshe, rubuta ranakun tunatarwa, an raba su da waƙafi, inda 0 ita ce ranar ƙarshe kuma lambobi marasa kyau ranaku ne bayanta, sannan danna Ajiye. Sassan isarwa da ke ƙasa suna saita abin da sanarwa ke ɗauka, haɗawa da lokaci.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Webhooks Masu Fita suna aika ayyukan wannan allo zuwa wani sabis, kamar kayan aikin hira ko haɗin kanka, yayin da suke faruwa. Kowane webhook yana aika rubutun aikin tare da sunaye da mahaɗan allo, jeri, layi, kati da mutanen da abin ya shafa.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Rubuta suna, adireshin da sabis mai karɓa ya ba ka kuma, idan yana so, alama, zaɓi nau'i kuma danna Ƙirƙira. Webhook da aka ajiye yana nuna ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka: waɗanne ayyuka yake aikawa, saƙonni kai tsaye ga mambobin kati don Mattermost, da yadda ake haɗa saƙonninsa da lokacinsu. Gyara kuma sake Ajiye shi, ko yi amfani da Kashe Wannan Webhook don dakatar da shi.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Mataimaka biyu don tarukan Scrum, ga kowane memba na allo. Taron tsaye na kullum agogo ne da ke ba kowane memba lokaci iri ɗaya, kuma Allon waiwaye yana ƙirƙirar sabon allo don waiwayen Fara, Daina, Ci gaba.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Taron tsaye na kullum yana jera mambobin allo a tsari mai gauraye; Fara yana ƙirga lokacin mutum na farko zuwa ƙasa, wanda ke zama ja idan ya wuce, kuma Na gaba yana miƙawa har zuwa na ƙarshe. Agogon yana aiki a burauzarka kawai. Allon waiwaye yana ƙirƙira ya buɗe sabon allo na sirri da jerin abubuwa Fara yi, Daina yi, Ci gaba da yi da Abubuwan aiki.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Rukunin iyakar WIP iyaka ɗaya ce ta aiki da ake yi wadda jerin abubuwa biyu ko fiye ke rabawa tare, ban da iyakar kowane jeri. Yana da amfani idan aikin da ake yi ya bazu a jerin abubuwa da yawa, kamar Ana yi, Bita da Gwaji, ko idan kana so ka iyakance dukan layi.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Ƙarƙashin Ƙara rukunin iyakar WIP, yi alama a jerin abubuwan da za a ƙirga tare, ko zaɓi layi kuma danna Aiwatar ga layi don yin alama a jerin abubuwansa. Saita iyakar kuma danna Ƙara rukunin iyakar WIP. Ana iya canza rukunin da ke akwai da Aiwatar, kunnawa ko kashewa da Kunna Iyakar WIP, ko cirewa da Share.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Ƙananan ayyuka suna raba babban kati zuwa ƙananan katuna waɗanda kowanne za a iya ba wani, tsara lokacinsa da matsar da shi daban, yayin da katin iyaye ke jera su yana ƙirga nawa aka gama. Waɗannan saitunan suna yanke shawarar inda ake ƙirƙirar sababbin ƙananan ayyuka da yadda ƙaramin aiki ke nuna iyayensa.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Zaɓi yadda ƙaramin katin ƙaramin aiki ke ambaton iyayensa, ko katunan allo suna da sashen Ƙananan ayyuka, da allo, jeri da layin da ake ƙirƙirar sababbin ƙananan ayyuka a ciki. A tsoho suna tafiya zuwa allo nasu. Ana ƙara ƙananan ayyuka kansu daga sashen Ƙananan ayyuka na katin da aka buɗe.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Dokoki suna sarrafa allo kai tsaye: idan wani abu ya faru, mai jawo, WeKan yana yin wani abu, aikin. Misali, idan aka matsar da kati zuwa Done, a yi masa alamar an gama. Manajojin allo ne ke yin dokoki, kuma allo zai iya barin mambobinsa su karanta su.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Rubuta suna, zaɓi mai jawo kuma cika filayensa, sannan zaɓi aiki; ana ajiye dokar kuma tana aiki daga nan sai dai idan an kashe ta. A ganin Tsarin aiki za ka iya gina dokoki ta jan mai jawo da aiki. Ana iya sake sunan dokoki, share su, fitar da su da shigo da su, kuma doka za ta iya samun ƙarin masu jawo da ayyuka a bayananta.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Saitunan Memba menu naka ne, ana buɗe shi daga sunan mai amfaninka ko hotonka a saman dama. Yana da shafukanka kamar Katunana, Katunan Ƙarshe da Masu tauraro, taƙaitawar alluna, da duk saitunanka na kai, daga bayanin martaba da kalmar sirri zuwa harshe da rubutun haruffa.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Danna sunan mai amfaninka ko hotonka kuma zaɓi shigarwa; shafinsa ko tagarsa tana buɗewa. Abin da kake gani ya dogara da nau'in asusunka, matsayinka da saitunan shafin. Idan bayanin fasali na mai gudanar da shafi ya ɓoye wasu fasaloli gare ka, menu yana faɗin nawa aka ɓoye.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Gyara Bayanin Martaba yana canza yadda wasu mutane ke ganinka a WeKan: cikakken sunanka da baƙaƙe, kuma, idan shafin ya ba da izini, sunan mai amfaninka da adireshin imel. Idan shafin ya ba da izini, za ka iya kuma share ko ɓoye sunan asusunka a nan.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Canza filayen kuma danna Ajiye; taga yana rufewa idan ya yi aiki kuma yana nuna kuskuren idan bai yi ba. Ana ƙin sunan mai amfani ko adireshin imel da wani asusu ke amfani da shi, kuma ana yi wa adireshin imel da aka canza alamar ba a tabbatar ba. Share yana cire asusunka ba tare da sokewa ba, yayin da Ɓoye sunan asusu ke riƙe tarihinka amma yana maye gurbin sunanka.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Canza Saituna yana riƙe da zaɓuɓɓukanka na gyara da nunawa, kamar maƙallan jan, alamar katunan da suka canza tun da ka buɗe su na ƙarshe, layin mayar da hankali, ajiye masu gyara da Enter, buɗe katuna da yawa lokaci guda da sautin jerin dubawa. Suna shafar ka kaɗai, a kowane allo.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Danna maɓalli don kunnawa ko kashewa; alamar tabbatarwa tana nuna yana kunne kuma ana ajiye shi nan take. Don Nuna yawan katuna idan jeri ya ƙunshi fiye da, rubuta lamba kuma danna Ajiye. Tsarin kwanan wata, farkon mako da sanarwa suna da shigarwa nasu a Saitunan Memba.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Canza launi yana saita jigon launinka na kanka don WeKan. Yana rinjayar jigon shafin a ko'ina kuma da launin allo kansa a shafukan allo, amma gare ka kaɗai.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Danna samfurin jigo; ana aiwatar da shi nan take. Don jigogi masu faɗi da masu haske za ka iya zaɓar launukanka da ƙafafun launi kuma ka gan su a samfoti. Zaɓi Jigon tsoho don cire zaɓinka da sake ganin launukan allo ko na shafin.
