help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Rubutun haruffa yana ba ka damar zaɓar nau'in haruffa, girman rubutu da launin rubutu na dukan fuskar WeKan don kanka. Yana taimakawa karatu, misali da girma mafi girma ko launin da ya dace da idanunka.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Danna Tsoho ko ɗaya daga maɓallan rubutun haruffa; rubutun haruffan da aka shigar a burauzarka ne kawai ake bayarwa. Zaɓi girma kuma zaɓi launin rubutu a ƙafar launi, ko danna Cire don komawa launin jigo. Canje-canje suna aiki nan take kuma ana ajiye su a bayanin martabarka, kuma layin samfoti yana nuna sakamakon.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Hotonka shi ne ƙaramin hoton da ake nunawa gare ka a katuna, a jerin mambobi, sharhi da kan shafi. Canza Hoto yana ba ka damar ɗora hotuna, zaɓar wanda ake amfani da shi, share su, ko komawa baƙaƙenka.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Danna Ɗora hoto kuma zaɓi hoto; ana ƙara shi a jeri, kuma danna jerensa yana mai da shi hotonka, mai alamar tabbatarwa. Danna Baƙaƙe don nuna baƙaƙenka maimakon haka. Alamar kwandon shara tana share hoto bayan ka tabbatar. Taga yana nuna iyakokin girma da nau'in fayil idan shafin ya saita su.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Canza Kalmar Sirri yana maye gurbin kalmar sirrin da kake shiga WeKan da ita. Don asusun da ke da kalmar sirri ta WeKan ne; asusun da ke shiga ta wani sabis suna canza kalmar sirrinsu a can.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Shigar da kalmar sirrinka ta yanzu, sannan sabuwar kalmar sirri sau biyu, kuma aika. Shafin zai iya buƙatar mafi ƙarancin tsawo kuma ya ƙi kalmomin sirri da suka yi kama da sunan mai amfaninka ko imel, ko waɗanda aka samu a sanannun keta bayanai. Bayan canjin ana fitar da kowane zaman asusunka, kuma kana sake shiga da sabuwar kalmar sirri.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Passkey yana ba ka damar shiga da zanen yatsan wannan na'ura, fuska, kulle allo ko maɓallin tsaro maimakon kalmar sirrinka. Passkey yana zama a na'urarka kuma WeKan yana adana sashensa na jama'a kawai.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Rubuta suna kamar Wayata kuma danna Ƙara passkey a wannan na'ura, sannan tabbatar da kulle allonka idan burauza ta tambaya. Ana jera passkeys ɗinka da sunayensu da kwanakinsu, kuma alamar kwandon shara tana cire ɗaya. Idan burauza ba za ta iya yin passkeys ba, taga yana faɗin haka.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL yana ba ka damar shiga ta hanyar duba lambar QR da app na SQRL, ba tare da kalmar sirri ba. A nan kana ƙara shaidar SQRL ɗinka a asusunka sau ɗaya, ko ka sake cire ta.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Danna Ƙara shaidar SQRL ta kuma lambar QR tana bayyana. Duba ta da app na SQRL, ko danna Buɗe abokin cinikin SQRL don abokin ciniki a wannan kwamfuta; taga yana gaya maka lokacin da aka ƙara shaidar, ko idan lambar ta ƙare ko ta gaza. Cire shaidar SQRL ta yana cire ta daga asusunka.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Tantancewa ta matakai biyu tana sa shiga ya nemi lamba mai lambobi 6 daga app na tantancewa a wayarka bayan kalmar sirrinka, don haka kalmar sirri da aka sace ita kaɗai ba ta isa a shiga asusunka ba.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Danna Kunna Tantancewa ta Matakai Biyu, sannan duba lambar QR da app na tantancewa ko rubuta lambar da ke ƙarƙashinta a cikin app. Shigar da lambar lambobi 6 da app ke nunawa kuma danna Tabbatar da Kunna. Daga nan shiga yana neman lamba, kuma taga iri ɗaya zai iya sake kashe ta sai dai idan mai gudanarwarka ya buƙace ta.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Alluna masu ɓoye suna jera allunan da ka bari waɗanda har yanzu za ka iya kaiwa ta ƙungiyar aiki, ƙungiya ko yankin imel ɗinka, don haka WeKan ya ɓoye maka su maimakon haka. Barin irin wannan allo ba ya canza zama membanka a ƙungiyar aiki ko ƙungiya.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Taga yana nuna jere ɗaya ga kowane allo mai ɓoye, ko yana cewa babu ko ɗaya. Danna Mayar kusa da allo don dawo da shi Duk Alluna. Wannan yana cire shi daga jerin ɓoyayyunka kawai; ko za ka iya buɗe allon har yanzu allon kansa ne ke yanke shawara.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: Canza Harshe yana zaɓar harshen fuskar WeKan gare ka. Ana ajiye zaɓinka a bayanin martabarka, don haka yana bin ka zuwa kowace burauza. Har sai ka zaɓa, WeKan yana bin harsunan burauzarka kuma yana komawa Turanci.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Ana jera harsuna da sunayensu, tare da tuta, layin yanki don bambance-bambancen yanki da bayani don harsunan dama zuwa hagu; na yanzu yana da alamar tabbatarwa. Danna harshe kuma fuskar tana canzawa nan take.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Gayyaci Mutane yana aika imel mai lambar gayyata ga mutanen da ba su da asusu tukuna, don su yi rajista yayin da rajistar kai ke kashe. Yana ba mambobin yankin imel na ƙungiyar damar shigo da abokan aiki ba tare da mai gudanarwa ba.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Rubuta adireshin imel, ɗaya a kowane layi ko an raba su da waƙafi, yi alama a allunan da ya kamata su shiga idan sun yi rajista, kuma danna Gayyata. Taga yana faɗin ko an aika gayyatar. Kana buƙatar matsayin allo da zai iya gayyata a kowane allo da aka yi wa alama, kuma adireshin da ke da asusu tuni yana dakatar da aikawa.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Kwanan wata yana zaɓar yadda ake rubuta kwanaki gare ka, kamar shekara-wata-rana ko rana-wata-shekara, tare da lokaci ko babu. Tsarin da ka kunna yana rinjayar na allo da na shafin. Taga iri ɗaya yana saita ranar farko ta mako da tsarin kalanda.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Saman taga yana nuna tsarin shafin da na allon yanzu, don ka ga abin da za ka gada. Yi alama a Saitunan Memba: Tsarin Kwanan Wata kuma zaɓi tsari, saita farkon mako da tsarin kalanda idan kana so, kuma danna Ajiye. Cire alamar tsarinka kuma ajiye don sake bin allo ko shafin.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Rukunin tauraro a kan shafi menu na alamomin shafinka ne: yana riƙe alluna, wasu shafukan WeKan, kuma daga menu nasu layuka, jerin abubuwa da katuna a nisan danna ɗaya. Taurarinka naka ne kaɗai.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Danna tauraro don sanya ko cire tauraro a allo ko shafin da kake ciki; adadin yana nuna nawa kake da su. Danna kibiya ko adadin don buɗe jerin kuma danna jere don zuwa can, ko Duba duk abubuwa masu tauraro don cikakken shafin Masu tauraro. A Duk Alluna / Masu tauraro za ka iya cire tauraro daga tayal kuma ka ja su don sake tsara su.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Katuna masu kama suna jera katunan wannan allo waɗanda sunansu da bayaninsu suka fi kama da wannan, don a lura da kwafi na biyu na aiki ɗaya kafin a yi aikin sau biyu. Daidaito mai kusanci sosai ana yi masa alama Wataƙila kwafi ne.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Har zuwa katuna biyar masu kama ake nunawa a nan, kowanne da jerin da yake ciki, kuma kan sashe yana ƙirga su. Danna ɗaya don buɗe shi. Kwatancen daidaita rubutu ne kawai da sabar ke yi, ba tare da wani sabis na AI ba. Ana iya ɓoye sashen a Saitunan Allo / Kati, jere Katuna masu kama, Nuna a Kati.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Ayyuka su ne tarihin kati kansa: wa ya ƙirƙira shi, ya canza sunansa, ya ƙara alama, ya matsar da shi, ya rubuta sharhi ko ya haɗa fayil, da yaushe. Yana amsa abin da ya faru da wannan kati ba tare da tambayar kowa ba.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Ana jera sababbin abubuwan da suka faru a tsari, tare da sunaye, alamomi, guntun sharhi da sunayen fayiloli an tsara su kamar yadda suke a kan kati kansa. Danna sunan da ke da mahaɗi don zuwa wannan kati, jeri ko allo. Mai gudanar da shafi zai iya zaɓa a Panel na Admin / Saituna / Tsaro don nuna rubutu mai ado a matsayin rubutu mara ado ko ba tare da mahaɗan da ake dannawa ba.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Alamomi su ne tambarin allo masu launi, ana amfani da su don haɗa da tace katuna ta batu, fifiko ko duk abin da ƙungiyar aiki ta yarda. Alama za ta iya samun ranar ƙarshe tata, wanda ke mai da ita mataki mai sauƙi kamar Sprint 1 ko v2.0 ga kowane kati da ke ɗauke da ita.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Danna alama ko maɓallin ƙari don buɗe tagar alamomi, sannan danna alamomi don sanya su a kati ko cire su; alamar tabbatarwa tana nuna waɗanda aka zaɓa. Fensir ɗin da ke kusa da alama yana gyara sunanta, launinta da ranar ƙarshenta, kuma alama mai ranar ƙarshe tana nuna wannan rana kusa da ita. Lambobi masu liƙawa da wurare suna a wannan sashe.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Kati yana da kwanaki huɗu na zaɓi: Karɓa don lokacin da aikin ya iso, Farawa don lokacin da aiki ya fara, Ƙarshe don wa'adi kuma Ƙarewa don lokacin da aka gama shi. Alamar ranar ƙarshe tana da launi bisa gaggawa kuma tana ƙirga kwanakin da suka rage, don haka aikin da ya makara yana fitowa a allo.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Danna ƙari kusa da rana, ko alamar ranar, zaɓi rana da lokaci kuma ajiye; ranar ƙarshe ba tare da zaɓaɓɓen lokaci ba tana samun 17:00. Sake buɗe taga iri ɗaya don canzawa ko share ta. Idan gajerun hanyoyin madannai suna kunne, danna d a kan kati yana buɗe ranar ƙarshensa. Kati yana kuma ƙirga sau nawa aka canza ranar ƙarshensa.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Sashen Mambobi yana faɗin waɗanda abin ya shafa da kati: mambobinsa, waɗanda aka ba wa, wanda ya ƙirƙira shi, wanda ya nemi aikin da wanda ya ba da shi. Wanda ya nema da Wanda ya bayar za su iya riƙe mambobin allo da kuma rubutu na kyauta, misali suna daga wani mai bin diddigi.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Danna ƙari mai zagaye a jere don buɗe jerin mambobin allo kuma zaɓi mutane; ana nuna su a matsayin hotuna ko baƙaƙe, kuma sake danna hoto yana cire su. Ƙarƙashin Wanda ya nema da Wanda ya bayar, mahaɗin Ƙara da ke ƙarƙashin ƙari yana rubuta rubutun kyauta maimakon haka. Ana zaɓar jerukan da ke bayyana a Saitunan Allo / Kati.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Sashen Kati yana riƙe da filayen aikin kati kansa, kamar dogaronsa, yanayin hanawa, ajin sabis, makin fifiko, lambar tsarawarsa da maɓallan katinsa. Katin da aka buɗe yana nuna kowane filin da allo ya zaɓa ya nuna a katuna, mara komai ko a'a, a shirye don cikawa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Cika ko canza fili kai tsaye a wannan sashe. Abin da ke bayyana a nan, a wane sashe da a wane tsari ana yanke shawara don dukan allo a Saitunan Allo / Kati, a faifan Nuna a Kati: yi alama ko cire alama a jere, ko ja shi don sake tsarawa. Ƙaramin kati yana bin faifan Nuna a Ƙaramin Kati haka nan.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Bin diddigin lokaci yana rubuta sa'o'i nawa aka kashe a kati, tare da kimantawa na zaɓi, alamomin Ana biya da Ƙarin lokaci da rubutun kowace rana na wa ya yi aiki tsawon wane lokaci. Jimlar tana ciyar da ganin lokaci, nauyin aiki da biyan kuɗi na allo, kuma agogon Flowtime da Pomodoro a nan suna ƙara mata.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Danna alamar lokaci ko hamburger ɗin da ke kusa da Lokacin da aka kashe don buɗe Canza lokacin da aka kashe, shigar da sa'o'i (an yarda da ɗigo), kimantawa da alamomi idan kana so, kuma Ajiye. Ƙarƙashin Lokaci ta rana, zaɓi rana, shigar da sa'o'i da bayani kuma danna Rubuta lokaci; za ka iya cire shigarwarka har sai an amince da ita ko an yi mata takardar kuɗi. Alamar tana zama ja idan aka yi alama a Ƙarin lokaci.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Filayen keɓaɓɓu su ne ƙarin filayen allo kansa don katunansa, ban da na ciki: siga, kasafin kuɗi, abokin ciniki, akwatin alama ko zaɓi daga jeri. Ana ayyana su sau ɗaya ga allo, kuma kowane kati zai iya ɗaukar ƙimarsa ta kansa.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: A nan kana zaɓar waɗanne filayen keɓaɓɓu na allo wannan kati ke amfani da su kuma ka cika ƙimominsu. Ana ƙirƙirar sababbin filaye a Saitunan Allo / Kati, a sashen Filayen keɓaɓɓu, ta zaɓar suna da nau'i kamar Rubutu, Lamba, Kwanan wata, Jerin zaɓi, Akwatin alama ko Kuɗi. Ana iya nuna fili a ƙaramin kati ma, kuma ana iya haɗa filayen lamba a saman kowane jeri.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: Planning Poker yana ba ƙungiyar aiki damar kimanta kati tare. Kowa yana zaɓar ƙima daga katunan ba tare da ganin zaɓin wasu ba, kuma idan zaɓen ya ƙare WeKan yana nuna wa ya zaɓi me da wace ƙima ta yi nasara, don a yarda da kimantawa maimakon mutum ɗaya ya yi zato.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Buɗe hamburger na sashen, Gyara Planning Poker, idan kana so ka ba duk masu amfani da suka shiga dama kuma saita lokacin ƙarewa, kuma Ajiye. Kowane mai zaɓe yana danna ƙima ɗaya; danna wata yana canza zaɓen. Manajan allo yana danna Gama don ganin sakamako, ya rubuta lamba kuma ya danna Saita Kimantawa. Sake kunnawa yana share ƙuri'u don sabon zagaye.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Saitunan Scrum suna riƙe da wurin kati a tsarin Scrum na allo: sprint ɗinsa da sprints na baya, fitarwa, nau'in matsala, sharuɗɗan karɓa da matsayin backlog. Ana iya kuma yi wa kati alama a matsayin Story ko Task, wanda ganin sprint da backlog ke amfani da shi.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Buɗe Gyara ƙarƙashin filayen don canza su kuma Ajiye; waɗanda za su iya canza kati ne kawai za su iya gyarawa. Hamburger a kan sashen yana zaɓar irin kati: babu, Story ko Task. Ana tsara, farawa da rufe sprints kansu a ganin Scrum na allo, kuma ana saita waɗanne daga cikin waɗannan filayen ke bayyana a Saitunan Allo / Kati.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Bayani shi ne babban rubutun kati: bayanan aikin, bayanai, mahaɗai ko bayanan taro da aka liƙa. Ana rubuta shi a Markdown, don haka zai iya samun kanun labarai, jeruka, mahaɗai, emoji da hotuna yayin da yake zama rubutu mara ado don gyarawa.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Danna bayanin don gyara shi a akwatin rubutu mara ado. Rubuta alamar at da farkon suna don samun shawarwarin mambobi. Ajiye, kuma ana nuna rubutun a tsare. Fayilolin da aka ɗora suna zama a sashen Abubuwan haɗawa kuma ana iya ambaton su daga rubutun.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Jerin dubawa jerin abubuwa ne a kan kati, kowanne ana yi masa alama idan an gama, don matakai, sharuɗɗan karɓa ko aikin yau da kullum. Kati zai iya samun da yawa, kuma ƙaramin kati zai iya nuna abubuwa nawa aka gama.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Ƙara jerin dubawa da ƙarinsa, sannan ƙara abubuwa kuma yi musu alama yayin da aka gama su. Hamburger na kowane jerin dubawa yana da ayyukansa: gyara duk abubuwa lokaci guda a matsayin rubutu, fitar da ko shigo da, matsar ko kwafa shi, yi alama ko cire alama a duk abubuwa, ɓoye abubuwan da aka yi wa alama, saita sake saiti kai tsaye wanda ke cire duk alamomi kullum, kowane mako ko kowane wata, ko share shi. Jerin dubawa zai iya samun wa'adinsa ma.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Ƙananan ayyuka suna raba babban kati zuwa ƙananan katuna waɗanda kowanne za a iya ba wani, tsara lokacinsa da matsar da shi daban, yayin da wannan katin iyaye ke jera su yana ƙirga nawa aka gama. Ƙaramin aiki kati ne na yau da kullum, ana ajiye shi a allon da aka zaɓa don ƙananan ayyuka.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Danna ƙari, rubuta suna kuma Ajiye don ƙirƙirar ƙaramin aiki; yi alama a Gaji alamomin iyaye don kwafar alamomin wannan kati zuwa gare shi. Alamar mahaɗi tana ƙara katin da ke akwai a matsayin ƙaramin aiki maimakon haka. Hamburger na kowane ƙaramin aiki yana da Duba shi, Je zuwa Allo kuma, ga manajojin allo, Share. Danna sunan ƙaramin aiki don sake sunansa.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Abubuwan haɗawa fayiloli ne da ake ajiyewa tare da kati: takardu, hotuna, bidiyo, rajista ko ma'ajiyoyi. Hoto zai iya kuma zama hoton murfi da ake nunawa a ƙaramin kati.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Danna ƙari don ƙara fayiloli daga kwamfutarka, liƙa ko jefa hoto, haɗa wani kati, ko zana sabon hoto. Ana nuna kowace iyakar girma da nau'ikan fayil da aka yarda ƙarƙashin waɗannan zaɓuɓɓuka. Danna abin haɗawa don buɗe shi a nunin hotuna, kuma yi amfani da maɓallan da ke kusa da shi don saukewa, sake suna ko share shi; hamburger ɗinsa yana da zaɓuɓɓukan hoton murfi.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Sharhi su ne tattaunawar kati: tambayoyi, amsoshi, sabbin bayanai da shawarwari, ana ajiye su tare da aikin da suke magana a kai. Sharhi zai iya amsa na baya, kuma ana nuna amsar ƙarƙashinsa a matsayin zare.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Rubuta a filin sharhi, ta amfani da Markdown da ambaton mutane da alamar at, kuma wallafa shi. Danna Amsa kusa da sharhi don amsa shi; tutar Amsa ga tana nuna abin da kake amsawa, kuma rufe ta yana yin sharhi na yau da kullum. Za ka iya gyara ko share sharhinka, kuma a wasu alluna marubucin sharhi ne kawai zai iya canza shi.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Lambobi masu liƙawa ƙananan alamomi ne da ake sanyawa a kati, kamar babban yatsa sama, ƙwaro, agogo ko kofin nasara, don yi masa alama a kallo ɗaya ba tare da amfani da alama ko launi ba. Ana nuna su a ƙaramin kati da kuma a katin da aka buɗe.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Danna lambar liƙawa a mai zaɓi don ƙara ta a kati; alamar tabbatarwa tana nuna tana kan kati, kuma sake danna ta yana cire ta. A cikin kati, ƙaramin giciye kusa da lambar liƙawa yana cire ta. Ƙarawa da cirewa suna buƙatar izinin canza kati.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Kati zai iya samun wurare da yawa, wuraren da aikin ke faruwa, kamar ofishin abokin ciniki, wurin aiki ko wurin taro. Kowanne yana da suna, adireshi kuma, idan an sani, daidaitawa tare da mahaɗin Buɗe a taswira.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Cika sunan wuri, adireshi, latitude da longitude kuma danna Ajiye. Liƙa mahaɗin taswira yana ba taga damar gano wurin gare ka, don haka babu wanda zai rubuta daidaitawa. Danna wuri a kan kati yana sake buɗe shi don canzawa ko share shi, kuma giciyen da ke kusa da shi yana cire shi nan take.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Dogaro suna haɗa wannan kati da wasu katuna: yana hana su, an hana shi da su, yana gyara su, kwafinsu ne ko yana da alaƙa da su. Idan dogaro suna kunne a Saitunan Memba, ana zana su a matsayin layukan kibiya masu launi a kan allo, don haka tsarin aiki yana bayyana a kallo ɗaya.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Zaɓi nau'in alaƙa da launi, sannan nema kuma danna katin da za a haɗa da shi. Ana nuna mahaɗin a Dogaron kati da kuma a matsayin layi a allo. Danna layi, ko yi amfani da Dogaron kati, don canza nau'insa, launinsa ko alamarsa, ko don cire shi. Za ka iya kuma jan maƙallin haɗi na ƙaramin kati zuwa kan wani kati.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Abubuwan aiki suna mai da layukan abin yi na bayanan taro da aka liƙa zuwa katuna. Ana samun layuka kamar TODO: Yi ajiyar wurin, layin aiki mara alama, ko layin da ke farawa da ambato ta siffarsu, ba tare da AI ba.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Taga yana jera katunan da za a yi, kowanne da alama da memba da ambato ke nuni gare shi. Cire alama daga abin da ba ka so kuma danna Ƙirƙira. Sababbin katunan suna shiga jeri ɗaya da wannan kati kuma suna haɗawa zuwa gare shi. Ambato yana zama memba ne kawai idan mutumin memba ne mai aiki na allo.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Tarihi jerin kowane canji ne da aka yi wa wannan kati: wa ya canza me, yaushe, kuma daga wace ƙima zuwa wace. Ana iya zaɓar kowane canji a mayar da shi, don haka ana iya soke kuskure ko da daga baya.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Rubuta a Nema don rage jerukan, ko danna hoton mutum don ganin canje-canjensa kawai. Yi shafi da kibiyoyi. Yi alama a jere ɗaya ko fiye kuma danna Mayar; ana mayar da jeruka da yawa daga mafi tsufa a matsayin canji ɗaya, wanda shi kansa za a iya soke shi. Ctrl+Z da Ctrl+Y suna kuma sokewa da sake yin canjinka na ƙarshe.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Lambar QR tana nuna mahaɗin wannan kati a matsayin lambar da za ka iya dubawa, don buɗe kati a waya ko kwamfutar hannu ba tare da rubuta adireshinsa ba. Ba ta canza komai a kati.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Nuna kyamarar waya ga lambar kuma buɗe mahaɗin; ana kuma nuna adireshin a matsayin rubutu ƙarƙashinta. Ana zana lambar a burauzarka kuma ba a aika komai ko'ina ba. Duk wanda ya duba ta dole ne ya shiga kuma ya sami damar shiga allo. Ana ba da rahoton mahaɗin da ya yi tsawo ga lambar QR maimakon haka.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Matsar da Kati yana matsar da kati zuwa wani wuri a wannan allo ko zuwa wani allo. Yana yin abin da jan ke yi, har ma inda jan ba zai kai ba, kamar wani allo ko wuri daidai a dogon jeri.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Zaɓi allo, layi da jeri, sannan kati da ko zai tafi sama ko ƙasa da shi. Za ka iya canza suna, rubuta dalilin matsarwa na zaɓi, kuma yi alama a Bar mahaɗi a wurin asali don ajiye katin da aka haɗa inda yake. Danna An gama da zarar wurin zuwa ya loda. Shift+M yana kuma buɗe wannan taga, kuma ana tuna wurin zuwa ga kowane allo.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Kwafa Kati yana yin sabon kwafi mai zaman kansa na kati a wannan allo ko wani, tare da lambarsa da kwafin sharhi, jerin dubawa, abubuwan haɗawa da ƙananan ayyuka nasa.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Gyara suna idan kana so; suna mara komai ba ya kwafa komai. Zaɓi allo, layi da jeri, sannan kati da ko kwafin zai tafi sama ko ƙasa da shi, kuma danna An gama. Idan aka ƙi kwafin, ana nuna dalilin a nan. Shift+C yana kuma buɗe wannan taga, kuma ana tuna wurin zuwa ga kowane allo.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Maimaita kati yana sa WeKan ya ƙirƙiri sabon kwafin wannan kati a jeri ɗaya bisa jadawali, don aikin da ke maimaituwa kamar rahoton matsayi na kowane mako ko takardar kuɗi ta kowane wata wanda in ba haka ba za a sake ƙirƙira shi da hannu.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Zaɓi Kullum, Kowane mako ko Kowane wata, ko A kashe don dakatar da shi; A kashe shi ne tsoho. Sannan sabar tana yin kwafin da kanta, ba tare da wani saiti ba. Kai kati ma'ajiya yana kuma hana shi yin ƙarin kwafi, ko da tazarar tana nan a saita.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Kwafa Samfuri zuwa Katuna Da Yawa yana yin kwafi da yawa na wannan kati lokaci guda. Kati yana aiki a matsayin samfuri: jerin dubawarsa, abubuwan haɗawa, alamomi da sauran filaye suna zuwa kowane kwafi, kuma suna da bayani ne kawai suke bambanta.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: A akwatin rubutu, rubuta shigarwa ɗaya ga kowane kati tare da sunansa da bayaninsa, bin misalin da aka riga aka cika. Zaɓi allo, layi, jeri da wurin kusa da kati, sannan danna An gama. Idan rubutun ba a tsarin da ya dace ba, ba a ƙirƙiri komai ba kuma ana nuna kuskuren a nan.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Saita launi yana ba kati launin bango nasa don ya fito a allo, misali ja don aikin gaggawa ko launin abokin ciniki. Ana sa rubutun kati ya zama mai karantuwa a kan launin kai tsaye.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Danna ɗaya daga launukan da ke da suna, launi na musamman da aka riga aka yi amfani da shi a wannan allo, ko zaɓi kowane launi ƙarƙashin Launi na musamman, sannan danna Ajiye. Cire yana ɗauke launin. Launin yana bayyana a ƙaramin kati da a katin da aka buɗe, sai dai idan an kashe shi a Saitunan Allo / Kati.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Zane yana ba ka damar zana ko rubuta da hannu a kan kati da linzamin kwamfuta, yatsa ko alƙalami: zane mai sauri, zane-zane, sa hannu ko bayanin hannu. Zanen yana zama mai iya gyarawa kuma ana ajiye hotonsa a matsayin abin haɗawa na kati ma.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Zaɓi launi da faɗin layi kuma zana. Sokewa yana komawa mataki baya, Mai gogewa yana cire layukan da ya taɓa kuma Share yana cire duka. Ajiye yana riƙe layukan a kati kuma yana adana hoton a matsayin abin haɗawa; sabon zane yana zama hoton murfin kati. Ana jera zanen da aka ajiye a nan don buɗewa da sake gyarawa, kuma Sauke a matsayin SVG yana ajiye ɗaya a matsayin fayil.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Ƙari yana nuna mahaɗin kati, katunan iyayensa da lokacin da aka ƙirƙire shi. A nan ne ake mai da kati ƙaramin aikin wani kati, kuma a nan manajan allo ke share kati gaba ɗaya.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Kwafa mahaɗin kati zuwa allon kwafi yana kwafar adireshin kati. Ƙarƙashin Canza iyayen kati, zaɓi allon tushe da katin iyaye, ko babu don sake mai da shi kati na sama; Ƙara wani katin iyaye yana ƙara iyaye, kuma giciyen da ke kusa da ɗaya yana cire shi. Share, ga manajojin allo kawai, yana cire kati har abada bayan tabbatarwa.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Ƙirƙiri allo daga wannan kati yana mai da kati mahaɗi zuwa sabon allo. Don katin da ya girma zuwa aikin kansa ne: aikin yana tafiya zuwa allonsa, kuma kati yana zama inda yake a matsayin hanyar shiga.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Ana cika sunan sabon allo da sunan kati; canza shi idan kana so kuma danna Ƙirƙiri allo daga wannan kati. Ana ƙirƙirar allo da kai a matsayin manajansa, kuma kati sannan yana buɗe wannan allo. Babu wani abu a kati da ya canza. Idan aka ƙi, ana nuna dalilin kuma babu abin da ya canza.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Haɗa zuwa allo yana sanya katin da aka haɗa na wannan kati a wani allo da ke akwai. Sannan kati yana bayyana a alluna biyu: na asali yana zama inda yake, kuma mahaɗin yana nuna abun cikinsa inda ka sanya shi.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Zaɓi allo, layi da jeri, sannan kati da ko mahaɗin zai tafi sama ko ƙasa da shi, kuma danna An gama. A jeri mara komai mahaɗin yana zuwa ƙasa. Ba a canza katin asali ba, kuma ba a kwafi alamomi ba. Ana tuna wurin zuwa ga kowane allo.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Menu na hamburger na kati, Ayyukan Kati, yana tattara duk abin da za ka iya yi da kati gaba ɗaya, ba da ɗaya daga filayensa ba. Shigarwar da ke bayyana sun dogara da matsayinka a allo.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Matsar da kwafa yana da Matsar da Kati, Kwafa Kati, Ajiye a matsayin Samfuri, Kwafa Samfuri zuwa Katuna Da Yawa, Maimaita kati da matsarwa zuwa sama ko ƙasan jeri. Sannan akwai Kula da Tauraro, da Kamanni tare da Saita launi, Zane da Ƙirƙiri katuna daga abubuwan aiki. Rabawa yana da mahaɗin kati, Haɗa zuwa allo, lambar QR da Tarihi, sannan Fitar da da Shigo da. Ma'ajiya tana da Kai kati ma'ajiya, Ƙari da Ƙirƙiri allo daga wannan kati.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Faifan Siga yana nuna abin da wannan WeKan ke gudanarwa: sigar WeKan da yadda aka shigar da shi, tsarin aiki, Meteor, ma'ajiyar bayanai da Node.js. Shi ne faifan farko na Panel na Admin / Saituna da bayanin da za a kwafa a rahoton kuskure lokacin neman taimako.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Karanta teburin, wanda aka haɗa zuwa Dandali, OS, Meteor, Ma'ajiyar bayanai da Node. Danna Duba Siga don kwatanta da sababbin sigogin WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node da NPM da aka fitar; yayin da yake aiki yana cewa yana lodawa, kuma idan dubawa ya gaza kana ganin saƙon gazawa ɗaya maimakon haka.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Kamanni yana yanke shawarar yadda wannan WeKan ke kama da abin da Duk Alluna ke nunawa: sassan da aka ɓoye kamar alluna na jama'a ko ayyukan allo, wa zai iya ƙirƙirar alluna, tsarin kwanan wata, faɗin buɗe bayanan kati, adireshin mahaɗai, autolink na mai bin diddigin matsaloli na waje, sunan samfur, launuka da tambura.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Canza filayen rukuni ɗaya kuma danna Ajiye na wannan rukunin, wanda ke adana wannan rukunin kawai. Alamomi ƙarƙashin Duk Alluna: Ɓoye suna nufin an ɓoye abin, sai dai allunan da kowane mai amfani da ya shiga zai iya gyarawa, waɗanda ake yi wa alama idan an ba da izini. Canza launi yana ajiyewa ba tare da maɓallin Ajiye ba kuma shi ne kawai rukunin da manajan ƙungiya ke gani.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Fasaloli shi ne inda mai gudanar da shafi ke kunna ko kashe sassan zaɓi na WeKan ga dukan shigarwa: ganuwan allo, mataimaka, kayan aikin Kanban da Scrum, filayen kati, Nauyin aiki da iyawa, Kasafin kuɗi da biyan kuɗi, SQRL, ActivityPub, Dokoki na karatu kawai da APIs na zaɓi masu dacewa. Layuka da jerin abubuwa suna nan koyaushe.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Cire alama daga abin da wannan WeKan bai kamata ya bayar ba, har da filayen kati da bai kamata kowane allo ya nuna ba, kuma danna Ajiye. Fasalin da ba shi da alama yana ɓacewa daga fuskar kowa kuma sabar tana ƙin shi ma, amma ana riƙe bayanansa. Za ka iya buƙatar amincewa ga fasalolin da sabunta WeKan ke ƙarawa, kuma ka ambaci masu amfani na gwaji waɗanda har yanzu suke ganin fasalolin da ke kashe.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Bayanin fasali yana ba zaɓaɓɓun masu amfani, ƙungiyoyin aiki ko ƙungiyoyi ƙaramin WeKan ta ɓoye wasu fasalolin zaɓi daga gare su, yayin da kowa kuma ke ci gaba da ganin komai. Zai iya ɓoye fasaloli iri ɗaya da faifan Fasaloli zai iya kashewa.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Danna Ƙara bayani, ba shi suna, yi alama a fasalolin da yake ɓoyewa kuma jera masu amfani, ƙungiyoyin aiki da ƙungiyoyinsa, sannan danna Ajiye na faifan. Sunayen da ba su dace da kowa ba ana ba da rahotonsu bayan ajiyewa kuma ba a adana su ba. Ana gwada bayanai a tsarin shafi, kuma menu na memba na mai amfani yana gaya masa wane bayani ke ɓoye fasaloli nawa.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Tsaro yana riƙe da maɓallan dukan sabar don abin da rubutu mai ado zai iya yi da abin da za a iya shigo da shi ko fitar da shi. Yi amfani da su don dakatar da mahaɗan da ake dannawa, nuna duk rubutu da aka tsara a matsayin tushe mara ado, toshe shigowa ko fitarwa, iyakance girman shigowa, barin hotuna, ko maye gurbin ainihin shaidar masu amfani da sunaye marasa sani.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Yi alama a maɓalli kuma ana ajiye shi nan take; ana ajiye mafi girman girman shigowa idan ka bar filin, kuma ƙima mara komai tana nufin babu iyaka. Kowane maɓalli a kashe yake a tsoho kuma sabar ce ke tilasta shi, don haka ana ƙin shigowa ko fitarwa da aka kashe ko da wani ya kira shi kai tsaye.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Maɓallai uku na dukan sabar don shafukan da dole su iyakance bin diddigin ayyuka: daina rubuta wa ya yi me, daina aika sanarwa game da ayyuka, ko hana masu amfani kula da alluna, jerin abubuwa da katuna.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Yi alama a maɓalli kuma ana ajiye shi nan take. Idan ayyuka a kashe suke, ba a rubuta wani sabon abu kuma ba a ƙara nuna shigarwar da ke akwai. Idan sanarwa a kashe take, ba a aika sanarwar cikin app, imel ko wasu ba. Idan kula a kashe yake, ba wanda zai iya canza matakin kula. Cire alamar don sake kunnawa; ayyukan da ba a rubuta ba a wannan lokaci ba sa dawowa.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Sharewa a WeKan yawanci tana yi wa jerin abubuwa, katuna da abubuwan haɗawa alamar an share kawai don a iya mayar da su. Wannan faifan yana riƙe da maɓalli ɗaya da ke ba mai gudanar da shafi damar lalata irin wannan abun ciki gaba ɗaya.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Yi alama a Kunna sharewa ta dindindin ga Babban Admin; ana ajiye shi nan take kuma ba ya share komai da kansa. Sannan alamomin sharewa suna bayyana inda ake bayar da sharewa ta dindindin, kamar jeri a kwandon shara ko allo na ma'ajiya a ma'ajiyar Duk Alluna. Ana rubuta kowane canjin saiti da yunƙurin sharewa ta dindindin a Mayarwa. Cire alamar idan ka gama.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Tutar dukan shafi don gaya wa kowane mai amfani da ya shiga wani abu lokaci guda, kamar hutun gyara, sabon adireshi ko canjin manufa. Ya bambanta da sanarwar allo kansa.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Yi alama a Sanarwar Dukan Tsari Mai Aiki, rubuta saƙon kuma danna Ajiye. Tutar tana bayyana a saman Gida, Duk Alluna da allunan da masu amfani ke membobi a cikinsu. Mai amfani zai iya rufe ta, kuma tana zama a rufe gare shi har sai ka canza rubutun. Cire alamar akwatin don sauke ta ga kowa.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Shafin samun dama shi ne inda wannan WeKan ke gaya wa masu amfaninsa yadda yake da sauƙin amfani da wanda za a tuntuɓa game da wani shinge. Wannan faifan yana kunna wannan shafi kuma yana saita sunansa da abun cikinsa.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Yi alama a An kunna shafin samun dama, wanda ke ajiyewa nan take, sannan rubuta suna da abun ciki kuma danna Ajiye. Ana tsara abun ciki kamar bayanin kati. Sannan mambobin allo suna samun mahaɗin Samun dama a gefen dama na allo. Cire alamar don sake ɓoye mahaɗin.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Kirtani na fassara na musamman suna maye gurbin rubutun WeKan na ciki a wannan shigarwa, ga kowane harshe, misali don amfani da kalmar ƙungiyarka don allo ko don gyara kirtani kafin gyararren fassara ya iso.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Danna Sabo, zaɓi harshe, shigar da maɓallin kirtanin da za a maye gurbinsa (ba jumlar Turanci ba) da rubutun da za a nuna maimakon haka, sannan Ajiye. Rubutun fassara na jere da ke akwai ne kawai za a iya gyarawa, kuma ana iya share jere daga menu ɗinsa. Maye gurbin yana shafar rubutun da sabar ke yi, kamar imel; a burauza a yanzu suna bayyana ga masu gudanar da shafi kawai.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Faifan PWA yana sarrafa abin da burauzoji da wayoyi ke karantawa game da WeKan kansa: ƙarin alamun meta da mahaɗi a kowane shafi, manifest na yanar gizo da ake amfani da shi idan aka shigar da WeKan a matsayin app, da fayil ɗin mahaɗan app na Android wanda ke ba app na Android damar buɗe mahaɗan WeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Yi alama a sashen da kake so ka keɓance, wanda ke ajiyewa nan take, liƙa alamominka ko JSON kuma danna Ajiye. Ana ƙin JSON mara inganci kuma ba a ajiye komai ba. Ana ƙara alamun meta a matsayin abubuwan meta kawai, don haka ana cire rubutun umarni, salo da alamun sabunta shafi. Idan maɓalli a kashe yake, WeKan yana amfani da tsoffin sa na ciki.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Webhooks na duniya suna aika saƙo zuwa wani adireshi, kamar hira ko sabar sarrafa kai, a duk lokacin da wani abu ya faru a kowane allo na wannan WeKan. Suna amfani da fom iri ɗaya da webhooks na allo kansa. Faifan yana kuma jera runduna na ciki da webhooks za su iya kaiwa da webhook na shiga da rajista.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Cika fom mara komai da suna, adireshi, alama ta zaɓi da nau'i, hanya ɗaya ko hanya biyu, kuma danna Ƙirƙira. A webhook da aka ajiye za ka iya kashe shi, zaɓar waɗanne ayyuka yake aikawa da yadda yake isarwa, sannan Ajiye. Jera runduna a cibiyar sadarwar WeKan kansa ƙarƙashin Wuraren zuwa na ciki, ɗaya a kowane layi, don a ba webhooks izinin kaiwa gare su.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Alamomin tare suna ba alama suna ɗaya da launi ɗaya a alluna da yawa lokaci guda: a kowane allo, a allunan ƙungiya, ko a allunan ƙungiyar aiki. Yi amfani da su don alamomi kamar Gaggawa ko Abokin ciniki waɗanda ya kamata su yi kama ɗaya a ko'ina.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Ƙara alama a jere na ƙarshe da suna, launi da kundin bayani, sannan danna Ƙara alamar tare; kowane jere yana ajiyewa ko sharewa da kansa. A alamomin kati, mambobin allo suna ganin alamomin tare da allonsu zai iya amfani da su kuma suna danna ɗaya don ƙara ta. Sake suna ko launi a nan yana canza ta a kowane allo, kuma share ta yana barin ta a waɗannan alluna a matsayin alamarsu.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Faifan Imel yana saita yadda WeKan ke aika wasiƙa, ko ta saitunan wasiƙar sabar kansa ko ta mai bayarwa da aka saita a nan, kuma yana riƙe da saitunan da suka dace: wane yankin imel zai iya gayyatar mutane idan rajistar kai a kashe take, ko masu amfani za su iya canza adireshinsu, abin da za a yi da wasiƙar da ta dawo, da samfuran imel na gayyata da ayyuka.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Yi alama a Kunna ƙarƙashin saitunan imel, zaɓi SMTP ko mai bayarwa na ciki, cika sunan mai amfaninsa, kalmar sirri da adireshin mai aikawa kuma danna Ajiye; ana riƙe kalmar sirri da aka ajiye idan aka bar filin babu komai. Aika imel na gwaji zuwa kanka don duba yana aiki. Ba tare da alamar ba, saitunan wasiƙar sabar kansa suna ci gaba da aiki. Filayen samfuri marasa komai suna riƙe imel na ciki.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Tsohon dukan shafi don sanarwa: ko tire na sanarwar cikin app da imel suna kunne ko a kashe ga kowa, da yadda imel, tire da webhooks masu fita ke isarwa a tsoho. Saitunan allo da saitunan kowane memba za su iya rinjayar sa a fagensu.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Zaɓi I ko A'a don Tire na sanarwa da don Imel; ana ajiye zaɓin nan take. Buɗe tasha don saita tsarinta, abin da take nunawa, yadda ake haɗa sanarwa da lokacin da ake aika su, kowanne ana ajiye shi nan take. Manajojin allo da mambobi za su iya zaɓar Tsoho don komawa abin da ka saita a nan. Saitunan imel zuwa kati suna a faifai ɗaya.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Yankuna suna jera kowane yankin imel da asusun wannan WeKan ke amfani da shi, tare da yawan masu amfani a kowanne. Hanya ce mai sauri don ganin waɗanne ƙungiyoyi ke kan shigarwa da gano yankin da ba a zata ba ba tare da karanta dukan jerin masu amfani ba.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Karanta teburin, jere ɗaya ga kowane yanki tare da yawan masu amfaninsa. Rubuta wani sashe na yanki a akwatin nema kuma danna Enter don nemo shi, kuma matsa tsakanin shafuka da maɓallan na baya da na gaba. Ba a adana komai ba; ana ƙirga teburin sabo duk lokacin da aka nuna shi.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Ƙungiyoyi suna haɗa masu amfani ta kamfani, sashe ko abokin ciniki don a raba alluna da allunan samfuri da dukansu, a ci gaba da daidaita mambobinsu da kundin adireshi kamar LDAP, kuma, tare da multitenancy, ƙungiya za ta iya samun yankunanta, tambarinta da manajojinta.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Danna Sabo a kan ginshiƙi na farko don ƙirƙirar ɗaya, Gyara don canza jere, da menu na jere don share shi ko naɗa manajojin ƙungiya. Maɓallan jere don samfuran tare, ƙara mambobi zuwa alluna da daidaita mambobi daga mai bayar da shiga suna ajiyewa nan take. Yi alama a Ƙara mambobin allo daga Ƙungiya ɗaya kawai don iyakance wanda za a iya ƙarawa zuwa alluna.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Ƙungiyoyin aiki suna haɗa masu amfani da ke aiki tare don a raba allo ko allunan samfuri da dukan ƙungiyar, a ci gaba da daidaita mambobi da kundin adireshi kamar LDAP, kuma a rage jerin Mutane zuwa ƙungiyar aiki ɗaya. Suna aiki kamar ƙungiyoyi ba tare da sashen mai haya ba.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Danna Sabo a kan ginshiƙi na farko don ƙirƙirar ƙungiyar aiki, Gyara don canza ta, ko menu na jere don share ta. Maɓallan jere suna ajiyewa nan take. Don sanya mutane cikin ƙungiyoyin aiki, yi musu alama a Panel na Admin / Mutane / Mutane kuma danna Ƙungiyoyin aiki. Yi alama a Ƙara mambobin allo daga Ƙungiyar aiki ɗaya kawai don iyakance wanda za a iya ƙarawa zuwa alluna.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Mutane yana jera kowane asusu a wannan WeKan tare da imel ɗinsa, matsayin admin, bayanin fasali, yanayin aiki, ƙasashen shiga, yanayin kulle, aiki na ƙarshe da ranar ƙirƙira. A nan ne kake ƙirƙira, gyara, kashewa, buɗe kulle, yin kamar wani, ɓoye suna da share asusu.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Nema ta sunan mai amfani, suna ko imel kuma danna Enter, kuma rage da Nuna da Ƙungiyar aiki. Danna Sabo don ƙirƙirar mai amfani da Gyara don canza ɗaya. Danna alamar aiki don kashewa ko kunnawa, da jan kulle ko Buɗe Duka don buɗe kulle. Menu na jere yana da yin kamar wani, ɓoye suna da sharewa; yi alama a mutane da yawa kuma danna Ƙungiyoyin aiki don canza ƙungiyoyinsu.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Kariya daga hari na ƙarfi tana kulle asusu bayan gazawar shiga da yawa. Wannan faifan yana saita gazawa nawa ke jawo kulle, tsawon lokacinsa da tazarar lokacin da ake ƙirga gazawa, daban ga sunayen masu amfani da ke akwai da sunayen da ba su wanzu ba.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Cika gazawa, lokacin kulle da tazara, a daƙiƙoƙi, ga sanannun masu amfani da waɗanda ba a sani ba kuma danna Ajiye; sababbin ƙimomin suna aiki nan take ba tare da sake farawa ba. Don gani da sakin asusu da aka kulle, buɗe Panel na Admin / Mutane / Mutane, zaɓi Masu Amfani da aka Kulle Kawai kuma danna jan kulle, ko Buɗe Duka.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Rajistar bincike ita ce hanyar abin da masu gudanar da shafi suka yi, sabo a farko: yaushe, wa, wane aiki, ko ya yi nasara, bayanansa da adireshin da ya fito. Yana amsa wa ya canza wani abu da yaushe don saitunan mutane, shiga, ma'ajiya da ajiya.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Karanta teburin Yaushe, Mai gudanarwa, Aiki, Bayani da IP; ana yi wa aikin da aka ƙi alama da kuskurensa. Rubuta a akwatin nema don rage jeruka ta mai gudanarwa, aiki ko bayani, kuma yi amfani da kibiyoyi ƙarƙashin tebur don matsawa tsakanin shafuka.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Matsayi suna yanke shawarar waɗanne matsayin allo za su iya gayyatar mutane zuwa allo, suna ba ka damar gina matsayi na musamman daga abin da memban allo zai iya yi, kuma suna nuna abin da kowane matsayi zai iya yi. Masu gudanar da shafi koyaushe suna da kowane hakki.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Ƙarƙashin Ba da izinin Gayyata zuwa Allo, yi alama a matsayin da za su iya gayyata kuma danna Ajiye. Ƙarƙashin Matsayi na musamman, rubuta suna, yi alama a abin da matsayin zai iya yi kuma danna Ƙara matsayi; kowane jere yana ajiyewa ko sharewa da kansa, kuma manajojin allo za su iya ba mambobi matsayin sannan. Teburin Matsayin Matsayi yana nuna sakamakon alamominka, ko kafin ka ajiye.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Samfuran tare suna ba ka damar duba allunan samfuri na masu amfani da za a iya rabawa ta ƙungiya, ƙungiyar aiki ko yankin imel. Alamomin suna kuma yanke shawarar waɗanne irin rukuni za a iya raba allon samfuri da su daga Duk Alluna / Samfura.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Yi alama a Ƙungiyoyi, Ƙungiyoyin aiki ko Yankuna; kowace alama tana ajiyewa nan take ga dukan shigarwa. Ƙarƙashin kowane fage da aka yi wa alama kana ganin kowane rukuni, masu amfaninsa da allunan samfurinsu, kuma danna allon samfuri yana buɗe shi. Ko samfuran rukuni ɗaya suna kaiwa mambobinsa ana saita shi ga kowace ƙungiya da ƙungiyar aiki a faifansu.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Shiga yana yanke shawarar abin da aka yarda lokacin shiga, kamar manta kalmar sirri, rajistar kai, canza sunan mai amfani, share asusun kai da mai zaɓar hanya. Yana kuma ba ka damar rinjayar saitunan shiga na sabar ba tare da sake farawa ba, misali shiga da kalmar sirri, hanyar tsoho, tsawon zama, fita kai tsaye, dokokin kalmar sirri da tantancewa ta matakai biyu ta tilas.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Yi alama ko cire alama a akwatunan Shiga: Ba da izini; kowanne yana ajiyewa idan aka danna. Idan rajistar kai a kashe take, yi amfani da Gayyaci Mutane don gayyatar adireshi zuwa zaɓaɓɓun alluna. A fom ɗin saituna kowane fili yana faɗin wace ƙima ke aiki; rubuta ko zaɓi ƙima kuma ajiye, ko bar shi babu komai ko zaɓi Tsoho don komawa saitunan sabar. Kowace hanyar shiga tana da faifanta a menu na Mutane.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Shiga ta SAML yana ba mutane damar shiga ta mai bayar da shaidar ƙungiyarka maimakon kalmar sirri ta WeKan. Mai bayarwa yana tabbatar da su waye da saƙo mai sa hannu kuma WeKan yana shigar da su, yana ƙirƙirar asusu a shigarsu ta farko.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Shigar da adireshin shiga da takardar shaidar sa hannu na mai bayar da shaida, sunan mai fitarwa na wannan WeKan da sauran zaɓuɓɓuka a wannan faifai, ko a saitunan sabar; ƙimar da aka ajiye a nan tana rinjayar ta sabar. Da zarar an kunna, shafin shiga yana nuna maɓallin Shiga da SAML wanda ke kai mai amfani zuwa mai bayar da shaida ya dawo.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Shiga ta LDAP yana ba mutane damar shiga da sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri da suke da su a kundin adireshinku, kamar Active Directory ko OpenLDAP. WeKan yana duba kalmar sirri a kundin adireshi, yana ƙirƙirar asusu a shiga ta farko kuma zai iya daidaita sunaye, imel, matsayin admin, ƙungiyoyi da ƙungiyoyin aiki da kundin adireshi.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Cika adireshin kundin adireshi, tashar jiragen ruwa, ɓoyewa, tushe da yadda ake neman masu amfani, sannan ajiye; ƙimar da aka ajiye tana rinjayar saitunan sabar kuma Tsoho yana mayar da ƙimar sabar. Danna Gwada Haɗin LDAP don gwada saitunan da ke aiki, da Daidaita masu amfani na LDAP yanzu don gudanar da daidaitawar bango nan take. Zaɓi LDAP a matsayin hanyar tsoho a faifan Shiga.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Shiga ta OAuth2 da OpenID Connect yana ba mutane damar shiga da asusu a wani sabis, kamar Keycloak, Authelia ko GitLab, maimakon kalmar sirri ta WeKan. Ba kamar kafaffun masu bayar da shiga na zamantakewa ba, kana nuna shi ga kowane mai bayarwa ta ba da adireshinsa.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Yi rajistar WeKan a matsayin aikace-aikace a wurin mai bayarwa, sannan shigar da id na abokin ciniki, sirri, adireshin sabar, wuraren ƙarshe da yadda filayen mai amfaninsa ke daidaita da WeKan a nan; ƙimar da aka ajiye a nan tana rinjayar saitunan sabar kuma tana aiki a shiga ta gaba ba tare da sake farawa ba. Sannan shafin shiga yana nuna maɓallin shiga wanda ake saita rubutunsa a faifan Shiga.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS tsarin shiga sau ɗaya ne: mutane suna shiga sau ɗaya a sabar CAS na ƙungiyarka, kuma WeKan yana amincewa da tikitin da take mayarwa, don haka WeKan ba ya taɓa ganin kalmar sirri.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Shigar da adireshin tushe, shiga da tabbatarwa na sabar CAS a nan kuma kunna shi; ƙimar da aka ajiye a nan tana rinjayar saitunan sabar. Zaɓi CAS a matsayin hanyar tsoho a faifan Shiga, ko bar masu amfani su zaɓe shi daga mai zaɓar hanya. Shiga yana kai burauza zuwa shafin shiga na CAS ya mayar da shi WeKan, a shigar.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Shiga ta kan saƙo yana ba amintaccen proxy na baya da ya riga ya yi shiga sau ɗaya damar gaya wa WeKan wanene mai amfani, don haka ana shigar da mai amfani ba tare da kalmar sirri ba kuma ana ƙirƙirar asusu a ziyarar farko.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Ana nuna waɗannan saitunan don karatu kawai a nan kuma ba za a iya ajiye su daga Panel na Admin ba, saboda amintaccen proxy zai iya shiga a matsayin kowa; ana saita su a saitunan sabar tare da sake farawa. Dole ne proxy ya tantance mai amfani, ya aika kanun shaida kuma ya cire irin waɗannan kanun da abokan ciniki suka aika, kuma adireshin proxy da aka jera ne kawai ake amincewa da su.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Waɗannan su ne maɓallan shiga na zamantakewa da aka shirya: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo da Meetup. Kowanne yana buƙatar id na app da sirrin da mai bayarwa ya ba ka kawai, kuma ana iya amfani da su tare da shiga ta OAuth2 na gama-gari.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Ƙirƙiri app a shafin masu haɓakawa na mai bayarwa tare da adireshin dawowa na WeKan, sannan shigar da id da sirrinsa a nan kuma kunna mai bayarwa; ƙimar da aka ajiye a nan tana rinjayar saitunan sabar. Sannan maɓallin Shiga da na wannan mai bayarwa yana bayyana a shafin shiga.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Shiga ba tare da kalmar sirri ba yana ba mai amfani damar shiga da lambar amfani sau ɗaya da WeKan ke aika masa ta imel, maimakon kalmar sirri. Sauƙi ne ga mutanen da ke manta kalmomin sirri, ba mataki na biyu ba, kuma amincinsa daidai yake da na akwatin wasiƙar mai amfani.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Tabbatar imel mai fita yana aiki, sannan kunna shi a nan; ƙimar da aka ajiye a nan tana rinjayar saitunan sabar. Sannan shafin shiga yana bayar da aika lambar shiga ta imel: mai amfani yana rubuta adireshinsa, yana karɓar lamba mai aiki na ɗan lokaci, yana shigar da ita kuma ya shiga.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Ajiya tana ɗaukar ma'ajiyar wannan WeKan yanzu ko bisa jadawali, tare da bayanan rubutu, abubuwan haɗawa da hotuna a matsayin zaɓuɓɓuka daban, kuma tana mayar da ita. Mai gudanar da shafi yana ajiye dukan shigarwa ko ƙungiya ɗaya; manajan ƙungiya yana ajiye allunanta kawai. Ajiya mai ci gaba maimakon haka tana kwarara kowane canji don ka iya mayarwa zuwa kowane lokaci.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Zaɓi fage, yi alama a abin da za a haɗa kuma danna Ajiye yanzu; cikakkiyar ajiya tana buƙatar duka uku da dukan shigarwa. Saita jadawali na kullum, kowane mako ko kowane wata kuma Ajiye. Danna Jera ajiyoyi kuma mayar da ɗaya, ko ƙara bayanan da suka ɓace kawai ko maye gurbin komai. A Ajiya mai ci gaba, saita babban fayil na manufa, abun ciki da riƙewa, sannan zaɓi wurin mayarwa.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Faifan Abubuwan haɗawa suna yanke shawarar inda ake adana abubuwan haɗawa na kati da hotuna, girman da za su iya kai, tsawon lokacin da ake riƙe su da yadda suke matsawa tsakanin ma'ajiyoyi. Ana iya ajiye fayiloli a faifan sabar, a ma'ajiyar bayanai ko a ma'ajiyar gajimare kamar S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage ko WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Zaɓi faifai daga menu na hagu. Saita ma'ajiyar da sababbin fayiloli ke zuwa, saita kowace ma'ajiya da maɓallan karatu da rubutu nata, kuma matsar da abubuwan haɗawa ko hotuna daga wata ma'ajiya zuwa wata. Iyakoki yana saita girman ɗorawa da saukewa, Riƙewa yana share tsoffin abubuwan haɗawa bayan wasu kwanaki, kuma Ƙaura ma'ajiyar bayanai yana matsar da bayanan rubutu tsakanin MongoDB da FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Shafin farko na Panel na Admin / Matsaloli da dubawarka ta kullum na dukan sabar. Yana gaya maka abin da ke gudana yanzu, abin da ke kuskure yanzu, da sababbin matsaloli nawa kowane rahoto ya tattara, tare da maɓallan gyara ko amincewa da su.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Matsayi yana jera ƙaura da gyare-gyaren da ke gudana, waɗanda za su iya rage saurin shiga, sannan kowace matsala da adadi da abin da za a yi, da maɓallin Gyara katunan da suka lalace, Mayar ko Gyara inda ya dace. Gyaran da ke share bayanai yana tambayarka ka danna Tabbatar da farko. Ƙarƙashin Lafiyar bayanai, Fara yana gudanar da binciken bango. Ƙarƙashin Matsaloli, yi alama a rahotannin da ka duba kuma danna Amince don sake saita sabon adadinsu, ko Share don share jerukansu.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Kowane yunƙuri da mai tsaron tsaro ya ƙi ko ya lura: menene, yaya tsananinsa, wa ya gwada, daga ina da sau nawa. Yana nuna cewa wani ya gwada, ba kawai cewa an rufe ramin ba. Maɓallan tsaro kansu suna a Panel na Admin / Saituna / Tsaro.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Ana jera jeruka sabo a farko, kuma yunƙurin da aka maimaita jere ɗaya ne wanda adadin Yunƙurinsa ke ƙaruwa, yayin da Bayani ke faɗin abin da mai tsaro ya gani. Rubuta suna, rukuni, tushe, sunan mai amfani ko adireshi a akwatin nema don tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa, kuma danna sunan mai amfani don buɗe wannan asusu. Amince ko share rahoton a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Hanyar bincike ta masu gudanarwa da ke aiki a matsayin wasu masu amfani. Yin kamar wani yana ba mai gudanarwa damar ganin WeKan yadda mai amfani ɗaya ke ganinsa, misali don fitar da allo na sirri, kuma wannan rahoto yana sa wannan iko ya kasance a bayyane daga baya.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Ana rubuta jere idan mai gudanarwa ya zaɓi Yi kamar mai amfani a Panel na Admin / Mutane, ya ƙirƙiri alamar shiga ga wani mai amfani ta REST API, ko ya fitar da allo, kati ko abin haɗawa yayin da yake yin kamar wani. Kowane jere yana nuna kwanan wata, mai gudanarwa, mai amfanin da aka yi kamarsa, allo da dalili, sabo a farko. Danna suna don buɗe wannan mai amfani, kuma nema da Enter. Babu abin da ke nan da ke canza ko share jere.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Yana nuna wanda ke shiga da kalmar sirri da ta gaza mafi ƙarancin tsawo, daga ina, da ko ya canza ta tun lokacin. Za ka iya ganin wanda abin zai shafa kafin ka tilasta mafi ƙarancin tsawo ga sababbin kalmomin sirri.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Saita Mafi ƙarancin tsawon kalmar sirri, yi alama a Tilasta mafi ƙarancin tsawo don ƙin sababbin kalmomin sirri gajeru, kuma danna Ajiye. Ba a taɓa ƙin shiga ba, amma idan tilastawa a kunne take, ana tambayar asusu mai tsohuwar gajeriyar kalmar sirri ya canza ta da farko. Teburin yana da jere ɗaya ga kowane asusu tare da shiga ta farko da ta ƙarshe, adireshi, adadin shiga da lokacin da aka gyara. Tace ta Kalmar sirri gajeru, An gyara zuwa kalmar sirri mai tsawo ko Duka. Ba a jera asusun da ke shiga ta LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS ko Sandstorm ba.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Yana bayyana yadda WeKan ke loda katunan allo, wanda ke yanke shawarar nawa babban allo ke kashewa don buɗewa. Bayani ne kawai, ba tare da abin dannawa ko ajiyewa ba.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Loda katuna kai tsaye ne ga kowane allo: allo mai katuna fiye da 500 yana loda katunan da ake gani a kowane jeri kawai yayin da kake gungurawa, tare da adadi daga sabar, kuma ƙaramin allo yana loda kowane kati. Mai gudanar da sabar zai iya tilasta loda duka ko loda a hankali, ko canza adadin katuna, a saitunan sabar sannan ya sake farawa. Ganin Ƙididdiga na allo yana nuna wane yanayi yake amfani da shi.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Yana jera buƙatun shafin yanar gizo da REST API da suka ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo kafin amsawa, don ka ga waɗanne shafuka ko kira ke jinkiri da sau nawa.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Ana auna lokacin kowace buƙata sai dai fayiloli marasa canzawa, kuma ana rubuta wadda ta ɗauki daƙiƙa biyu ko fiye a tsoho. Ana ajiye buƙata mai jinkiri iri ɗaya a matsayin jere ɗaya wanda adadinsa da kwanan watansa ke ƙaruwa, kuma Bayani yana nuna hanya, hanyar adireshi da tsawon lokacin da ta ɗauka. Nema yana tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa, kuma Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa yana amincewa ko share ta. Ana saita iyakar, ko kashe ta, a saitunan sabar. Lokutan kira na kai tsaye na hanyoyi da wallafe-wallafe suna ƙarƙashin Kayan aunawa maimakon haka.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Binciken kai na sabar da ke gudana waɗanda suka gaza. Jim kaɗan bayan farawa, WeKan yana duba cewa ma'ajiyar bayanai tana amsawa, cewa ana iya rubutawa a babban fayil na fayiloli, cewa ƙwaƙwalwar heap tana da sarari da ya rage kuma faifai yana da sarari kyauta.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Binciken suna gudana sau ɗaya, kusan daƙiƙa 15 bayan sabar ta fara, kuma gazawa ce kawai ke yin jere: Tushe yana ambaton binciken kuma Bayani yana ba da saƙon kuskurensa. Babu sababbin matsaloli yana nufin babu abin da ya gaza tun lokacin da aka share rahoton na ƙarshe. Faifan ba shi da maɓallin sake gudanar da su, don haka sake farawa WeKan. Amince ko share shi a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Yana kallon nauyin na'ura mai sarrafawa na dukan injin, saboda WeKan da ma'ajiyar bayanansa a kwamfuta ɗaya za su iya amfani da isasshen CPU har su rage saurin wasu manhajoji. Ana rubuta lokutan CPU mai yawa da suka daɗe a nan, kuma dogayen ayyuka suna rage gudu yayin da injin ke shagaltuwa.
help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Layin sama yana nuna amfani da CPU na yanzu, yawan ginshiƙai, matsakaicin nauyi, mafi ƙanƙanta, matsakaici da mafi girma na kwanan nan, da abin da WeKan ke yi, ana sabunta shi kowane daƙiƙa 5. Teburin da ke ƙasa yana jera lokutan shagaltuwa na baya: jeren farawa, aƙalla jere ɗaya game da rage gudu, da jeren ƙarewa tare da tsawon lokaci, ƙoli da ko rage gudu ya taimaka. Nema yana tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa. Iyakoki, ko kashe mai kallo, suna a saitunan sabar.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Yana kallon yawan ƙwaƙwalwa da swap da dukan injin ke amfani da su, kuma yana rubuta lokacin da lokacin amfani da ƙwaƙwalwa mai yawa ya fara da lokacin da ya ƙare. Ƙarewar ƙwaƙwalwa, ko swap, yana rage gudu ko ya ruguza WeKan da wasu manhajoji a inji ɗaya.
help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Layin sama yana nuna amfani da ƙwaƙwalwa na yanzu a matsayin kashi da kuma gigabytes da aka yi amfani da su da jimla, tare da swap idan injin yana da shi, ana sabunta shi kowane daƙiƙa 5. A ƙasansa, teburin yana riƙe da jeren farawa ɗaya da jeren ƙarewa ɗaya ga kowane lokacin ƙwaƙwalwa mai yawa, sabo a farko, jeruka 10 a shafi, tare da akwatin nema. Amince ko share shi a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa. Iyakokin suna a saitunan sabar kuma ana karanta su idan sabar ta fara.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Yana kallon sarari kyauta a faifan da ke riƙe da ma'ajiyar bayanai, abubuwan haɗawa da abubuwan da aka ɗora. Cikakken faifai yana sa ɗorawa su gaza kuma yana hana ma'ajiyar bayanai rubutawa, don haka wannan yana ba da gargaɗi da wuri kafin hakan ya faru.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Layi ɗaya kai tsaye ga kowane faifai yana nuna kashin da aka yi amfani da shi, gigabytes kyauta da jimla, wurinsa da abin da WeKan ke ajiyewa a can, ana sabunta shi kowane daƙiƙa 30, kuma ana haskaka faifan da ke cikin lokaci mai yawa. Teburin da ke ƙasa yana da jeren farawa da jeren ƙarewa ga kowane lokacin amfani mai yawa, kuma nema yana tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa. Amince ko share shi a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa. Ana iya ƙara wasu faifai da za a kalla a saitunan sabar.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Masu ƙirga kai tsaye na abin da wannan sabar WeKan ke yi: haɗi nawa ke buɗe, da sau nawa ake kiran kowace hanya da wallafawa, sau nawa take gazawa da tsawon lokacin da take ɗauka. Yana nuna wane sashe na WeKan ke shagaltuwa ko gazawa yanzu ba tare da wani kayan aikin kallo daban ba.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Layin sama yana nuna haɗi masu aiki, waɗanda aka buɗe da waɗanda aka rufe da lokacin da ƙirga ya fara. Sanduna ga kowane yanki, kamar Katuna, Alluna, Shiga ko Abubuwan haɗawa, suna nuna kira, matsakaicin lokaci da kurakurai; danna yanki don nuna jerukansa kawai, kuma sake danna don nuna duka. Teburin yana jera kira, waɗanda aka kammala, kurakurai, da matsakaicin lokaci da mafi girma. Yana sabuntawa kowane daƙiƙa biyar, yana ƙirga wannan tsarin sabar kawai, kuma yana sake farawa daga sifili bayan sake farawa.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Yana jera katunan da babu allo da zai iya nuna su, saboda allo, layi ko jerin da suke ciki ya ɓace. Yana ƙunshe da kowane allo a sabar, ko kai memba ne ko a'a.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Kowane jere yana nuna sunan kati, id ɗinsa, sunayen allo, layi da jerin da har yanzu suke wanzuwa, nau'insa da lokacin da aka ƙirƙire shi; tantanin da babu komai shi ne sashen da ya ɓace. Rubuta wani sashe na suna kuma danna Enter don nema, kuma yi shafi da maɓallan na baya da na gaba. Faifan yana jera katuna ne kawai: gyara su da Gyara katunan da suka lalace a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa. Buɗe allo yana kuma gyara katunansa.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Yana jera abubuwan haɗawa da aka adana a wannan sabar, tare da maɓallan da ke duba abin da ma'ajiyar bayanai ke faɗi game da kowane abin haɗawa da hoto a kan abin da ke cikin ma'ajiya da gaske. Binciken suna gano fayilolin da suka ɓace, waɗanda ba a ambata ba ko waɗanda aka yi wa alamar kuskure da tarihin da zai iya bayyana su.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Teburin yana nuna samfoti, sunan fayil, girma, nau'i da id na abin haɗawa, allo da kati, tare da akwatin nema. Duba fayiloli da tarihi, Duba nau'ikan fayil da ƙarin suna, ko Duba fayilolin da suka ɓace da waɗanda ba a bi ba yana fara bincike; Soke bincike yana dakatar da shi. Bayan haka, karanta adadi, faɗin bincike da samfurin abubuwan da aka gano, ko yi amfani da Sauke taƙaitaccen matsayi. Binciken ba sa taɓa canzawa, matsarwa ko share wani fayil ko rikodi.
help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Yana jera kowace dokar sarrafa kai a sabar tare da allonta, don ka ga a wuri ɗaya abin da WeKan ke yi kai tsaye a duk alluna, misali lokacin neman dokar da ke matsar da katuna ba zato ba tsammani.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Teburin yana nuna sunan doka, allonta, nau'in aikinta da nau'in aikin mai jawo ta, jeruka 10 a shafi, an tsara su ta allo. Rubuta wani sashe na sunan doka kuma danna Enter don nema, kuma share akwatin ka danna Enter don sake ganin duka. Faifan na karatu ne kawai: don canza doka, buɗe allonta kuma gyara ta a dokokin wannan allo.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Tebur na kowane webhook a sabar, duka webhooks na kowane allo da na duniya: wane allo kowanne ke ciki, wa ya ƙara shi da inda yake aikawa. Yana taimakawa kafin kashe webhooks, bayan wani lamari, ko idan bayanai suna zuwa wani wuri da babu wanda ya tuna ya saita.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Jere ɗaya ga kowane webhook, sabo a farko, yana nuna allo, mai shi, suna, adireshi, nau'i, ko yana kunne ko a kashe, waɗanne ayyuka yake aikawa, ko an saita alama, da lokacin da aka ƙara shi. Tace Duk webhooks, A kunne ko A kashe, kuma nema da Enter. Ba a taɓa nuna alamomi da kalmomin sirri ba. Danna sunan allo don buɗe allon kuma canza webhook ɗinsa a can, yayin da webhooks na duniya suke a Panel na Admin / Saituna / Webhooks na Duniya.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Yana jera kowane allo a sabar tare da ganuwarsa, mambobi, ƙungiyoyi da ƙungiyoyin aiki. Yana amsa waɗanne alluna ke wanzuwa, wa zai iya ganin kowanne da wa ke ciki, ba tare da buɗe kowane allo ba.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Kowane jere yana nuna suna, id, izini, ko allo yana ma'ajiya, mambobi masu aiki, da ƙungiyoyi da ƙungiyoyin aiki da aka raba shi da su. Rubuta wani sashe na suna kuma danna Enter don nema, ko zaɓi Duka, Na jama'a, Masu amfani da suka shiga ko Na sirri ƙarƙashin Izini; duka biyun suna sake farawa daga shafin farko. Yi shafi da maɓallan na baya da na gaba. Ba za a iya canza komai a nan ba.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Yana jera kowane kati a sabar, tare da inda yake da wa ke ciki, a duk alluna ko kai memba ne ko a'a. Yana amsa inda kati yake da su waye mambobinsa da waɗanda aka ba wa, ba tare da buɗe alluna ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Kowane jere yana nuna sunan kati, allonsa, layinsa da jerinsa, da sunayen masu amfani na mambobinsa da waɗanda aka ba wa. Rubuta wani sashe na suna kuma danna Enter don nema, wanda ke sake farawa daga shafin farko, kuma yi shafi da maɓallan na baya da na gaba. Ba za a iya canza komai a nan ba.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Inda kake kiyaye ma'ajiyar bayanai lafiya da gama aikin da ya tsaya a rabi. Yana nuna tarihin binciken ma'ajiyar bayanai, ajiyoyi da mayarwa, kuma yana ba ka damar yanke shawarar abin da zai faru da imel da ya makale, sanarwa, imel na dokoki, ayyukan daidaita jeri da shigowar allo da aka katse.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Daga sama kana ganin maɓallan duba fayiloli, sannan sassa kamar layin isar da imel, sanarwar ayyuka da ke jira, imel na dokoki, ayyukan daidaita jeri da shigowar da aka katse, kowanne da maɓallai kamar Dakata, Ci gaba, Sake gwadawa, Watsar ko Riƙe. Tabbatar idan an tambaya, kuma idan aikin yana shagaltuwa, danna Sabunta kuma sake gwadawa. Teburin da ke ƙasa yana rubuta kowane lamarin mayarwa da shawara; nuna Duka, An gama, Ya gaza ko An share kuma nema da Enter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Yana ƙirga shiga masu nasara ta mutum da adireshi, don ka ga inda kowane asusu ke shiga daga ciki da waɗanne adireshi asusu da yawa ke raba. Adireshin da aka raba zai iya zama ofis, VPN ko haɗin cibiyar sadarwa na tare; ba ya tabbatar da cewa asusun mutum ɗaya ne.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Ana jera mutane ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kowanne da jere ga kowane adireshi: IPv4, IPv6, shiga ta farko da ta ƙarshe, yawan shiga, da wuri idan proxy a gaban WeKan ya bayar da shi. Rubuta sunan mai amfani, cikakken suna, adireshi ko wuri kuma danna Enter don nema, kuma yi shafi da maɓallan na baya da na gaba. Ba a toshe komai saboda wannan rahoto, don haka adireshin da aka raba ba ya taɓa kulle mutane a waje.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Yana nuna waɗanne wuraren ƙarshe na REST API ake amfani da su, ta wa da sau nawa. Sauran faifai suna faɗin abin da ya lalace; wannan yana faɗin abin da ake tambayar sabar ta yi. A sabar da ba a kunna REST API ba, yana zama babu komai.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Kowane jere asusu ne da wurin ƙarshe, mafi shagaltuwa a farko: adadin kira, lokacin da aka kira shi na farko da na ƙarshe, da sababbin adireshin IPv4 da IPv6 tare da wurinsu. Sunan mai amfani mara komai yana nufin kira daga wanda ba shi da asusu, wanda aka gane ta adireshi. Rubuta wurin ƙarshe, hanya, sunan mai amfani ko adireshi don tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa, kuma yi shafi jeruka 10 a lokaci guda.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Yana bayyana abin da ma'ajiyar bayanai ta faɗa. Kuskure daga MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB ko SAP HANA yawanci ana rubuta shi ne don masu haɓaka ta, don haka wannan faifan yana ambaton ma'ajiyar bayanai, yana rarraba matsalar zuwa irin kamar faifai, shiga, tsarin rubutu ko ƙarewar lokaci, kuma yana ƙara bayani mai sauƙi da mataki na gaba.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Ana jera jeruka sabo a farko. Bayani yana faɗin ma'anar matsalar da abin da za a yi, sannan saƙon ma'ajiyar bayanai kanta, kuma sauran ginshiƙai suna nuna ma'ajiyar bayanai, irin, tsanani, aikin, wa da daga ina idan an sani, da sau nawa. Nema yana tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa, har da kalmomin ma'ajiyar bayanai kanta. Idan an magance ta, amince ko share ta a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Yana nuna ko wannan sabar ta tsaya cikin tsari, abin da ya ruguza ta, da ko ajiya mai ci gaba ta gaza, tare da maɓallan duba fayiloli iri ɗaya da Rahoton Fayiloli. Duba nan bayan katsewar da ba a zata ba.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Ana rubuta jere don sake farawa ba tare da tsayawa cikin tsari ba, a matsayin sake farawa da sauri idan sabar ta dawo cikin mintuna uku ko rugujewa idan ta daɗe a kashe, don kuskuren da ba a kama ba tare da saƙonsa, da lokacin da ajiya mai ci gaba ta gaza. Jeruka sabo a farko, 10 a shafi, kuma nema yana tacewa yayin da kake rubutawa. Maɓallan duba fayiloli a sama ba sa canza wani fayil ko rikodi. Amince ko share shi a Matsaloli / Taƙaitawa.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Panel na Gajimare shafin mai gudanar da masauki ne don sarrafa yankunan WeKan na abokan ciniki da yawa daga wuri ɗaya: kwanakinsu, ma'ajiyoyin bayanai, takardun kuɗi, tikitin tallafi da hira, bayanan DNS da hanyoyin sabar yanar gizo. Yana wanzuwa ne kawai idan saitunan sabar sun kunna shi don yankinta, kuma masu gudanar da shafi a can kawai, Manajojin Gajimare, ke ganinsa.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Ƙara yankunan abokan ciniki tare da kwanakinsu da ko kowanne yana da WeKan da ma'ajiyar bayanai nasa ko yana raba wannan, gwada haɗin ma'ajiyar bayanai, kuma rubuta takardun kuɗi. Kowane yanki yana samun allon tallafi don tikiti da hira. Duba da sabunta bayanan DNS, loda hanyoyin sabar yanar gizo, kuma jera adireshin da aka yarda don iyakance inda Manajojin Gajimare za su iya shiga. Abokan ciniki suna shiga don ganin yankinsu.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Duk Alluna shafi ne da ke jera allunanka. Menu na hagu yana zaɓar waɗanne alluna ake nunawa, kamar Masu tauraro, Sauran, Gida, Samfura, Ma'ajiya, wurin aiki ko ƙungiya ko ƙungiyar aiki, kuma sandar kai tana da tsarawa, nema, fitar da da Zaɓi Da Yawa.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Danna sashe a menu na hagu sannan allo don buɗe shi. Yi amfani da Tsara Alluna don tsarin jan musamman ko ta suna, da menu na gani don canza tsakanin alamomin allo da tebur. Kunna Zaɓi Da Yawa kuma yi alama a alluna don kai su ma'ajiya, kwafa, fitar da ko saita ɗaya a matsayin allon Gida, ko ja allo zuwa kan Ma'ajiya.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Nauyin aiki da iyawa yana nuna, mako bayan mako, yawan aikin da kowane mutum ke da shi a kan sa'o'in da yake da su, a duk allunan da kake aiki a kai. Yana nuna wanda aka ɗora wa nauyi fiye da kima, wanda zai iya ɗaukar ƙari, da abin da aiki mai zuwa ke buƙata kafin a ambaci kowa.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Zaɓi makon farko, makonni nawa da ko za a nuna sa'o'i ko maki na labari, sannan danna mako don ganin katunansa. Makonnin da ke da aiki fiye da sa'o'i ja ne. Saita lokacin aikinka, ƙwarewa da rashin zuwa, manajojin allo suna ƙara rabe-rabe da wuraren riƙe matsayi, kuma masu gudanarwa suna ƙara hutun jama'a.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Kasafin kuɗi da biyan kuɗi shi ne inda manajojin allo ke tsara da cajin aikin allo: kasafin kuɗinsa, abin da aikin ya kashe da abin da zai kashe, farashin sa'a, kashe kuɗi, kuɗaɗe kafaffu, ƙididdigar farashi da takardun kuɗi, bisa lokacin da aka bi a katuna.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Zaɓi kuɗi da farashin sa'a ga kowane memba da tsohon allo, saita kasafin kuɗi, kuma ƙara kashe kuɗi da kuɗaɗe. Sannan lokacin da aka rubuta a katuna yana bayyana a matsayin abin da aka kashe da hasashe a kan kasafin kuɗi. Idan kana so, amince da lokaci kafin takardar kuɗi. Cika bayanan mai fitar da takardar kuɗi sau ɗaya, sannan ƙirƙiri takardun kuɗi na wani lokaci, sauke su, yi musu alamar an aika kuma rubuta biyan kuɗi, ko ƙirƙiri ƙididdigar farashi don aikin da ya rage.
gitea-no-index: Ba a auna manyan fayiloli ba tukuna.
gitea-not-configured: Ba a saita babban fayil na Gitea ba. Saita GITEA_APP_INI a shafin Saituna.
gitea-not-local: Ba a kan faifan gida ba, don haka ba a auna ba:
gitea-not-sqlite: Omi yana karanta Gitea da ke amfani da SQLite kawai. Wannan Gitea yana amfani da:
gitea-read-only: Waɗannan shafuka suna karanta babban fayil na Gitea ne kawai; babu abin da ke canza shi a nan.
gitea-tree: Jerin tree -s na babban fayil na Gitea, na zaɓi
gitea-delete: Share wannan mai amfani ko ƙungiya
gitea-dry-run: Ba a canza komai ba tukuna; ga abin da sharewa za ta yi.
gitea-delete-plan: Sharewa za ta cire waɗannan layuka da fayiloli:
gitea-delete-confirm: Wannan yana share mai amfani ko ƙungiyar, rumbunan lambarsa da duk bayanansu daga babban fayil na Gitea har abada. Rubuta sunan don ci gaba:
gitea-delete-wrong-name: Sunan da aka rubuta ba sunan mai shi ba ne. Ba a share komai ba.
gitea-running: Gitea yana gudana. Tsayar da shi tukuna: Omi yana rubutu ne kawai a cikin Gitea da aka tsayar.
gitea-blocked: Ba za a iya share wannan ba:
gitea-backup-first: Madadi tukuna: madadin github-to-gitea na wannan mai shi, daga GitHub zuwa BACKUPS_DIR. Sharewa tana ci gaba ne kawai idan madadin ya yi nasara.
gitea-no-backup: Babu madadin github-to-gitea na wannan mai shi a BACKUPS_DIR.
gitea-import-help: Yana shigo da ƙungiyar GitHub ko mai amfani, ko wasu daga cikin rumbunan lambarsa, kai tsaye cikin babban fayil na Gitea: git, batutuwa, buƙatun ja, sharhi, lakabobi, matakai, fitarwa da abubuwan haɗawa. Dole ne Gitea ya tsaya. Sake gudanar da shi don kawo sabo ko abin da ya canza kawai.
gitea-github-repos: Rumbunan lamba (na zaɓi, an raba da sarari)
gitea-github-token: Alamar GitHub, ana ajiye ta a fayil kuma ba a taɓa nuna ta ba
gitea-token-works: GitHub ya karɓi alamar. An shiga a matsayin
gitea-token-requests-left: Buƙatun da suka rage a wannan sa'a:
gitea-token-rejected: GitHub bai karɓi alamar ba: ba daidai ba ce, ta ƙare ko an soke ta. Ajiye sabuwa a Saituna.
gitea-token-unreachable: Ba a iya isa GitHub ba:
gitea-job-stop-requested: Ana tsayarwa: aikin zai tsaya kafin buƙatarsa ta gaba zuwa GitHub.
gitea-bad-name: Wannan ba sunan mai shi ko rumbun lamba mai inganci ba ne.
gitea-doer: Mai amfani da Gitea da ake shigo da su da sunansa
gitea-no-sync: Kada a sake daidaita wannan rumbun lamba
gitea-sync-exclude-file: jerin rumbunan lamba da github-to-gitea da Omi ba sa daidaitawa kuma
gitea-delete-repo: Share wannan rumbun lamba da fayilolinsa
gitea-delete-repo-confirm: Wannan yana share rumbun lamba, wiki dinsa da duk bayanansa daga babban fayil na Gitea har abada. Rubuta owner/name don ci gaba:
gitea-delete-repo-wrong-name: Sunan da aka rubuta ba owner/name na rumbun lambar ba ne. Ba a share komai ba.
gitea-exclude-too: Kuma cire shi daga daidaitawa, don daidaitawa ta gaba kada ta dawo da shi
gitea-packages-unlinked: Fakitin da ke da alaƙa da shi suna zama tare da mai shi, ba tare da alaƙa ba:
gitea-index-stale: Ya tsufa tun bayan sharewa: sake aunawa don girman daidai.
gitea-db-migration-version: Sigar ƙaura ta rumbun bayanai na Gitea
gitea-orphans-delete-confirm: Wannan yana share har abada daga babban fayil na Gitea fayilolin marayu waɗanda babu abin da ke amfani da su a cikin rumbun bayanai, da layukan rumbun bayanai waɗanda fayilolinsu suka ɓace. Duk abin da ake amfani da shi a lokacin da ake share shi za a ajiye shi. Rubuta adadin marayu don ci gaba:
gitea-orphans-delete-wrong-number: Lambar da aka rubuta ba adadin marayu ba ce. Ba a share komai ba.
